original_sentence: When Nadim invited me to his sister's wedding, I knew it would be the opportunity of a lifetime.
readingExamples: When Nadim invited me to his sister's wedding, I knew it would be the opportunity of a lifetime.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a marriage ceremony, especially one with a religious service, together with any celebrations that follow
(2) n. the day on which two people get married, often used attributively (wedding dress, wedding ring)
(3) n. (figurative) a close combination or joining together of two different things or ideas

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）（两种事物的）完美结合、融合
uncommonMeanings.example: The restaurant's signature dish was a happy wedding of Sichuan spice and French technique — a marriage of two culinary worlds that no one had thought possible. （读后续写·美食创新·融合之美）

posExamples.sentence: As the bride glided down the aisle, the whole hall fell silent; it was the kind of wedding that seemed to belong in a fairy tale, and Grandma dabbed at her eyes with a trembling handkerchief. （读后续写·家庭温情·婚礼场景）
I am writing to invite you to my elder sister's wedding, which will be held at the Riverside Hotel this coming Saturday; your presence would mean a great deal to our whole family. （应用文·邀请信）
Some argue that a lavish wedding is a waste of money, yet others contend that such a ceremony strengthens family bonds and marks a milestone worth celebrating with dignity. （议论文·消费观念）
On their wedding day, the young couple planted a sapling in the garden, promising to nurture their love the way they would tend that tiny tree through the seasons to come. （读后续写·象征手法·誓言）

wordForms.other: married (婚姻的/已婚的)

idioms.translation: 奉子成婚；被迫仓促促成的结合
idioms.example: Critics dismissed the sudden merger as a shotgun wedding between two rival firms that had spent decades at each other's throats. （议论文·比喻·商业评论）

collocations.translation: 某人的婚礼（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: When Nadim invited me to his sister's wedding, I knew it would be the opportunity of a lifetime. 当纳迪姆邀请我参加他姐姐的婚礼时，我就知道这将是千载难逢的机会。（课文原句）
The whole family flew back for the wedding ceremony held in the old family courtyard. 全家人都飞回来参加在老宅院举行的婚礼仪式。
He slipped the wedding ring onto her finger, his hand shaking with joy. 他把结婚戒指戴到她手指上，手因喜悦而颤抖。
She was thrilled to be invited to her best friend's wedding. 能受邀参加最好朋友的婚礼，她激动不已。
Having flown halfway across the country to attend the wedding, Uncle Li arrived just in time to see his niece exchange her vows. （读后续写·亲情·及时赶到）
The wedding ceremony was simple yet moving, held under an old oak tree that had witnessed three generations of the family's joys and sorrows. （读后续写·环境描写）
To mark their golden wedding anniversary, the elderly couple returned to the very seaside town where they had first met fifty years before. （读后续写·怀旧·重逢）
Her mother's wedding dress, yellowed by time yet lovingly preserved, was carefully taken out of the cedar chest for the fitting. （读后续写·传承·细节）
A gold-embossed wedding invitation slipped through the letterbox, and Emma's heart leapt when she recognised the name on the envelope. （读后续写·惊喜）
The couple decided to hold a small wedding in the countryside, believing that genuine happiness needs no grand display. （应用文·个人叙述）
At the wedding reception, guests raised their glasses as the newly-weds shared their first dance beneath a canopy of twinkling fairy lights. （读后续写·欢庆场景）
For a girl who had grown up in an orphanage, this fairy-tale wedding felt like a dream from which she was afraid to wake. （读后续写·励志·圆梦）

synonyms.example: The wedding lasted only a day, but the marriage was meant to last a lifetime. 婚礼只持续一天，但婚姻本应相守一生。
synonyms.usage: 重点辨析①：marriage 指婚姻这一持续的关系或状态（a happy marriage 幸福的婚姻），也可指'结婚'这一行为；wedding 特指结婚当天的典礼与庆祝活动，是一次性事件（attend a wedding）。记忆：wedding=当天的仪式，marriage=一辈子的关系

synonyms.example: The ceremony was conducted with such solemnity that even the youngest children sat perfectly still. （读后续写·庄重场景）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：ceremony 泛指各类正式仪式（毕业、颁奖、婚礼等）；wedding 专指婚礼，语义更具体；二者常合成 a wedding ceremony 婚礼仪式

synonyms.example: The royal nuptials drew crowds from every corner of the kingdom, lining the streets long before dawn. （应用文·新闻报道·正式）
synonyms.usage: nuptials 为正式、书面或文学用语，多用于报道或典雅文体；日常语境用 wedding 更自然

advancedExpressions.expression: a wedding ceremony / ring / dress；attend / hold a wedding；wedding reception / anniversary
advancedExpressions.example: They held a small wedding, exchanged wedding rings, and later celebrated their first wedding anniversary. 他们办了一场小型婚礼，交换了结婚戒指，后来庆祝了第一个结婚纪念日。（婚礼主题词块，一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·婚礼(名词,可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: wedding / wedding ceremony / marriage ceremony / nuptials(正式)
advancedExpressions.example: The wedding (= the marriage ceremony) was held in a garden. 婚礼在花园里举行。（表'婚礼仪式'时可替换；注意 marriage 单用多指'婚姻状态'）

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had ... than the wedding ...
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had the last note of the music faded than the wedding erupted into a whirl of laughter, flying petals and clinking glasses. （倒装 no sooner...than + 动态意象堆叠，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: it would be an honour to have you at my/our wedding
advancedExpressions.example: It would be a great honour to have you share in the joy of our wedding, for no celebration feels complete without the friends who have walked beside us. （邀请信礼貌套路 + 情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: a wedding is not merely ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: A wedding is not merely a display of wealth, but a public promise — a moment in which two families, two histories, are woven into one. （not merely...but...递进 + 破折号强调）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The wedding was beautiful and everyone was happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The wedding unfolded like a scene painted in gold: sunlight streamed through the stained-glass windows, laughter rippled from table to table, and even the shyest of guests found themselves swept up in a happiness too great to contain. （读后续写·环境+群像描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like a scene painted in gold) + 三分句排比(streamed/rippled/found) + 感官细节(sunlight, laughter)营造画面感

sentenceUpgrade.original: I want to invite you to my sister's wedding.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is with great pleasure that I write to invite you to my sister's wedding, an occasion we have long looked forward to and one that would be all the more memorable with you by our side. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is with great pleasure that...正式强调句 + 同位语(an occasion...) + all the more...递进表达重视

classPractice.question: 选词填空(wedding/marriage): Their ____ lasted forty years, though the ____ itself had been a simple ceremony in the village hall.
classPractice.note: marriage 指持续的婚姻状态，wedding 指结婚当天的仪式；对比记忆

classPractice.question: 当纳迪姆邀请我参加他姐姐的婚礼时，我就知道这将是千载难逢的机会。When Nadim invited me to his sister's ____, I knew it would be the ____ of a lifetime.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；the opportunity of a lifetime 千载难逢的机会

classPractice.question: The couple exchanged their ____ rings during the wedding ____ held in a quiet garden.
classPractice.note: a wedding ring 结婚戒指；a wedding ceremony 婚礼仪式

original_sentence: The wedding ceremony took place in a brightly decorated hotel room.
readingExamples: The wedding ceremony took place in a brightly decorated hotel room.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a formal public or religious occasion, especially one celebrating a particular event, achievement or anniversary
(2) n. the formal actions, words and traditional practices used on such an occasion
(3) n. very polite or formal behaviour that follows accepted social rules; formality

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （过分讲究的）客套，礼节，繁文缛节
uncommonMeanings.example: "Come in, come in — no need to stand on ceremony here," the old fisherman laughed, pulling the drenched stranger toward the crackling fire. （读后续写·善意·打破拘束）

posExamples.sentence: As the closing ceremony began, the athletes marched into the stadium waving their national flags, and a wave of pride surged through Lin as she realised her Olympic dream had finally come true. （读后续写·体育·荣誉时刻）
On behalf of the student union, I sincerely invite you to attend the opening ceremony of our art festival, which will be held in the school auditorium at nine o'clock next Friday. （应用文·邀请信/通知）
Rather than dismissing traditional ceremonies as outdated formalities, we should recognise that they preserve collective memory and pass cultural values from one generation to the next. （议论文·传统文化）
During the graduation ceremony, the headmaster shook each student's hand, and when it was David's turn, his eyes brimmed with tears he could no longer hold back. （读后续写·毕业·情感）

wordForms.adjective: ceremonial (仪式的，礼仪的) / ceremonious (讲究礼节的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：ceremon(y) + -ial → ceremonial 仪式的（a ceremonial robe 礼服）；-y 结尾变 -ies 复数：ceremonies

idioms.example: "Please, don't stand on ceremony — treat this home as your own," said the host warmly, and at once the awkward silence melted away. （读后续写·待客·消除隔阂）

idioms.translation: 简慢地，不客气地，草草地
idioms.example: The waiter dumped the plates on the table without ceremony and hurried off, leaving the diners exchanging puzzled glances. （读后续写·人物刻画·无礼）

collocations.translation: 婚礼仪式举行（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The wedding ceremony took place in a brightly decorated hotel room. 婚礼仪式在一间装饰鲜艳的酒店房间里举行。（课文原句）
The village elder performed the ceremony while the whole family looked on in silence. 村中长者主持仪式，全家人默默注视着。
The opening ceremony of the Games left the audience breathless with wonder. 运动会开幕式让观众叹为观止。
The opening ceremony dazzled the audience with a spectacular fusion of ancient legend and modern technology. （应用文·活动报道）
Thousands gathered to attend the ceremony honouring the volunteers who had risked their lives in the flood rescue. （读后续写·致敬·英雄）
As her name echoed across the hall at the award ceremony, Maya rose on trembling legs, hardly believing the moment was real. （读后续写·获奖·心理）
The graduation ceremony marked not an ending but a threshold, beyond which a whole world of possibility lay waiting. （读后续写·成长·哲思）
The wedding ceremony was held at dusk, when the fading light lent the garden a warm, dreamlike glow. （读后续写·环境）
The ancient religious ceremony, unchanged for centuries, filled the temple with the low murmur of chanting and the scent of burning incense. （读后续写·文化·氛围）
The village elder performed the ceremony with slow, deliberate movements that commanded everyone's silent respect. （读后续写·传统·庄重）
Every Monday morning our school holds a flag-raising ceremony, during which students stand at solemn attention as the national anthem rings out. （应用文·校园生活）

synonyms.example: Lighting a single candle at dawn had become her private ritual, a quiet moment of peace before the noise of the day began. （读后续写·习惯·心理）
synonyms.usage: ritual 强调按固定程序重复进行的行为（含宗教或个人习惯）；ceremony 更强调某一正式、公开的隆重场合

synonyms.example: The coming-of-age rite marked the boy's passage into manhood in the eyes of his tribe. （读后续写·文化·成人礼）
synonyms.usage: rite 多指传统或宗教中固定的仪式行为，常成套出现(rites of passage)；书面色彩强于 ceremony

synonyms.example: Signing the contract was a mere formality; the real agreement had been sealed with a handshake weeks earlier. （议论文/记叙·程序）
synonyms.usage: formality 侧重按规矩走的例行程序或客套；ceremony 侧重隆重、值得纪念的正式活动

advancedExpressions.expression: hold / perform / attend a ceremony；an opening / closing / award / graduation / wedding ceremony
advancedExpressions.example: The school held an opening ceremony, and later an award ceremony to honour top students. 学校举行了开幕式，后来又办了颁奖典礼表彰优秀学生。（'各类典礼'词块合集）

advancedExpressions.expression: ceremony(n.) → ceremonial(adj. 仪式的) / ceremonious(adj. 讲究礼节的) → ceremonially(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: The soldiers marched past in full ceremonial dress. 士兵们身着全套礼服列队走过。（ceremonial 修饰与典礼相关的事物）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the ceremony drew to a close, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the ceremony drew to a close, a hush settled over the crowd, and in that stillness Grandpa's whispered blessing seemed to echo louder than any applause. （时间状语引出静谧收尾 + 对比手法）

advancedExpressions.expression: you are cordially invited to attend the ... ceremony
advancedExpressions.example: You are cordially invited to attend the prize-giving ceremony, at which the achievements of our most dedicated students will be warmly celebrated. （cordially invited 正式邀请套语 + at which 定语从句）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being empty ceremony, ... embodies ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being empty ceremony, these age-old rites embody the wisdom, values and identity that bind a people together across generations. （Far from being...让步反驳 + embody 抽象名词升格）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The ceremony was very moving and I cried.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So moving was the ceremony that, before I even knew it, warm tears were tracing silent paths down my cheeks, and I made no attempt to wipe them away. （读后续写·情感+倒装）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: So + adj. 倒装(So moving was...) + before I knew it 时间副词状语 + 细节动作(tracing silent paths)代替直白"cried"

sentenceUpgrade.original: We invite you to come to the opening ceremony.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would give us immense pleasure if you could grace the opening ceremony of our science fair with your presence, an event we have prepared for with great care and enthusiasm. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would give us immense pleasure if...委婉虚拟 + grace...with your presence 高级敬语 + 同位语补充说明

classPractice.note: 课文原句；the wedding ceremony took place 婚礼仪式举行

classPractice.note: perform / hold a ceremony 举行/主持仪式

original_sentence: The wedding ceremony took place in a brightly decorated hotel room.
readingExamples: The wedding ceremony took place in a brightly decorated hotel room.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to make something look more attractive by adding ornaments, colour or beautiful objects to it
(2) v. to apply paint, wallpaper, etc. to the walls of a room or building
(3) v. to give someone a medal or an award as an official sign of honour, especially for bravery

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （把墙/房间）粉刷，油漆；装潢【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: The waiting room was decorated in light blue. 等候室被刷成了浅蓝色。（课件原句；be decorated in + 颜色，指'漆成/装潢成某色调'）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 授予（某人）勋章（以表彰英勇等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The young firefighter was decorated for the reckless courage he had shown carrying a child from the blazing building — a medal he insisted belonged to his whole team. （读后续写·英雄·荣誉）

posExamples.sentence: The children spent the whole afternoon decorating the classroom with paper lanterns and hand-drawn banners, their faces glowing with the pride of creating something beautiful together. （读后续写·校园·合作）
To welcome the Spring Festival, we plan to decorate the community hall with red couplets and lanterns, and we sincerely hope every resident will lend a hand. （应用文·倡议书/通知）
While some prefer to hire professionals to decorate, others argue that doing it yourself, however imperfect the result, brings a far deeper sense of belonging to a home. （议论文·生活方式）
Grandmother's hands, though wrinkled and slow, decorated each dumpling with tiny pleats so delicate that we could hardly bear to eat them. （读后续写·亲情·细节）

wordForms.noun: decoration (装饰；装饰物) / decorator (装饰工，室内设计师)
wordForms.adjective: decorative (装饰性的) / decorated (被装饰的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：decorate(v.) + -ion → decoration(n.)；+ -or → decorator(n. 人)；+ -ive → decorative(adj.)。搭配核心：decorate A with B 用B装饰A（=A be decorated with B）

collocations.example: He decorated his room with pictures of his favourite players. 他用自己最喜欢的球员的照片装饰房间。（课件原句；decorate A with B）
Traditional Chinese lanterns are often decorated with Chinese calligraphy and paintings, making them more impressive. 传统中国灯笼常以中国书法和绘画装饰，使其更令人印象深刻。（课件原句；A be decorated with B）
The waiting room was decorated in light blue. 等候室被刷成了浅蓝色。（课件原句；be decorated in + 颜色，表'漆成/装潢成某色调'）

collocations.translation: 装饰品（c/n 常用复数）；装饰、装潢；装饰风格（u/n）【课件】
collocations.example: Festive paper decorations had been hung from the ceiling. 节日的纸装饰品已经挂在天花板上。（课件原句；表'装饰物'时可数，多用复数）
The interior decoration follows a Chinese theme. 室内装潢采用了中式主题。（课件；此处 decoration 表'装潢/装饰风格'，不可数）
For practical and decorative purposes, the benches are usually painted. 出于实用和装饰的目的，这些长凳通常会上漆。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 装饰鲜艳的（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The wedding ceremony took place in a brightly decorated hotel room. 婚礼仪式在一间装饰鲜艳的酒店房间里举行。（课文原句；decorate 的过去分词作定语）
They decorated the hall with balloons and fresh flowers, transforming the plain room into a fairyland overnight. （读后续写·布置·转变）

collocations.translation: 装饰得很漂亮 / 鲜艳
collocations.example: The brightly decorated stalls lined both sides of the street, each one competing to draw the eyes of passing shoppers. （读后续写·集市·热闹）

collocations.translation: 布置房间 / 装修房子
collocations.example: After weeks of saving, the young couple finally had enough to decorate their first tiny apartment. （读后续写·奋斗·温情）
The whole village came together to decorate for the harvest festival, stringing golden corn along every doorway. （读后续写·社区·丰收）
The elaborately decorated float, glittering with thousands of tiny lights, drew gasps of wonder from the crowd. （读后续写·游行·惊叹）
He was decorated for bravery after single-handedly holding back the rising flood to save the trapped villagers. （读后续写·英雄事迹）
Every December the family gathered to decorate the Christmas tree, hanging ornaments that carried decades of memories. （读后续写·家庭·传统）

synonyms.example: Fresh jasmine adorned the bride's dark hair, filling the air around her with a sweet, lingering fragrance. （读后续写·人物·文学描写）
synonyms.usage: adorn 更书面、优雅，常用于人身或抽象美化；decorate 更中性、日常，泛指布置装饰

synonyms.example: Intricate carvings ornamented the ancient temple's every pillar. （议论文/说明·文化遗产）
synonyms.usage: ornament 作动词较正式且少用，强调用花纹图案点缀；decorate 使用范围最广，口笔语皆宜

synonyms.example: She embellished the plain scarf with hand-stitched flowers, turning a cheap gift into a treasure. （读后续写·巧手·用心）
synonyms.usage: embellish 强调添加细节使更精美，也可比喻夸大润色故事(embellish a story)；decorate 无"夸大"含义

advancedExpressions.expression: decorate A with B；brightly / beautifully / elaborately decorated；decorate for a festival
advancedExpressions.example: We decorated the classroom with lanterns and brightly decorated the door for the festival. 我们用灯笼装饰教室，还把门装点得鲜艳夺目迎接节日。（'装饰'主题词块）

advancedExpressions.expression: decorate(v.) → decoration(n. 装饰/装饰物) / decorator(n. 人) / decorative(adj. 装饰性的)
advancedExpressions.example: The festival decorations were designed by a famous decorator, each one bright and decorative. 节日装饰物出自一位著名装饰师之手，每件都鲜艳而富有装饰性。（一句串起词族）

advancedExpressions.expression: decorated from top to bottom with ...
advancedExpressions.example: The little shop, decorated from top to bottom with fairy lights and paper cranes, glowed like a lantern against the darkening street. （from top to bottom 夸张 + like a lantern 明喻，营造温暖画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: we warmly invite you to help decorate ...
advancedExpressions.example: We warmly invite every volunteer to help decorate the nursing home for the coming holiday, so that our elderly friends may feel the warmth of the whole community. （号召性动词 + so that 目的状语传递人文关怀）

advancedExpressions.expression: what truly decorates a life is not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What truly decorates a life is not the ornaments on one's walls, but the kindness in one's deeds and the courage in one's heart. （What 引导主语从句 + not...but... 对比升华，虚实转换）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They decorated the room and it looked nice.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By the time the last ribbon was tied, the once-bare room had been utterly transformed — draped in soft light and scattered with flowers, it now breathed a warmth that no words could fully capture. （读后续写·转变+拟人）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By the time...时间状语 + once-bare 对比 + 过去分词短语(draped, scattered)伴随 + breathe a warmth 拟人化

sentenceUpgrade.original: Please help us decorate the classroom.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We would be truly grateful if you could spare an hour or two to help us decorate the classroom, for many hands not only lighten the work but also weave stronger bonds among us. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: We would be grateful if...礼貌虚拟请求 + spare an hour or two 委婉 + for 引导原因升华 + not only...but also 递进

translation: （穿着、言语、行为等）适合正式场合的，正规的，庄重的
original_sentence: There were hundreds of guests, all dressed up in formal, colourful clothes.
readingExamples: There were hundreds of guests, all dressed up in formal, colourful clothes.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. suitable for or used on official, serious or public occasions; following accepted rules and conventions
(2) adj. (of language or behaviour) very correct and suitable for official or important situations, rather than relaxed and friendly
(3) adj. official and recognized; done according to proper procedures

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （几何/艺术上）形式的，注重外在形式的；对称规整的
uncommonMeanings.example: The mansion was fronted by a formal garden, its hedges clipped into such rigid symmetry that not a single leaf dared stray out of line. （读后续写·环境·规整之美）

posExamples.sentence: Dressed in a formal black suit for the first time in his life, the farmer's son stood stiffly at the interview door, his rough hands betraying a nervousness his calm face tried to hide. （读后续写·人物·紧张）
I would like to make a formal complaint about the poor quality of the goods I purchased last week, and I sincerely hope the matter can be settled at your earliest convenience. （应用文·投诉信）
While formal education equips us with knowledge and credentials, it is the informal lessons drawn from failure and friendship that shape our character most profoundly. （议论文·教育本质）
As the guests arrived in their formal evening wear, the ballroom shimmered with silk gowns and the polite murmur of well-rehearsed greetings. （读后续写·社交·场景）

wordForms.other: 反义词：informal (非正式的，随便的) —— in- 否定前缀。构词法：form(形式) + -al → formal；formal + -ity → formality；formal + -ize → formalize

collocations.example: There were hundreds of guests, all dressed up in formal, colourful clothes. 有数百位来宾，个个盛装打扮，穿着正式而鲜艳的服装。（课文原句）
He had never spoken at a formal occasion before, and his voice wavered as hundreds of expectant faces turned toward him. （读后续写·演讲·紧张）
The invitation stated that formal dress was required, sending half the guests into a last-minute panic over what to wear. （读后续写·社交·细节）
Though she had received little formal education, her wisdom, drawn from a lifetime of hardship, humbled everyone who met her. （读后续写/议论·智慧）
The company issued a formal apology and promised that such a mistake would never happen again. （应用文·公告）
A cover letter calls for formal language; slang and abbreviations can cost you the job before the interview even begins. （议论文/说明·写作建议）

collocations.translation: 使正式化，使成为正式安排
collocations.example: They had worked together for years, but signing the contract finally made the partnership formal. （记叙·程序）
After months of talks, the two nations at last reached a formal agreement to protect the shared river. （应用文/议论·合作）
In formal attire, the shy boy seemed to grow taller, standing prouder than anyone had ever seen him. （读后续写·蜕变）

synonyms.translation: 非正式的，随便的（反义词）
synonyms.example: The dinner was informal, so no one bothered with suits or ties. 晚餐是非正式的，因此没人费心穿西装打领带。
synonyms.usage: 反义辨析：formal 用于正式、庄重、合规的场合（formal clothes/occasion/language）；informal 用于轻松随意的场合（informal chat 随意聊天）。前缀 in- 表否定

synonyms.translation: 官方的，正式的（有权威认可的）
synonyms.example: The official results were announced at noon, and a roar of celebration rose from the waiting crowd. （读后续写·结果·欢庆）
synonyms.usage: official 强调由权威机构认可或发布；formal 强调符合正式规范与礼仪的形式，二者常搭配但侧重不同

synonyms.example: The ceremonial handshake between the two leaders was captured by cameras from around the world. （应用文·新闻）
synonyms.usage: ceremonial 特指与典礼仪式相关的、庄重的；formal 泛指一切正式、庄重、合规的场合或风格

synonyms.example: A solemn silence fell over the memorial hall as the veterans bowed their heads. （读后续写·纪念·庄重）
synonyms.usage: solemn 强调严肃、庄重的情感氛围；formal 侧重形式上的规范正式，未必带强烈情感

advancedExpressions.expression: formal clothes / dress / wear / attire；a formal occasion / apology / complaint / agreement；formal education / language
advancedExpressions.example: Dressed in formal wear, he made a formal apology at the formal ceremony. 他身着正装，在正式仪式上郑重道歉。（'正式'搭配一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.expression: formal(正式的) ↔ informal(非正式的)；formal → formality(n.) / formally(adv.) / formalize(v.)
advancedExpressions.example: What began as an informal chat gradually turned into a formal negotiation. 起初的随意闲聊渐渐变成了正式谈判。（formal 与 informal 对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath the formal exterior lay ...
advancedExpressions.example: Beneath the formal exterior of the stern headmaster lay a gentle heart that ached for every struggling child in his care. （倒装 Beneath...lay + 表里对比，塑造立体人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to make a formal request that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to make a formal request that the school library extend its opening hours, a change that would greatly benefit students preparing for exams. （make a formal request that + 虚拟语气宾语从句，公文体）

advancedExpressions.expression: formal ... is necessary but not sufficient
advancedExpressions.example: Formal qualifications may open the door to an interview, but they are necessary rather than sufficient; it is character and adaptability that ultimately secure the job. （necessary but not sufficient 辩证框架 + it is...that 强调）

translation: 传统，传统的信仰（或风俗）
original_sentence: According to tradition, the bride was wearing an eye-catching red silk sari.
readingExamples: According to tradition, the bride was wearing an eye-catching red silk sari.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a belief, custom or way of doing something that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people
(2) n. the passing on of such beliefs and customs from one generation to the next
(3) n. an established artistic, literary or intellectual style that a group of people follow or have followed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （艺术、文学、思想上的）流派，传统风格
uncommonMeanings.example: Trained in the great tradition of Chinese landscape painting, the young artist could summon whole mountains from a few strokes of ink. （读后续写·艺术·传承）

posExamples.sentence: Every Lunar New Year, in keeping with a tradition older than anyone could remember, Grandma would wake before dawn to make dumplings, folding into each one a wish for the year ahead. （读后续写·家庭·文化）
To help exchange students appreciate Chinese culture, our club will hold a workshop introducing the tradition of paper-cutting, and all are warmly welcome to join. （应用文·活动通知）
Some dismiss tradition as a chain that binds us to the past, yet without it we would drift like leaves in the wind, cut off from the roots that give our lives meaning and identity. （议论文·传统与现代）
It had long been a tradition in the village that the eldest son would carry the lantern at the head of the funeral procession, and now that solemn duty fell to Ming. （读后续写·习俗·责任）

wordForms.other: traditionalist (传统主义者)。构词法：tradition + -al → traditional；+ -ly → traditionally。高频搭配：according to tradition / by tradition 按照传统

collocations.translation: 按照传统（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: According to tradition, the bride was wearing an eye-catching red silk sari. 按照传统，新娘身穿一件抢眼的红色丝绸莎丽。（课文原句）
The school has a long tradition of helping students in need. 这所学校有帮助贫困学生的悠久传统。
By tradition, the eldest son lights the first lantern of the festival. 按照传统，长子点燃节日的第一盏灯笼。
Planting a tree on one's birthday was a long-standing tradition in the family, a living record of every year that had passed. （读后续写·家庭·象征）

collocations.phrase: carry on / keep up a tradition
collocations.example: Determined to carry on the tradition his grandfather had begun, he reopened the old tea house that everyone else had given up on. （读后续写·传承·坚守）
By choosing to become a nurse rather than a soldier, she broke with a family tradition that stretched back four generations. （读后续写·抉择·突破）
Sharing these cultural traditions with foreign friends filled her with a quiet, unexpected pride. （应用文·文化交流）

collocations.translation: 传统深厚的，富有传统底蕴的
collocations.example: The ancient town, rich in tradition, drew travellers eager to glimpse a way of life that time seemed to have forgotten. （议论文/读后续写·文化）

collocations.phrase: pass on / hand down a tradition
collocations.example: These stories, handed down as a treasured tradition, kept the memory of their ancestors alive in every child's heart. （读后续写·记忆·传承）
We should not only enjoy the fruits of progress but also preserve the traditions that give our culture its unique soul. （议论文·文化保护）

synonyms.example: It was the local custom to greet strangers with a bowl of hot tea, no matter how poor the household. （读后续写·风俗·好客）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：custom 指某群体普遍遵循的具体习惯做法，范围较窄（a local custom 当地风俗）；tradition 更强调世代相传、承载文化意义的信念与习俗

synonyms.example: Defying convention, she wore a bright red dress to the solemn gathering, and every head turned. （读后续写·个性·反叛）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：convention 侧重被普遍接受的行为规范或惯例，语气中性；tradition 侧重历史悠久、带情感与文化归属的传承

synonyms.translation: 遗产，传统（尤指文化/历史遗产）
synonyms.example: The crumbling temple was part of a heritage that belonged not to one town, but to all humanity. （议论文·文化遗产）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：heritage 指前人留下的（尤指珍贵的）文化、历史或自然遗产，静态名词；tradition 强调持续实践、代代相传的过程

advancedExpressions.expression: according to tradition / by tradition 按照传统；a long / long-standing tradition；carry on / preserve / break with tradition
advancedExpressions.example: According to tradition, the family carries on the custom every year, and no one dares break with it. 按照传统，这家人每年都延续这一习俗，无人敢打破。（'传统'搭配合集）

advancedExpressions.expression: tradition(n.) → traditional(adj. 传统的) → traditionally(adv. 传统上)
advancedExpressions.example: Traditionally, families reunite for a traditional feast on New Year's Eve. 传统上，家家户户会在除夕团聚共享一顿传统盛宴。（词族串句）

advancedExpressions.expression: steeped in tradition, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Steeped in tradition yet unafraid of change, the old craftsman taught his apprentice not merely how to carve, but why the work mattered. （过去分词短语开头 + yet 让步，塑造有深度的人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a time-honoured tradition, ... reflects ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a time-honoured tradition, the Dragon Boat Festival reflects our deep respect for loyalty and courage, values that still guide us today. （time-honoured 高级形容词 + reflect 抽象升格，文化说明文体）

advancedExpressions.expression: tradition need not be at odds with ...; rather, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Tradition need not be at odds with innovation; rather, the wisest societies are those that plant new ideas in the rich soil of the past. （need not be at odds with 辩证 + rather 转折 + 隐喻(rich soil of the past)）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It is a tradition to eat dumplings at New Year.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Eating dumplings at New Year is no ordinary meal but a cherished tradition, one in which the warmth of gathered hands and the hope for the year ahead are folded, quite literally, into every fragile parcel of dough. （读后续写·文化+双关）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: no ordinary...but... 强调对比 + 同位语(one in which...) + folded...literally 双关(实指包饺子/虚指寄托情感)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect our traditions.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is incumbent upon our generation to safeguard the traditions we have inherited, for a people that forgets where it comes from can never be certain of where it is going. （议论文·文化责任）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is incumbent upon...正式"有责任" + safeguard 高级动词 + for 引导原因 + where it comes from/where it is going 对仗升华

In some cultures the bride is expected to leave her family and adopt her husband's, a custom that many now question as society moves toward greater equality between partners. （议论文·社会习俗）
As the bride knelt to touch her grandmother's feet in a gesture of respect, tears slipped quietly down the old woman's cheeks, tracing the joys and losses of a long life. （读后续写·亲情·文化细节）

wordForms.noun: bride / bridegroom (新郎) / bridesmaid (伴娘) / groom (新郎)

translation: 惹人注意的，引人注目的
original_sentence: According to tradition, the bride was wearing an eye-catching red silk sari.
readingExamples: According to tradition, the bride was wearing an eye-catching red silk sari.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. attracting your attention immediately because of being unusual, bright, striking, or interesting
(2) adj. (of a design, advertisement, or performance) noticeable in a way that pleases the eye and stands out from its surroundings

posExamples.sentence: The moment I turned the corner, an eye-catching mural sprawled across the crumbling wall — a riot of gold and crimson that seemed to breathe life back into the forgotten alley. （读后续写·环境描写·惊艳一瞥）
To make our charity sale a success, I suggest that we design a few eye-catching posters and put them up where students gather most, so that no passer-by can possibly miss the event. （应用文·建议信·活动宣传）
While an eye-catching headline may lure readers in, it is the substance behind it that determines whether an article earns their lasting respect. （议论文·媒体与阅读）

wordForms.other: 构词法·合成词：eye(眼睛) + catch(抓住) 的现在分词 catching → eye-catching = '抓住眼球的' → 引人注目的。同类合成形容词：good-looking 好看的 / hard-working 勤奋的 / time-consuming 耗时的（名词/副词 + 现在分词）。同源短语 catch sb's eye 引起某人注意

idioms.translation: 引起某人注意；吸引某人目光
idioms.example: It was a single lantern glowing in the darkened window that first caught my eye, drawing me irresistibly toward the little shop. （读后续写·环境·被吸引）

collocations.translation: 抢眼的红色丝绸莎丽（课文原句词块）

The team spent a whole night refining an eye-catching design for the festival banner, determined to make it the talk of the campus. （应用文·活动方案）

(4) adj. (chiefly used before a noun) specially made for a particular customer; custom-made

wordForms.adjective: impressive (给人深刻印象的) / impressed (印象深刻的·修饰人) / impressionable (易受影响的)
wordForms.other: impressionism (n. 印象派)；辨析：be impressed by/with sth（人对……印象深）↔ sth is impressive（事物令人印象深刻）；impress sb with sth 以……给某人留下印象

idioms.example: I had been under the impression that the exam was next week, and my heart nearly stopped when I saw the crowd already filing into the hall. （读后续写·误会·情节紧张）

idioms.idiom: make a good / bad impression (on sb.)
idioms.example: Eager to make a good impression on his new classmates, he arrived half an hour early and offered to help arrange the desks. （读后续写·新环境·人物动机）

collocations.phrase: make / leave an impression on sb
collocations.translation: 给某人留下（……的）印象【课件】
collocations.example: The terrible earthquake left a lasting impression on all survivors. 那场可怕的地震给所有幸存者留下了持久的印象。（课件汉译英原句；make/leave an impression on sb）
She gives the impression of being very busy. 她给人的印象是特别忙。（课件原句；give sb the impression of doing sth）

collocations.phrase: get a good / bad impression of sb
collocations.translation: 对某人的印象好/不好【课件】
collocations.example: You made a favourable impression on the interviewer. 你给面试官留下了很好的印象。（课件汉译英原句；get a good/favourable impression of sb）
I was under the impression that they were unhappy with the situation. 我原以为他们对现状不满意。（课件原句；be under the impression that + 从句）

collocations.translation: 对某人没有效果/影响【课件】
collocations.example: My words made no impression on the boy. 我的话对那个男孩不起作用。（课件原句；make no impression on sb 对某人没有效果）

collocations.phrase: make a deep impression on sb.
collocations.translation: 给某人留下深刻印象（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I did not understand all of the traditional customs, but a few made a deep impression on me. 我并不理解所有的传统习俗，但有几个给我留下了深刻印象。（课文原句）
You never get a second chance to make a first impression, so I dressed neatly and rehearsed my opening lines the night before the interview. （应用文/记叙·面试）

collocations.phrase: make / leave a deep impression on sb.
collocations.example: The volunteer's tireless smile, even after twelve hours on her feet, left a deep impression on everyone at the shelter. （读后续写·志愿服务）
The exchange programme made a lasting impression on me and reshaped the way I see the wider world. （应用文·活动感悟）
The tidy classroom and the students' bright greetings created an impression of a school where everyone truly belonged. （读后续写·参观印象）
From the way she avoided my eyes, I got the impression that something was troubling her deeply. （读后续写·察言观色）
He walked in slowly, giving the impression of calm, though inside his heart was pounding like a drum. （读后续写·内外反差）
A single edited photo can create a false impression that spreads across the internet before the truth ever catches up. （议论文·网络与真相）

synonyms.example: The old teacher's parting words had a profound impact on the boy, echoing in his mind for years to come. （读后续写·师恩）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析①：指强烈而具体的作用或后果，强调'撞击式'的深远影响，程度重；典型搭配 have an impact on；impression 侧重留在心中的感受或印象，更主观、更内在

synonyms.example: I had a strange feeling that we had met somewhere before, though I could not say where. （读后续写·似曾相识）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析②：泛指内心朦胧的感受、直觉，比 impression 更主观、更不确定，常指一时的念头；impression 更强调由感官或经历直接形成的整体印象

synonyms.example: The film challenged my simple notion that heroes are always fearless. （议论文·观念修正）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析③：指一个想法或观念，偏理性、抽象；impression 更强调由感官或经历直接形成的整体感受，偏感性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·impress 用法（impress sb with / be impressed by / impressive）
advancedExpressions.expression: impress sb with sth（以……给某人留下深刻好印象）↔ be impressed by/with sth（人对……钦佩/印象深）↔ be impressive（事物令人印象深刻）
advancedExpressions.example: She impressed the judges with her fluent English. = The judges were impressed by her fluent English. = Her fluent English was impressive. 她流利的英语给评委留下了深刻印象。【课件】（同一意思三种表达，作文换句必备）

advancedExpressions.expression: make / leave a deep impression on sb / a first (lasting, favourable) impression / be under the impression that ... / get (have) the impression that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The kindness of the locals left a lasting impression on every visitor. 当地人的善良给每位游客都留下了持久的印象。（枚举可替换的高频搭配，'留下印象'固定介词用 on sb）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'留下印象/影响'
advancedExpressions.expression: make an impression on sb ≈ have an impact / effect / influence on sb ≈ leave a mark on sb
advancedExpressions.example: The trip made a deep impression on me. = The trip had a profound impact on me. 这次旅行给我留下了深刻印象/深远影响。（表'对某人产生影响'时可替换，注意介词都用 on sb）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·impress 与 impression 转换
advancedExpressions.expression: sb be impressed by/with sth（人受触动）↔ sth make an impression on sb（事物给人印象）↔ sth be impressive（事物令人印象深刻）
advancedExpressions.example: I was deeply impressed by the ceremony. = The ceremony made a deep impression on me. = The ceremony was impressive. 仪式给我留下了深刻印象。（同一意思三种表达，作文换句必备）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... left an impression on me that time could never erase
advancedExpressions.example: The sight of my mother waving in the rain until the train vanished left an impression on me that time could never erase. （用定语从句 that time could never erase 强化情感的永恒性，适合续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... made such a favourable impression that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Your warm hospitality made such a favourable impression that I have already recommended your programme to all my friends back home. （such ... that 结果状语，自然引出正向反馈，适用于感谢信）

advancedExpressions.expression: while first impressions may ..., it is ... that truly ...
advancedExpressions.example: While first impressions may open or close a door in an instant, it is sustained integrity, not a polished surface, that truly earns lasting respect. （while 让步 + it is ... that 强调句，辩证论证第一印象的局限）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The kind stranger gave me a deep impression.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The kindness of that ragged stranger, who pressed his last coin into the beggar's palm and walked on without a word, left an impression so deep that it has quietly reshaped the way I treat everyone I meet. （读后续写·善意的力量）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 非限制性定语从句(who pressed...) + 'so deep that' 结果状语 + 结尾抽象升华(reshaped the way I treat everyone) 由事及理

sentenceUpgrade.original: The city gave me a good impression.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From the spotless streets to the ready smiles of strangers, the city made an impression on me so favourable that, even now, months later, I find my thoughts drifting back to its lamplit evenings. （应用文·感谢信/游记）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'From ... to ...' 排比铺陈细节 + 'so favourable that' 结果状语 + 插入语(even now, months later)增强真实感与情感余韵

classPractice.question: 这次大地震给所有的幸存者留下了持久的印象。The terrible earthquake ____ .
classPractice.answer: left a lasting impression on all survivors
classPractice.note: 课件汉译英原题；make/leave an impression on sb，介词固定用 on

classPractice.question: 你给面试官留下了很好的印象。
classPractice.answer: You made a favourable impression on the interviewer.
classPractice.note: 课件汉译英原题；make a favourable impression on sb 给某人留下良好印象

classPractice.question: 我明显觉得我们在这里是不受欢迎的。
classPractice.answer: I get the distinct impression that we're not welcomed here.
classPractice.note: 课件汉译英原题；get the impression that... 觉得、产生……的印象，distinct 明显的（注：welcomed 为课件原文，作过去分词'受到欢迎'；若用形容词表'受欢迎的'则为 we're not welcome here）

classPractice.question: We were all ____ (impress) by her intelligence.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；be impressed by/with sth 对……印象深刻（人作主语，用 impressed）

classPractice.question: 有几个习俗给我留下了深刻的印象。A few customs ____ a deep ____ ____ me.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；make a deep impression on sb 给某人留下深刻印象，介词固定用 on

classPractice.question: Everyone was under the ____ (impress) that the shy newcomer was proud, until he saved a classmate from drowning.
classPractice.note: be under the impression that... 以为、误以为；此处需名词 impression

classPractice.question: I was deeply impressed by the wedding ceremony. → The wedding ceremony ____ a deep ____ ____ me.
classPractice.note: be impressed by sth = sth make/leave a deep impression on sb，impress↔impression 转换

classPractice.question: impressive / impressed —— The performance was so ____ that the whole audience was ____.
classPractice.note: impressive 修饰事物'令人印象深刻'；impressed 修饰人'感到印象深刻'

original_sentence: One was the bridegroom's entrance on a beautiful white horse.
readingExamples: One was the bridegroom's entrance on a beautiful white horse.
definitionEn: (1) n. a man on his wedding day, or one who is just about to be married (often shortened to groom)

posExamples.sentence: The bridegroom stood at the altar, straightening his tie for the hundredth time, and the instant the doors opened and his bride appeared, every trace of nervousness melted from his face. （读后续写·婚礼·情感瞬间）
As chief organiser, I would like to remind guests that the bridegroom and his family will greet everyone at the entrance, so please arrive a little early to share in the joy. （应用文·婚礼通知/邀请）
A wedding is not the bridegroom's day alone, nor the bride's; it is a solemn promise in which two families, and two ways of life, quietly become one. （议论文·婚姻的意义）

wordForms.noun: bridegroom / groom (新郎) / bride (新娘) / bridesmaid (伴娘) / groomsman / best man (伴郎)
wordForms.other: 构词法·合成词：bride(新娘) + groom(古义'男仆/侍从'→引申为新郎) → bridegroom；婚礼词族速记：bride 新娘 / bridegroom(=groom) 新郎 / bridesmaid 伴娘 / best man 伴郎 / newlyweds 新婚夫妇

collocations.translation: 新郎的出场/入场（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: One was the bridegroom's entrance on a beautiful white horse. 其中一个是新郎骑着一匹漂亮的白马出场。（课文原句）
The whole hall rose to its feet as the bride and bridegroom walked in, and a shower of rose petals filled the air. （读后续写·婚礼高潮）
When the best man rose to toast the bridegroom, his voice cracked with emotion, and there was hardly a dry eye in the room. （读后续写·祝酒·感人）
The nervous bridegroom fumbled with the ring, and a gentle wave of laughter rippled warmly through the guests. （读后续写·婚礼小插曲）
According to local tradition, the bridegroom's family arrives first to welcome the guests with tea and sweets. （应用文·风俗介绍）

synonyms.example: The groom lifted the veil with trembling hands, and for a heartbeat the whole world seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·婚礼·特写）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：groom 是 bridegroom 的日常口语简称，含义完全相同，现代英语中更常用；bridegroom 略显正式、传统。注意 groom 另有'马夫、给马刷洗'之义，需看语境

advancedExpressions.expression: bridegroom = groom（口语更常用）
advancedExpressions.example: The groom (= bridegroom) waited nervously at the altar. 新郎在圣坛前紧张地等待着。（完全可替换，口语/现代英语多用 groom，正式文体多用 bridegroom）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词与婚礼词族
advancedExpressions.expression: bride 新娘 + groom → bridegroom 新郎 / bridesmaid 伴娘 / best man 伴郎 / newlyweds 新人
advancedExpressions.example: The bride and bridegroom exchanged rings while the bridesmaids looked on with tears in their eyes. 新娘和新郎交换戒指，伴娘们含泪注视着。（合成词构词，整组婚礼词汇一起记）

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment the bridegroom ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the bridegroom caught sight of his bride, the noisy hall seemed to fall silent, and time itself appeared to slow to a heartbeat. （The moment 引导时间状语从句 + 侧面烘托 fall silent，定格婚礼最动人的一刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: on behalf of the bride and bridegroom, we cordially invite ...
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of the bride and bridegroom, we cordially invite you to share in the joy of their union this coming Saturday. （On behalf of ... 正式邀请句式，适合婚礼请柬/通知）

advancedExpressions.expression: for both bride and bridegroom, ... means not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: For both bride and bridegroom, marriage means not the end of freedom but the beginning of a shared responsibility that will test and enrich them for life. （not ... but ... 对比结构，纠正片面认知，论证婚姻的真义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bridegroom was very happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The bridegroom's face lit up with a joy he made no attempt to hide, and as his eyes met his bride's across the crowded hall, the years of waiting seemed to dissolve into that single, radiant instant. （读后续写·情感特写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'face lit up with' 具象化情感 + 定语从句(he made no attempt to hide) + 时间状语从句(as his eyes met) + 抽象升华(dissolve into that single instant)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bridegroom came in on a white horse.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Amid a burst of drums and cheering, the bridegroom made his entrance on a snow-white horse, sitting tall and beaming, as though the whole world had been arranged for this one shining moment. （读后续写·出场·渲染）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'Amid + 名词' 状语渲染氛围 + 用词升级(made his entrance / snow-white) + 独立分词(sitting tall and beaming) + as though 引导夸张状语从句

classPractice.question: 其中一个精彩之处是新郎骑着一匹漂亮的白马出场。One was the ____ entrance on a beautiful white horse.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；bridegroom 新郎，此处用名词所有格 bridegroom's 修饰 entrance

classPractice.question: bride / bridegroom / bridesmaid —— At the wedding, the ____ wore a white gown, the ____ a dark suit, and the ____ helped carry her long train.
classPractice.note: 婚礼词族辨析：新娘 bride / 新郎 bridegroom / 伴娘 bridesmaid

classPractice.question: The bridegroom looked nervous at the altar. →（用简称改写）The ____ looked nervous at the altar.
classPractice.note: groom 是 bridegroom 的常用简称，含义完全相同

translation: 进入，出场；入口；进入权；准许加入
original_sentence: One was the bridegroom's entrance on a beautiful white horse.
readingExamples: One was the bridegroom's entrance on a beautiful white horse.
definitionEn:
(1) n. /ˈentrəns/ a door, gate, or opening through which you enter a place
(2) n. /ˈentrəns/ the act of coming or going into a place, especially in a dramatic or noticeable way
(3) n. /ˈentrəns/ the right or permission to enter a place, an institution, or a profession
(4) v. /ɪnˈtrɑːns/ to fill someone with wonder and delight so that they give you all their attention; to enchant

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （重音移位，读作 /ɪnˈtrɑːns/）使入迷，使着迷，使狂喜（对比名词 /ˈentrəns/）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old sailor's tales entranced the children so completely that not one of them noticed the tide creeping up over their bare feet. （读后续写·故事的魔力·被深深吸引）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 入场权，准许入内；(考试等的)录取资格
uncommonMeanings.example: Years of quiet, stubborn study had finally won her entrance to the university her mother could only ever dream of. （读后续写·寒门苦读·梦想成真）

posExamples.sentence: She paused at the entrance of the crowded hall, her heart hammering, then lifted her chin and stepped inside as though she had every right to be there. （读后续写·鼓起勇气·登场）
For safety reasons, all visitors are kindly asked to use the main entrance and to register at the front desk before proceeding into the building. （应用文·通知/须知）
One was the bridegroom's entrance on a beautiful white horse. （读后续写·印度婚礼·出场）
Standing before the waterfall for the first time, I was so entranced by its thunder and mist that I forgot the long, exhausting climb that had brought me there. （读后续写·自然奇观·忘我）

wordForms.noun: entrance (入口/出场) / entry (进入/词条) / entrant (参赛者/新加入者)
wordForms.other: 重音移位·一词双读：名词 entrance /ˈentrəns/(入口/出场，重音在前) vs 动词 entrance /ɪnˈtrɑːns/(使入迷，重音在后)；构词：enter(v.进入) + -ance → entrance(n.)

idioms.translation: 隆重登场；引人注目地出场
idioms.example: She knew how to make an entrance: the doors swung open, the music swelled, and every head in the ballroom turned as one. （读后续写·华丽登场）

collocations.example: We were told to wait at the entrance to the museum. 我们被告知在博物馆入口处等候。（课件原句；at the entrance to the museum = the museum entrance）

collocations.translation: 入场，登场（单数可数名词）【课件】
collocations.example: She made her entrance after all the other guests had arrived. 她在其他所有客人都到达后才入场。（课件原句；make one's entrance 入场/登场）

collocations.translation: 获得进入权，得以进入（不可数）【课件】
collocations.example: The police were unable to gain entrance to the house. 警方未能获准进入这栋房子。（课件原句；gain entrance to 进入权）
Visitors have to pay an entrance fee to see the exhibition. 参观者需支付入场费才能看展览。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: make a dramatic entrance into (a market)
collocations.translation: 戏剧性地打入（市场）【课件】
collocations.example: The company made a dramatic entrance into the export market. 这家公司戏剧性地打入了出口市场。（课件原句；戏剧性打入市场）
A lighthouse marks the entrance to the harbour. 灯塔是海港入口的标志。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 新郎的出场/入场（课文原句词块，此处 entrance 作'出场'）
collocations.example: One was the bridegroom's entrance on a beautiful white horse. 其中一个是新郎骑着一匹漂亮的白马出场。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 隆重登场；引人注目地出场
collocations.example: She knew how to make an entrance: the doors swung open, the music swelled, and every head in the ballroom turned as one. （读后续写·华丽登场）
The night before the entrance examination, she lay awake, her mind replaying every formula she had ever learned. （读后续写·考前之夜）
We agreed to meet at the main entrance of the museum at nine sharp, and I arrived early, too excited to sit still. （读后续写·相约·期待）
A shivering puppy sat at the entrance to the shop, and something in its pleading eyes made me stop dead in my tracks. （读后续写·街头偶遇）
After months of relentless effort, he finally gained entrance to the school of his dreams. （读后续写·奋斗有成）
A fallen tree blocked the entrance to the lane, forcing us to abandon the car and continue on foot through the storm. （读后续写·突发状况）
To avoid the waiting reporters, the star slipped out through a side entrance and vanished into the night. （读后续写·躲避·情节）
After months of relentless effort, he finally gained entrance to the school of his dreams. （读后续写·奋斗有成）

synonyms.example: The guard checked our names before granting us entry to the restricted area. （记叙·情节）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析①：entry 更强调'进入'这一动作或权利（No entry 禁止入内），也可指日记条目、词典词条、参赛作品；entrance 更常指具体的门/入口以及'出场'这一场面

synonyms.example: He lingered in the doorway, unwilling to step into a room that held so many painful memories. （读后续写·心理·迟疑）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析②：doorway 特指门框所在的那个具体开口，范围窄；entrance 可泛指任何供人进入的通道或入口区域，也可指'出场'

synonyms.translation: 使着迷，使倾心（与 entrance 作动词时义近）
synonyms.example: The young violinist captivated the entire audience, drawing them into a world woven of pure sound. （读后续写·艺术感染力）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析③：captivate 与 entrance(vt.) 都表'深深吸引'，captivate 更常用、语气略中性；entrance(vt./ɪnˈtrɑːns/) 更强调如入梦境般的忘我与陶醉

advancedExpressions.expression: make an entrance(隆重登场) / at the entrance to(在……入口) / the main(side, back) entrance / an entrance examination(入学考试) / gain entrance to(获准进入)
advancedExpressions.example: Candidates must show their ID at the main entrance before the entrance examination begins. 考生须在正门口出示身份证，入学考试才开始。（枚举可替换的高频搭配，'入口'介词多用 to/of）

advancedExpressions.expression: entrance ≈ entry ≈ way in ≈ doorway（入口）；make an entrance ≈ come in dramatically（隆重登场）
advancedExpressions.example: The way in (= entrance / entry) was blocked by the crowd. 入口被人群堵住了。（表'入口'时可替换，注意 entry 也可指'词条/参赛作品'）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·重音移位辨双读
advancedExpressions.expression: 名词 ˈentrance /ˈentrəns/(入口/出场) ↔ 动词 enˈtrance /ɪnˈtrɑːns/(使入迷)，重音前移→后移，词义随之改变
advancedExpressions.example: Her grand entrance /ˈentrəns/ entranced /ɪnˈtrɑːns/ the whole audience. 她盛大的出场使全场观众都入了迷。（同一拼写、重音不同则词性词义不同，高考听力/词汇易考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had sb. made an entrance than ...
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had the old professor made his entrance than the restless lecture hall fell into a respectful, expectant hush. （no sooner ... than 倒装，制造'一……就……'的戏剧节奏，突出人物气场）

advancedExpressions.expression: guests are kindly requested to ... at the entrance
advancedExpressions.example: Guests are kindly requested to show their invitation cards at the entrance and to switch their phones to silent before the ceremony begins. （被动礼貌句式，符合通知/须知的正式文体）

advancedExpressions.type: 议论文/记叙·被吸引（entrance vt.）
advancedExpressions.expression: so entranced was sb. by ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: So entranced was the boy by the dancing flames that he lost all sense of time, and the night slipped away unnoticed. （so + 过去分词提前的倒装，强化'入迷到忘我'的程度，画面感极强）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He came into the room and everyone looked at him.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant he made his entrance, a hush swept through the room and every eye turned toward him, as though the very air had been waiting for his arrival. （读后续写·登场·气场）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'made his entrance' 名词化升级 + The instant 引导时间状语 + 侧面烘托(a hush swept) + as though 夸张状语从句渲染气场

sentenceUpgrade.original: The music was so beautiful that I forgot everything.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So entranced was I by the haunting melody drifting across the lake that the world around me dissolved, leaving only the music and the fading gold of the setting sun. （读后续写·陶醉·环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 熟词僻义 entrance(vt.) 入迷义 + so + 过去分词提前的倒装 + 现在分词后置(drifting) + 独立结构收束(leaving only...)营造余韵

classPractice.question: 我们在博物馆入口处等候。We waited ____ the entrance ____ the museum.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；at the entrance to a place 在……的入口处（介词 to）

classPractice.question: 她在其他所有客人都到达后才入场。She ____ ____ ____ after all the other guests had arrived.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；make one's entrance 入场、登场，entrance 此处作单数可数名词

classPractice.question: 警方未能获准进入这栋房子。The police were unable to ____ ____ ____ the house.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；gain entrance to 获得进入权/得以进入，entrance 此处不可数

classPractice.question: 这家公司戏剧性地打入了出口市场。The company ____ a dramatic ____ ____ the export market.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；make a dramatic entrance into (a market) 戏剧性地打入市场

classPractice.question: 其中一个是新郎骑着一匹漂亮的白马出场。One was the bridegroom's ____ on a beautiful white horse.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处 entrance 作名词'出场、入场'，读 /ˈentrəns/

classPractice.question: So ____ (entrance) was the boy by the waterfall that he forgot the long, tiring climb.
classPractice.note: entrance 作动词 /ɪnˈtrɑːns/ '使入迷'，此处 be entranced by 被……迷住；so + 过分提前构成倒装

classPractice.question: entrance / entry —— The dictionary ____ was too brief, and a guard stopped us at the ____ to the hall.
classPractice.note: 词典'词条'用 entry；具体的'入口/大门'用 entrance

classPractice.question: She worked day and night to gain ____ (entrance / doorway) to her dream university.
classPractice.note: gain entrance to '获准进入/被录取'；doorway 仅指门框那个开口，不表'录取资格'

original_sentence: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary.
readingExamples: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary.
definitionEn:
(1) phrase. not at all; the complete opposite of the quality mentioned
(2) phrase. used to emphasize that something is definitely not a particular thing
(3) phrase. (in the pattern 'anything but + noun') everything except the thing named

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 除……之外的任何东西（字面义，非强调否定，anything but + 名词）
uncommonMeanings.example: Exhausted after the twelve-hour march, the soldiers would have welcomed anything but another sleepless night on the frozen ground. （读后续写·战争·疲惫）

posExamples.sentence: When Grandpa finally handed me the yellowed diary, his hands were anything but steady; each tremble seemed to carry the weight of the sixty years he had guarded that secret. （读后续写·亲情·物件传递）
I must stress that the road ahead for our volunteer team will be anything but smooth, yet I firmly believe that shared determination will carry us through every obstacle. （应用文·招募信）
The claim that success comes effortlessly to the talented is anything but true; behind every celebrated achievement lie countless hours of unseen, unglamorous toil. （议论文·成功与努力）
The old fisherman's welcome was anything but warm at first — he eyed the city boy with folded arms and a silence that spoke louder than any refusal. （读后续写·人物初遇·冷淡）

wordForms.other: 易混辨析·anything but vs nothing but：anything but = not at all 根本不（The trip was anything but relaxing 一点也不轻松）；nothing but = only 只不过、仅仅（He eats nothing but junk food 他只吃垃圾食品）；all but = almost 几乎（The task is all but finished 几乎完成）

collocations.phrase: anything but + adj./n. (= not at all)
collocations.translation: 决不，根本不（=一点也不）【课件】
collocations.example: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary. 随后的那些习俗一点也不寻常。（课文原句；anything but = not at all / definitely not）

collocations.phrase: be anything but satisfactory / a success
collocations.translation: 根本不令人满意 / 绝非成功【课件】
collocations.example: The hotel was anything but satisfactory. 这家旅馆根本不令人满意。The party was anything but a success. 那场聚会根本算不上成功。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 一点也不累人 / 一点也不轻松【课件】
collocations.example: The trip is anything but tiring. On the contrary, I enjoyed it. 这趟旅行一点也不累人，恰恰相反，我很享受。My vacation was anything but relaxing, for my hotel was being built. 我的假期一点也不轻松，因为我住的旅馆正在施工。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 仅仅，只不过（对比项）【课件】
collocations.example: He's nothing but a criminal. 他只不过是个罪犯。He dreams of nothing but going home. 他一心只想着回家。（课件·拓展对比；nothing but = only）

collocations.translation: 几乎，差不多（对比项）【课件】
collocations.example: The party was all but over when we arrived. 我们到时聚会几乎已经结束了。It was all but impossible to climb back into the boat. 几乎不可能再爬回船上。（课件·拓展对比；all but = almost）

collocations.translation: 绝不寻常，非同凡响（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary. 随后的习俗一点也不寻常。（课文原句）
Learning to forgive the man who had wronged her was anything but easy, and every morning she had to choose it all over again. （读后续写·宽恕·成长）

collocations.translation: 极为不悦，一点也不高兴
collocations.example: My father was anything but pleased when he saw the shattered vase, yet instead of shouting he simply asked, in a voice heavy with disappointment, what I had learned. （读后续写·亲子·反思）
The math problem looked innocent on the page, but its solution proved to be anything but simple, demanding three sheets of scrap paper and an hour of stubborn effort. （读后续写·学业·挑战）
What seemed a hopeless detour proved to be anything but a waste of time, for it led us straight to the discovery that changed everything. （读后续写·转折）
Standing backstage before three hundred strangers, I felt anything but confident, my carefully rehearsed lines dissolving into a blur of nerves. （读后续写·演讲·紧张）
The trembling rookie was anything but a coward; he simply feared the wrong things until the day the fire taught him what real courage meant. （读后续写·人物成长·勇气）

collocations.translation: 根本不……，绝非……（= not at all）
collocations.example: The exam was anything but easy; half the class left the hall in silence. 这场考试根本不容易，一半同学都默默地走出了考场。

synonyms.example: The task was not at all as simple as it had first appeared. 这项任务根本不像最初看上去那么简单。
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析①：not at all 是最直白的程度否定，口语书面皆宜；anything but 语气更生动、强调'恰恰相反'的反差感，后可接形容词或名词，续写制造张力更佳

synonyms.example: The task is by no means impossible; with patience and teamwork, every one of us can master it. （议论文·观点论证）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析②：by no means 语气正式、书面，直接置于系动词或助动词后作程度否定，置句首要倒装；anything but 更口语生动，后接形容词或名词，强调'恰恰相反'

synonyms.example: Far from being discouraged by the setback, she rolled up her sleeves and started again. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：far from 常接动名词或形容词，还可引导独立分句（Far from doing...），语气比 anything but 稍缓；anything but 否定更彻底、更强调完全相反

synonyms.example: He was not in the least surprised by the outcome, for he had foreseen it all along. （读后续写·人物·从容）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：not in the least 仅用于否定程度（一点都不），不能像 anything but 那样后接名词表'恰恰是相反的东西'；anything but 的搭配更灵活

advancedExpressions.type: 易混辨析·anything but / nothing but / all but（课件对比）
advancedExpressions.expression: anything but = 根本不(not at all) ↔ nothing but = 只不过(only) ↔ all but = 几乎(almost)
advancedExpressions.example: It was anything but a joke(绝不是玩笑); it was nothing but the truth(只不过是事实); and the crowd was all but silent(几乎鸦雀无声). 【课件】（三组极易混淆，务必背例句分清）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'根本不/绝非'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: anything but ≈ not at all ≈ by no means ≈ far from ≈ not in the least
advancedExpressions.example: The journey was anything but (= by no means / far from) relaxing. 这趟旅程一点也不轻松。（表强调否定时可替换，anything but 与 far from 后可直接接形容词/名词，by no means 更正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth. was anything but ..., and that was precisely what ...
advancedExpressions.example: The reunion was anything but joyful, and that was precisely what forced us, at last, to speak the truths we had buried for years. （用反差句制造情节张力，为下文转折埋线）

advancedExpressions.expression: I must be honest: the road/task ahead will be anything but ...
advancedExpressions.example: I must be honest with every applicant: the training ahead will be anything but relaxing, but I promise it will be worth every drop of sweat. （招募/倡议信中先抑后扬，增强可信度）

advancedExpressions.expression: the popular belief that ... is anything but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The popular belief that hard work alone guarantees success is anything but the whole picture; opportunity, guidance and resilience matter just as much. （用 anything but 直接推翻常见误解，开门见山立靶）

advancedExpressions.type: 易混辨析·anything but / nothing but / all but
advancedExpressions.expression: anything but = 根本不(not at all) ↔ nothing but = 只不过(only) ↔ all but = 几乎(almost)
advancedExpressions.example: It was anything but a joke(绝不是玩笑); it was nothing but the truth(只不过是事实); and the crowd was all but silent(几乎鸦雀无声). （三组极易混淆，务必背例句分清）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The journey was not easy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The journey was anything but easy: blistered feet, empty water bottles and a map that no longer matched the land — yet with each painful step, something unbreakable took root inside us. （读后续写·旅程·意志）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: anything but 强调否定替换 not + 冒号列举具象细节（blistered feet...）+ 破折号转折抒情，画面感与情感升华兼具

sentenceUpgrade.original: This problem is not simple.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Let me be frank: the challenge we face is anything but simple, and pretending otherwise would do our cause a grave disservice. （议论文/应用文·正式说理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Let me be frank 引出坦诚语气 + anything but 加强否定 + and 分句点明'回避问题的代价'，逻辑严密显成熟

classPractice.answer: My daughter looked anything but happy this morning.
classPractice.note: 课件汉译英原题；anything but + adj. = not at all，'一点也不'

classPractice.answer: It was all but impossible to read his writing.
