classPractice.question: The road ahead is by no means smooth. →（用 anything but 改写）The road ahead is ____ ____ smooth.
classPractice.note: anything but ≈ by no means ≈ far from，均表'绝非、根本不'

original_sentence: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary.
readingExamples: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. not different or special or unexpected in any way; usual
(2) adj. average or normal, without any special features, sometimes with the sense of dull or commonplace
(3) adj. (of a person) not important, powerful, or of high social rank; belonging to the general public
(4) n. (out of the ordinary) something unusual or exceptional

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 常规；惯例（多用于 out of the ordinary = 不寻常的）
uncommonMeanings.example: For a boy who had spent his whole life in a quiet mountain village, the neon-lit city was something entirely out of the ordinary — dazzling, deafening and utterly bewildering. （读后续写·城乡反差·初到）

posExamples.sentence: It began as an ordinary Tuesday — the same alarm, the same cold toast — but by nightfall, a single phone call had turned my whole world upside down. （读后续写·平凡开端·突转）
I am writing to nominate Mr. Lin, an ordinary security guard whose extraordinary kindness has quietly warmed our entire community for over a decade. （应用文·推荐信）
History is shaped not only by great leaders but by ordinary individuals whose small, steady acts of courage accumulate into extraordinary change. （议论文·平凡与伟大）
The customs that followed the wedding vows were anything but ordinary, and I watched, wide-eyed, as centuries of tradition unfolded before me. （读后续写·异国婚礼·见闻）

wordForms.noun: the ordinary (常规·多用于 out of the ordinary)
wordForms.adjective: ordinary (普通的) / extraordinary (非凡的·反义)
wordForms.other: 反义构词·extra- 前缀：ordinary(普通) + extra-(超出) → extraordinary(非凡的，注意读 /ɪkˈstrɔːdnri/，重音在 tra 前)；反义速记 ordinary ↔ extraordinary / special / remarkable / unusual

idioms.example: At first nothing seemed out of the ordinary, but the moment I noticed the door standing ajar, a chill crept up my spine. （读后续写·悬疑·反常细节）

collocations.translation: 绝不寻常，非同凡响（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary. 随后的习俗一点也不寻常。（课文原句）
At first nothing seemed out of the ordinary, but the moment I noticed the door standing ajar, a chill crept up my spine. 起初一切似乎都很平常，但当我注意到那扇半开的门时，一阵寒意爬上脊背。
She was an ordinary person with an extraordinary heart, giving away half of her modest salary to children she would never meet. （读后续写·平凡人物·善良）
The new policy, we argued, must serve ordinary people rather than a privileged few if it is ever to earn genuine public trust. （议论文·政策·民生）
After years chasing fame, he came to cherish the quiet beauty of an ordinary life — a warm meal, a familiar voice, a sky slowly turning gold. （读后续写·顿悟·回归）
The documentary finds poetry in the textures of ordinary life, from steam rising off a morning noodle stall to laundry dancing on a rooftop line. （应用文·影评/推荐）
In ordinary circumstances I would have refused, but the desperation in her eyes left me no choice. （读后续写·抉择）
The teacher glanced around the classroom and found nothing out of the ordinary — yet an odd silence told her something was wrong. （读后续写·悬念）
It was an ordinary-looking envelope, but the words inside would change the course of three lives forever. （读后续写·物件·伏笔）
Her methods were far from ordinary, and the results, in time, proved every doubter spectacularly wrong. （议论文/记叙·创新）

synonyms.example: A sense of duty is a common virtue, yet in her it burned with uncommon intensity. （议论文·品格）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析①：common 强调'常见、大量存在'（频率），可含'平庸、粗俗'贬义（common taste）；ordinary 强调'普通、不特别'（性质），中性，指与众相同

synonyms.example: He was an average student in every subject but art, where his brush seemed touched by genius. （读后续写·天赋·反衬）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析②：average 侧重'处于中间水平、不出众'，隐含可测量的比较；ordinary 更泛指'不特别、寻常'，不一定涉及水平高低

synonyms.example: In this seaside town, sightings of dolphins are so commonplace that no one bothers to look up. （应用文·风物介绍）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：commonplace 更书面，强调'因常见而不值一提'，略带乏味意味；ordinary 语气更中性日常，使用范围更广

synonyms.example: The house looked unremarkable from the street, giving no hint of the treasures hidden within. （读后续写·反差·伏笔）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：unremarkable 强调'不引人注意、无亮点'，多描述外观印象；ordinary 泛指普通，语义更宽

advancedExpressions.expression: out of the ordinary(不寻常) / nothing out of the ordinary(没什么反常) / anything but ordinary(绝非寻常) / far from ordinary(远非普通) / an ordinary + n.
advancedExpressions.example: The evening began like any other, with nothing out of the ordinary — until the phone rang. 那个夜晚和往常一样开始，没什么反常——直到电话铃响起。（枚举可替换的高频搭配，制造'平凡→突变'的续写节奏）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'不寻常'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: anything but ordinary ≈ out of the ordinary ≈ far from ordinary ≈ extraordinary ≈ unusual
advancedExpressions.example: The ceremony was anything but ordinary. = The ceremony was out of the ordinary. = The ceremony was extraordinary. 这场仪式非同寻常。（表'不寻常'时可替换，anything but/far from + ordinary 更显反差）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·反义 extra- 前缀
advancedExpressions.expression: ordinary(普通) → extra- + ordinary → extraordinary(非凡的) / ordinarily → extraordinarily
advancedExpressions.example: What makes his kindness extraordinary is that he himself is entirely ordinary. 他的善良之所以非凡，正因为他本人极其普通。（ordinary/extraordinary 对照，续写议论升华金句结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: an ordinary ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: She was an ordinary woman in a faded coat, yet the way she knelt to comfort the crying child made the whole crowded platform fall silent. （'an ordinary ..., yet ...'反差结构凸显人物光辉，续写点睛）

advancedExpressions.expression: what makes ... remarkable is that ... is entirely ordinary
advancedExpressions.example: What makes his heroism truly remarkable is that he is entirely ordinary — no cape, no title, just a bus driver who chose, in one split second, to be brave. （表彰信/推荐信中放大'平凡英雄'的感染力）

advancedExpressions.expression: greatness lies not in the extraordinary but in the ordinary done extraordinarily well
advancedExpressions.example: History reminds us that greatness lies not in the extraordinary but in the ordinary done extraordinarily well — a lesson worth carrying into every choice we make. （议论文结尾格言式升华，形成 ordinary/extraordinary 对照）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was an ordinary day when everything changed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was, by every measure, an ordinary day — grey sky, cold coffee, the drone of the morning news — until a knock at the door split my life neatly into 'before' and 'after'. （读后续写·平淡开场·剧变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: by every measure 强调普通 + 破折号三项名词短语堆叠氛围 + until 引出转折 + 'before/after' 隐喻分割人生，节奏张弛有致

sentenceUpgrade.original: Ordinary people can do great things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that ordinary people, when united by a common purpose, are capable of feats no single hero could ever accomplish alone. （议论文/演讲·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that 正式主句 + when united by... 状语插入增强逻辑 + no single hero...alone 对比句放大'平凡集体'的力量

classPractice.question: 随后的那些习俗绝非寻常。The customs that followed were ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；anything but ordinary = not at all ordinary，绝非寻常

classPractice.question: At first nothing seemed ____ ____ ____ ____, until I noticed the half-open door.
classPractice.note: out of the ordinary 不寻常的；ordinary 此处作名词用于固定短语

classPractice.question: What makes his courage remarkable is that he is an ____ (ordinary) man — with no title and no cape.
classPractice.note: 此处作形容词修饰 man，'普通的'；注意反义词 extraordinary 非凡的

classPractice.question: ordinary / extraordinary —— An ____ teacher tells; an ____ teacher inspires.
classPractice.note: ordinary 普通的 ↔ extraordinary 非凡的，extra- 前缀构成反义

translation: 浪漫的；爱情的；(Romantic) 浪漫主义的
original_sentence: It was very romantic!
readingExamples: It was very romantic!
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to love or a close loving relationship, or showing feelings of love
(2) adj. beautiful in a way that makes you feel that love is possible, or that strongly appeals to the emotions and the imagination
(3) adj. (of a person or idea) idealistic and impractical, not based on the way things really are
(4) adj. (usually Romantic) relating to Romanticism, the 18th–19th-century movement in art, music and literature
(5) n. a person who has idealistic, sentimental or imaginative attitudes

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不切实际的，理想化的（贬义）
uncommonMeanings.example: His plan to sail around the world with no money and no crew was hopelessly romantic, and even his closest friends struggled to hide their doubt. （读后续写·梦想·天真）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常大写 Romantic）浪漫主义的（18—19世纪艺术、音乐、文学运动）
uncommonMeanings.example: The poem is a classic example of the Romantic movement's love of wild nature and strong emotion. 这首诗是浪漫主义运动热爱自然、情感奔放的典型代表。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 浪漫主义者，多情善感之人
uncommonMeanings.example: At heart he had always been a romantic, the kind of man who kept train tickets and dried flowers long after the journeys were forgotten. （读后续写·人物性格·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: Under a sky freckled with stars, with candlelight trembling on the water, the whole evening felt impossibly romantic — the kind of moment you fear might dissolve if you blink. （读后续写·氛围·爱情）
For couples seeking a romantic getaway, our seaside town offers moonlit beaches, cosy candlelit cafés and sunsets that seem painted just for two. （应用文·旅游宣传/推荐信）
While some dismiss the pursuit of one's passion as naively romantic, I would argue that a life without ideals is a far poorer thing than a life that dares to dream. （议论文·理想与现实）
It was, without a doubt, the most romantic wedding I had ever witnessed — garlands of jasmine, drifting rose petals, and a bride whose smile could have lit the darkest hall. （读后续写·婚礼·唯美）

wordForms.noun: romance (n. 恋情;浪漫;传奇故事) / Romanticism (n. 浪漫主义) / romantic (n. 浪漫主义者)
wordForms.other: 词族速记：romance(名词·恋情/传奇) → romantic(形容词·浪漫的) → romantically(副词) → romanticize(动词·美化) → Romanticism(浪漫主义)；构词：romance + -tic → romantic，romantic + -ize → romanticize

collocations.translation: 太浪漫了！（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It was very romantic! 太浪漫了！（课文原句）
What began as a shy friendship slowly blossomed into a romantic relationship neither of them had dared to name. （读后续写·感情发展）
He filled the whole room with paper cranes — a romantic gesture so heartfelt that she burst into tears before she could speak. （读后续写·惊喜·感动）
As a special anniversary surprise, they booked a romantic getaway to a quiet lakeside cabin far from the noise of the city. （应用文·旅游/推荐）
He had planned a romantic dinner down to the last rose petal, only for the power to cut out and turn the evening into something even more unforgettable. （读后续写·计划意外·温情）
The film explores whether romantic love can survive the slow erosion of everyday routine. （应用文·影评）

collocations.translation: 无可救药的浪漫主义者
collocations.example: Call me a hopeless romantic, but I still believe the best stories begin with an unexpected hello. （读后续写/演讲·自我坦白）

collocations.translation: 浪漫的（不切实际的）想法
collocations.example: We must abandon the romantic notion that talent alone will carry us to the top, for discipline is the truer engine of success. （议论文·理想与努力）

synonyms.example: She gave him an affectionate pat on the shoulder, the way a mother reassures a nervous child. （读后续写·亲情/温情）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析①：affectionate 侧重'温柔亲昵的关爱'，可用于亲情、友情、爱情，不专指爱情；romantic 特指男女之情或唯美浪漫的氛围

synonyms.example: His idealistic vision of a world without borders inspired thousands, even as critics called it a fantasy. （议论文·理想）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析②：idealistic 中性偏褒，强调'追求崇高理想'；romantic 作'不切实际'解时贬义更浓，强调'感性、脱离现实'

synonyms.example: The old photograph made her sentimental, and for a long moment she simply sat, letting the memories wash over her. （读后续写·怀旧·情感）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析③：sentimental 强调'情感过度、多愁善感'，有时略含'滥情'贬义；romantic 侧重'浪漫、唯美或恋爱色彩'，情感更明快积极

advancedExpressions.expression: a romantic relationship(恋爱关系) / a romantic gesture(浪漫之举) / a romantic getaway(浪漫之旅) / a hopeless romantic(不可救药的浪漫者) / a romantic notion(不切实际的想法)
advancedExpressions.example: He planned a romantic getaway as a grand romantic gesture for their anniversary. 他策划了一场浪漫之旅，作为纪念日的浪漫之举。（枚举可替换的高频搭配，写爱情/旅游/影评类必备）

advancedExpressions.expression: romance(n.恋情/传奇) → romantic(adj.浪漫的) → romantically(adv.) → romanticize(v.美化) → Romanticism(n.浪漫主义)
advancedExpressions.example: Do not romanticize hardship; there is nothing romantic about going hungry. 别把苦难浪漫化——挨饿一点也不浪漫。（-ize 变动词'使浪漫化/理想化'，常含批判语气）

advancedExpressions.expression: romantic ≈ affectionate(亲昵深情) ≈ sentimental(感伤多情)；作'不切实际'解 ≈ idealistic ≈ impractical
advancedExpressions.example: It was a romantic (= sentimental) evening full of soft candlelight and whispered promises. 那是一个满是柔和烛光与耳语誓言的浪漫夜晚。（表'浪漫唯美'可与 sentimental 换用，注意贬义时才近 idealistic）

advancedExpressions.expression: there was something almost romantic about ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was something almost romantic about the way the rain traced silver rivers down the window while we shared one umbrella and a single, endless conversation. （'there was something almost romantic about...'铺陈唯美氛围，含环境描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: for those in search of romance, ... offers ...
advancedExpressions.example: For those in search of romance, our little coastal inn offers whispering waves, lantern-lit gardens and mornings that begin with coffee and birdsong. （旅游推荐信中调动感官吸引读者）

advancedExpressions.expression: however romantic ... may sound, reality demands ...
advancedExpressions.example: However romantic the idea of following one's heart may sound, reality demands that passion be tempered by preparation and hard-won skill. （议论文中'先让步再反驳'，逻辑严密显思辨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The evening was very romantic.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The evening unfolded like a scene from an old film — candlelight swaying, a violin sighing somewhere unseen, and two cups of tea growing cold as neither of us wished to break the spell. （读后续写·氛围·细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: like a scene from an old film 明喻定调 + 破折号三项现在分词/独立结构叠加感官（candlelight swaying, a violin sighing）+ growing cold 细节暗示沉醉，避免直白说'romantic'

sentenceUpgrade.original: It is romantic but not realistic to follow your dreams blindly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To chase one's dreams with eyes shut may be romantic, but it is reason, not raw passion, that ultimately turns a fragile wish into a lasting achievement. （议论文·理想与理性）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: To chase...with eyes shut 不定式作主语兼隐喻 + may be...but 让步转折 + it is...that 强调句突出'reason'，观点鲜明有思辨

classPractice.question: The wedding, with its garlands of jasmine and drifting petals, was truly ____ (romance).
classPractice.note: 此处作表语需形容词 romantic；名词 romance→形容词 romantic

classPractice.question: romance / romantic / romantically —— Their ____ began on a train; the whole thing sounds impossibly ____, but it was all true.
classPractice.note: 第一空作主语需名词 romance(恋情)；第二空作表语需形容词 romantic

classPractice.question: 别把贫穷浪漫化——挨饿一点也不浪漫。(romanticize)
classPractice.answer: Don't romanticize poverty; there is nothing romantic about going hungry.
classPractice.note: romanticize v. 使浪漫化/理想化，常含批判；nothing romantic about doing 做某事毫不浪漫

original_sentence: The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the flight.
readingExamples: The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the flight.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a journey made by flying in an aircraft; a plane making a particular journey
(2) n. the act of flying, or the movement of something through the air
(3) n. a set of stairs between two floors (a flight of stairs / steps)
(4) n. the act of running away or escaping from a dangerous or unpleasant situation
(5) n. an act or instance of soaring above the ordinary (a flight of fancy / imagination)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·随flight讲】(hit) 对……产生不良或意外的影响（have a bad effect on）；It suddenly hit sb that… 某人突然想起……
uncommonMeanings.example: The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the flight. / Covid-19 has hit the cinema industry very hard. 一下飞机热浪就袭来；新冠重创了电影业。（课件：课文 hit me 一句同时带出 hit 的'影响'与'突然想起'两义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①飞行；空中飞行（the act of flying）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bird's graceful flight across the lake left us speechless. 那只鸟优雅地掠过湖面，令我们无言以对。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②一段楼梯（a flight of stairs / steps；两层楼之间的一整段）
uncommonMeanings.example: My office is one flight up. 我的办公室在上一层楼（上一段楼梯的地方）。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 逃跑，逃离（正式用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The sudden crash of thunder sent the whole flock into panicked flight, and in the confusion the boy lost sight of his only lantern. （读后续写·惊险·逃散）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一段楼梯（a flight of stairs）
uncommonMeanings.example: She climbed the last flight of stairs on trembling legs, each step echoing in the empty tower like the ticking of a clock running out. （读后续写·紧张·登高）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （想象力的）驰骋（a flight of fancy/imagination）
uncommonMeanings.example: What his teachers dismissed as an idle flight of fancy would one day become a blueprint that reshaped the city skyline. （读后续写·梦想·天才）

posExamples.sentence: The wave of summer heat hit me the instant I stepped off the flight, and with it came the roar, the colour and the pulsing music of a city already lost in celebration. （读后续写·抵达·感官冲击）
I regret to inform you that our flight has been delayed by six hours, and I would therefore like to request a full refund or a reschedule at the earliest convenience. （应用文·投诉信/请求信）
The invention of powered flight not only shrank the distances between nations but reshaped the very way humanity imagines its own limits. （议论文·科技·文明）
I watched, breath held, as the eagle rose in effortless flight, its great wings carving slow circles against the pale morning sky. （读后续写·自然·壮美）

wordForms.noun: flight (n. 飞行;航班;一段楼梯;逃跑)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：fly (v. 飞) → flight (n. 飞行) 名词由动词变来，注意拼写 f-l-i-g-h-t；flyer / flier (n. 传单;飞行员)；flyover (n. 立交桥)。特例/贴士：fly 为不规则动词 fly-flew-flown；'一段楼梯'用 flight，不用 stairs 单独计数，如 up three flights of stairs 上三段楼梯

idioms.translation: 异想天开;想象力的驰骋
idioms.example: It was no mere flight of fancy: the sketches in that battered notebook contained a machine decades ahead of its time. （读后续写·天才·伏笔）

idioms.translation: 使某人溃逃，把某人赶跑
idioms.example: A single bold shout from the old shepherd was enough to put the circling wolves to flight. （读后续写·勇气·化险）
As the applause thundered, her spirits took flight, and every sleepless night of practice suddenly felt worth it. （读后续写·成功·喜悦）

collocations.phrase: get off / get on / board a flight
collocations.translation: 【课件】下飞机 / 登机 / 登机
collocations.example: The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the flight; two hours earlier I had boarded the flight without a hint of what was to come. 我一下飞机就热浪扑面；两小时前登机时还浑然不觉。（课件搭配）
To catch an early flight, we set out before dawn and reached the airport just as the sky began to pale. 为了赶早班飞机，我们天不亮就出发，到机场时天刚泛白。（课件搭配）
The flight to New York has been cancelled due to the heavy fog. 由于大雾，飞往纽约的航班已被取消。（课件填空原句）

collocations.phrase: a flight from A to B
collocations.translation: 【课件】从 A 到 B 的航程
collocations.example: It was a long flight from Beijing to Rio, but the excitement kept me wide awake the whole way. 这是一段从北京到里约的漫长航程，可兴奋让我一路清醒。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】惬意 / 舒适 / 顺利的航程
collocations.example: The crew did everything to make it a comfortable flight, and before I knew it we were beginning our descent. 机组人员想尽办法让航程舒适，不知不觉飞机就开始下降了。（课件搭配）
The total flight time to Rio is nearly thirty hours, counting the long stop in between. 算上中途长时间的经停，飞往里约的总飞行时间将近三十个小时。（课件搭配）
The flight crew greeted every passenger with a warm smile as we boarded. 我们登机时，机组人员向每位乘客报以温暖的微笑。（课件搭配）
The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the flight. 我一下飞机，夏日的热浪就扑面而来。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一段楼梯（两层楼之间的一段）
collocations.example: She ran up a flight of stairs to answer the door. 她跑上一段楼梯去开门。
At the first gunshot the birds took flight. 第一声枪响，鸟群便飞走了。
We sprinted through the terminal and caught the flight with barely a minute to spare, collapsing into our seats in breathless laughter. （读后续写·惊险·团圆）
As I boarded the flight that would carry me across the ocean, I glanced back once at my parents, waving until they were only two small dots. （读后续写·离别·出国）
The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the flight, wrapping around me like a thick, unfamiliar blanket. （读后续写·抵达·体感）
When the announcement came that our flight had been cancelled, a groan rippled through the waiting crowd. （读后续写·意外·失望）
The moment she read the letter, she booked the earliest flight home, unwilling to lose a single hour more. （读后续写·急切·亲情）
Passengers on the international flight are kindly reminded to complete their arrival cards before landing. （应用文·通知）
Panting, I dragged the heavy suitcase up the final flight of stairs, promising myself I would never pack this much again. （读后续写·日常·狼狈）
A thick fog grounded every plane, and our connecting flight vanished from the departure board along with our hopes of arriving on time. （读后续写·旅途·受阻）

synonyms.example: The long journey home gave her ample time to rehearse the apology she had put off for far too long. （读后续写·内心·和解）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：journey 泛指任何方式的（尤指长途）旅行过程，强调经历；flight 特指乘飞机的航班或飞行本身。句法：a two-hour flight / a long journey，二者都可作可数名词

synonyms.example: Their escape through the burning forest was a blur of smoke, fear and desperate hope. （读后续写·惊险）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：escape 是日常常用词，指从危险/困境中逃脱，可作动词也可作名词；flight 作'逃离'解时更正式书面，只作名词，常见于 in flight、put to flight、take flight 等固定表达

synonyms.example: The maiden voyage of the great ship ended in tragedy the world would never forget. （议论文/记叙·历史）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：voyage 专指海上或太空的长途航行；flight 专指空中飞行。二者按交通方式区分，不可混用

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·hit 表'对…产生影响'/it hit sb that突然想起
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】hit sb/sth = have a bad effect on 对……产生不良或意外影响（hit-hit-hit）；It suddenly hit(s) sb. that… 某人突然想起/意识到……
advancedExpressions.example: Covid-19 has hit the cinema industry very hard. / I couldn't remember where I'd seen him before, and then it suddenly hit me that we had been classmates. 新冠重创了电影业；我想不起在哪见过他，随后猛然记起我们曾是同学。（课件语法点：hit 的两个高频义项）

advancedExpressions.expression: get off the flight（课文）/ take flight 逃跑·起飞 / put sb to flight 使溃逃 / a flight of stairs 一段楼梯 / a flight of fancy 异想天开 / catch·miss·board·book a flight 赶上·错过·登·订航班
advancedExpressions.example: I got off the flight, dragged my case up one last flight of stairs, and only then let my imagination take flight. （一句话串起'航班·楼梯·飞驰'三义，帮助区分记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: fly (v.) → flight (n.) 飞行/航班；flight + less → flightless 不会飞的；fly + er → flyer/flier 传单·飞行员
advancedExpressions.example: The flightless penguin will never know the joy of flight, yet in water it flies as freely as any bird. （抓住 '-less 表否定、-t 名词化' 的构词规律）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·as soon as 引导时间状语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: ... as soon as sb. got off the flight（课文：主句用一般过去时，从句也用一般过去时，表'一……就……'）
advancedExpressions.example: The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the flight. 可与 the moment / the instant / immediately 互换引导'一……就……'。（课文语法点）

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment I stepped off the flight, ... hit me
advancedExpressions.example: The moment I stepped off the flight, a wall of heat and a symphony of unfamiliar sounds hit me all at once, and I knew at once that this journey would change me. （用感官冲击开启新场景，'hit me' 增强代入感）

advancedExpressions.expression: owing to the cancellation of my flight, I would like to request ...
advancedExpressions.example: Owing to the sudden cancellation of my flight, I would like to request either a full refund or the earliest possible rebooking, together with an explanation for the inconvenience caused. （投诉/请求信中因果+并列请求，礼貌而坚定）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as the invention of flight ..., so too ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as the invention of flight once dissolved the boundaries of the sky, so too may today's technologies dissolve barriers we can scarcely imagine. （用类比论证科技突破人类边界，句式工整有气势）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I got off the plane and felt very hot.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment I got off the flight, the summer heat slammed into me like a physical wall, and within seconds my shirt clung to my back and the horizon shimmered with haze. （读后续写·抵达·体感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment...引出瞬时动作 + slammed into me like a physical wall 明喻强化冲击 + within seconds 细节推进（shirt clung / horizon shimmered）画面立体

sentenceUpgrade.original: The invention of the plane changed the world.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The advent of powered flight did more than merely shorten distances; it rewrote humanity's sense of the possible and lifted our collective imagination to heights our ancestors could only dream of. （议论文·科技·文明）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The advent of 正式名词短语 + did more than merely... 递进否定 + 分号连接两大意义 + lifted...to heights 一语双关呼应'flight'意象

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: I couldn't remember where I'd seen him before, and then ____ ____ ____ ____ that we had once been classmates. （后来猛然记起来了）
classPractice.note: 【课件】It suddenly hit(s) sb. that… 某人突然想起……；此处 that 从句作真正主语，it 为形式主语

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: The ____ ____ New York has been cancelled due to the heavy fog. （飞往纽约的航班）
classPractice.note: 【课件】the flight to + 地点 = 飞往……的航班

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·hit义项）
classPractice.question: Covid-19 has ____ (hit) the cinema industry very hard over the past few years.
classPractice.note: 【课件】hit 对……产生不良/意外影响（have a bad effect on）；hit-hit-hit，现在完成时用过去分词 hit

classPractice.question: The summer heat hit me as soon as I got off the ____ (fly).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；动词 fly 的名词形式为 flight，此处指'航班'

classPractice.question: 选 flight / journey / voyage 填空：Exhausted, she climbed the last ____ of stairs to her attic room.
classPractice.note: a flight of stairs 一段楼梯；journey/voyage 无此搭配，考熟词僻义

classPractice.question: 第一声枪响，鸟群就飞走了。At the first gunshot the birds ____ ____.
classPractice.note: take flight 起飞/逃走；固定短语，flight 不可加 the

translation: 特殊场合，盛会；时刻；时机
original_sentence: No wonder people from Rio take a week off for this happy occasion.
readingExamples: No wonder people from Rio take a week off for this happy occasion.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a particular time when something happens, especially a specific instance of an event
(2) n. a special or important event, ceremony or celebration
(3) n. a suitable or opportune time; a chance or opportunity to do something
(4) n. (formal) the reason or cause for something
(5) v. (formal) to cause something to happen

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】(做某事的)时机、机会 (a suitable or favourable time)；an occasion for (doing) sth 做某事的时机
uncommonMeanings.example: This is not an occasion for laughter. 现在可不是笑的时候。（课件原句：occasion 表'时机'，区别于'场合'）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】(某事发生的)时刻、时候 (a time when something happens)；常见于 on several occasions 好几次、if the occasion arises 如有必要
uncommonMeanings.example: She met with Alex on several occasions. / I will turn to you for help if the occasion arises. 她和亚历克斯见过好几次；如有必要，我会向你求助。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（特殊、重要的）场合，盛会（a special/happy occasion）
uncommonMeanings.example: A wedding is a joyous occasion for the whole family. 婚礼是全家人喜庆的盛会。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（做某事的）时机，机会（have occasion to do；较正式）
uncommonMeanings.example: I have had no occasion to use my French since I left Paris. 离开巴黎后我一直没机会用法语。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 原因，理由（正式用法，常见于 have occasion to）
uncommonMeanings.example: In all his years of teaching, he had never once had occasion to raise his voice; a single quiet glance was enough to restore order. （读后续写·师者·威严）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 引起，导致（正式）
uncommonMeanings.example: The careless remark, though quickly forgotten by the speaker, occasioned a rift that would take years to heal. （读后续写·误会·裂痕）

posExamples.sentence: No wonder the whole town takes a week off for this joyous occasion — for these few dazzling days, ordinary streets become rivers of colour, music and unrestrained delight. （读后续写·节庆·氛围）
On behalf of the entire class, I would like to invite you to grace our graduation ceremony, an occasion we hope you will help us make truly unforgettable. （应用文·邀请信）
True character reveals itself not on grand occasions but in the countless small moments when no one is watching and nothing is at stake. （议论文·品格·细节）
She saved the silk dress for a special occasion that never seemed to come, until one grey afternoon she realized that ordinary Tuesdays were reason enough to shine. （读后续写·顿悟·珍惜当下）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：occasion (n./vt.) → occasional (adj.) → occasionally (adv.)。构词法贴士：名词 occasion + al 变形容词 occasional，再 + ly 变副词。特例/易错：on occasion（介词短语）= occasionally = 偶尔；注意 occasion 拼写为双 c 单 s（oc-ca-sion）

idioms.example: On occasion, when the house grew too quiet, she would take out the old letters and read them aloud to no one at all. （读后续写·孤独·怀念）

idioms.translation: 临危不乱，从容应对挑战
idioms.example: Everyone doubted the timid boy, but when the crisis struck he rose to the occasion, leading the panicked crowd calmly to safety. （读后续写·成长·蜕变）
The candles, the hush, the slow procession — everything lent the evening a solemn sense of occasion. （读后续写·仪式·氛围）

collocations.phrase: for this happy occasion / on this special occasion
collocations.translation: 【课件】为这个喜庆的盛会 / 在这个特殊的场合
collocations.example: No wonder people from Rio take a week off for this happy occasion; on such a special occasion the whole city gives itself over to joy. 难怪里约的人们为这个盛会请一周的假；在这样特殊的场合，整座城市都沉浸在欢乐里。（课件搭配）
She picked out a dress appropriate for the occasion. 她挑了一条与场合相称的裙子。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】做某事的时机 / 场合
collocations.example: This is not an occasion for laughter. 现在可不是笑的时候。（课件原句：occasion 表'时机'）
She met with Alex on several occasions, and on occasion he even loses his temper, though everyone knows him to be mild. 她和亚历克斯见过好几次；虽然大家都知道他脾气温和，偶尔他也会发火。（课件：on several occasions 好几次；on occasion 偶尔）

collocations.translation: 【课件】如有必要 (= if it becomes necessary)
collocations.example: I will turn to you for help if the occasion arises. 如有必要，我会向你求助。（课件原句）
On occasion he would visit his old teacher without a word of warning. 他偶尔会不打招呼就去看望老师。（课件归纳：on occasion(s) = sometimes）
On one occasion she called me in the middle of the night, her voice trembling with excitement. 有一次她半夜给我打电话，声音激动得发颤。（课件归纳：on one occasion = once）
On the occasion of the arrival of New Year's Day, please accept my sincere greetings. 值新年到来之际，请接受我诚挚的祝福。（课件归纳原句）

collocations.phrase: take a week off for this happy occasion
collocations.translation: 为这个喜庆的场合休假一周（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: No wonder people from Rio take a week off for this happy occasion. 难怪里约的人们要为这个喜庆的场合休假一周。（课文原句）
On occasion he would visit his old teacher. 他偶尔会去看望他的老师。
On this occasion I decided to keep silent. 这一次我决定保持沉默。
This dress is only for special occasions. 这条裙子只在特殊场合才穿。
No wonder people from Rio take a week off for this happy occasion, when the whole city surrenders itself to rhythm and joy. （读后续写·狂欢节·文化）
On this occasion, at least, luck was on our side, and the storm held off until the last guest had gone home. （读后续写·叙事·转折）
To mark the occasion of our school's centenary, we are organizing a grand exhibition of student achievements over the past hundred years. （应用文·通知/倡议）
Unsure what to wear to such a formal occasion, he stood before the mirror for a full ten minutes, tugging nervously at his borrowed tie. （读后续写·紧张·细节）
On the occasion of Teachers' Day, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to every mentor who has lit our way. （应用文·致辞/贺信）
The hall had been decorated specially for the occasion, with lanterns swaying overhead and ribbons rippling in the evening breeze. （读后续写·布置·氛围）
A good leader knows when to be firm and when to be gentle, adapting as the occasion demands. （议论文·领导力）

synonyms.example: Seize every chance to speak English, however small. 抓住每一个说英语的机会，无论多小。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：chance 最口语，指'（碰巧或可利用的）机会'，常 get/have/take a chance to do；occasion 作'时机'解时更正式，强调'合适去做某事的时候'，常 have occasion to do。区别：chance 侧重'可能性/运气'，occasion 侧重'合适的场合与时机'

synonyms.example: The charity concert turned out to be the most talked-about event of the entire school year. （应用文·活动报道）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：event 泛指发生的（尤指重要或有组织的）事件；occasion 更强调'特定的时间点'或'值得纪念的场合'，含'时机'意味

synonyms.example: The internship offered her the perfect opportunity to test theory against the messy realities of the workplace. （议论文/应用文·成长）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：occasion 作'时机'解时偏'合适的时候'（有机会做某事），较正式；opportunity 更常用，强调'有利的机会、可利用的良机'，常 a golden opportunity to do

synonyms.example: The award ceremony ended with a standing ovation that seemed to go on forever. （读后续写·荣誉·感动）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：ceremony 特指正式的、程序化的典礼活动；occasion 范围更广，可指任何特殊场合，不限于正式仪式

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·occasion 三大义项与短语归纳
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】①特殊场合/盛会 on this special occasion, appropriate for the occasion；②时机 an occasion for (doing) sth；③时刻 on several occasions 好几次, on occasion 偶尔, if the occasion arises 如有必要。归纳：on occasion(s) = sometimes 偶尔 / on one occasion = once 有一次 / on this·that occasion 这·那一次 / on the occasion of 值……之际
advancedExpressions.example: On the occasion of the festival she wore a dress appropriate for the occasion; on occasion she still slips back to that street, and on one occasion she even stayed till dawn to relive it. 节日之际她穿着与场合相称的裙子；偶尔她还会回到那条街，有一次甚至待到天亮，只为重温旧梦。（课件语法点：一句串起 occasion 各短语，辨析 on occasion 偶尔 vs on one occasion 有一次 vs on the occasion of 值……之际）

advancedExpressions.expression: on this occasion 这一次 / on occasion 偶尔 / on the occasion of 值……之际 / for the occasion 为此场合 / a special·happy·formal occasion / rise to the occasion 临危不乱 / a sense of occasion 隆重感
advancedExpressions.example: On occasion the shy boy would surprise us all, and on this special occasion he truly rose to the occasion. （一句话辨析 on occasion 偶尔 vs on this occasion 这一次）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表示'偶尔'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: on occasion = occasionally = now and then = from time to time = every now and again
advancedExpressions.example: On occasion / Occasionally / From time to time, she would slip back to the old house just to sit in silence. （以上表达可互换，均表'偶尔'）

advancedExpressions.expression: occasion (n.) + al → occasional (adj. 偶尔的) + ly → occasionally (adv. 偶尔地)
advancedExpressions.example: An occasional visitor, he came only on great occasions, and even then occasionally arrived late. （名词→形容词→副词，一句话贯通词族）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·情节转折/成长
advancedExpressions.expression: sb. rose to the occasion, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: When every plan collapsed and all eyes turned to her, she rose to the occasion, her voice steady even as her hands trembled beneath the table. （'rise to the occasion' 刻画人物临危蜕变，动作与心理并写）

advancedExpressions.expression: on the occasion of ..., we would be honoured if ...
advancedExpressions.example: On the occasion of our school's fiftieth anniversary, we would be deeply honoured if you could join us and share the wisdom of your remarkable career. （邀请信中庄重得体，'on the occasion of' 提升正式度）

advancedExpressions.expression: character is revealed not on great occasions but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Character, I would argue, is revealed not on great occasions but in the quiet, unwitnessed moments when doing right brings no reward at all. （用'not...but...'对比句深化观点，凸显思辨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: People take a week off to celebrate this happy event.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: No wonder the people of Rio surrender a whole week to this joyous occasion, when the drab rhythm of daily life dissolves into a flood of colour, drumbeats and unashamed joy. （读后续写·节庆·氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: No wonder 引出合理推断 + surrender a whole week 拟人化让步 + when 从句铺陈感官意象（colour, drumbeats, joy）三项排比，画面沸腾

sentenceUpgrade.original: We want to invite you to our graduation.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would mean a great deal to us all if you could grace our graduation ceremony with your presence — an occasion we have long dreamed of and one we sincerely hope you will help us remember forever. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would mean a great deal to us if... 委婉恳切 + grace...with your presence 敬辞抬升 + 破折号同位语 an occasion... 双重定语增强情感分量

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: People from all over the world fill this small town for ____ ____ ____. （这场特殊的盛会）
classPractice.note: 【课件】occasion 表'特殊场合、盛会'，for + 名词短语作原因/目的

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: The Lantern Festival is an occasion ____ the families get together and everyone has fun.
classPractice.note: 【课件】occasion 表'时刻/场合'时，定语从句用关系副词 when（= on which）

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: It's best not to try a new recipe for the first time ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____. （在这样重要的场合）
classPractice.note: 【课件】on + (such an important) occasion 在这样重要的场合

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: He has been known ____ ____ (有时) to lose his temper.
classPractice.note: 【课件·归纳】on occasion = sometimes 有时、偶尔；occasion 用单数、不加冠词

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: ____ ____ ____ (有一次), she called me in the middle of the night.
classPractice.note: 【课件·归纳】on one occasion = once 有一次

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: ____ ____ ____ ____ (在……的时候) arrival of New Year's Day, please accept my sincere greetings.
classPractice.note: 【课件·归纳】on the occasion of… 值……之际、在……的时候

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题·词形变化）
classPractice.question: Luke devoted himself to the new project, with ____ (occasion, 偶尔) visits to the nearby supermarket.
classPractice.note: 【课件】occasion → occasional (adj. 偶尔的)，作定语修饰 visits

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题·词形变化）
classPractice.question: While my job is ____ (occasion) dangerous, I don't mind because danger excites me.
classPractice.note: 【课件】occasional → occasionally (adv. 偶尔地)，修饰形容词 dangerous

classPractice.question: It is on ____ (occasion) like this that we feel most grateful to our teachers.
classPractice.note: occasion 作'场合'解为可数名词；like this 修饰复数须用 occasions

classPractice.question: 选 occasion / chance 填空：Since I moved abroad, I have had little ____ to speak my mother tongue.
classPractice.note: have occasion to do 有机会/需要做某事（正式）；此处强调'合适去做的时机'

classPractice.question: 他偶尔会来看望我们。He would visit us ____ ____. （用 occasion 的短语）
classPractice.note: on occasion = occasionally 偶尔；注意 occasion 用单数、不加冠词

original_sentence: I could feel it already—the Carnival was in the air!
readingExamples: I could feel it already—the Carnival was in the air!
definitionEn:
(1) phrase. (of a feeling, mood or quality) noticeable and felt by people, though not clearly expressed; seeming to surround you
(2) phrase. (of an idea, plan or possibility) being talked about or considered, but not yet decided or certain
(3) phrase. (literal) up above the ground; floating or suspended in the sky
(4) phrase. (up in the air) still undecided, uncertain or unsettled

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·对比】on the air 正在播送 / off the air 停止播送；up in the air 悬而未决；put on airs 摆架子；an air of confidence 一副自信的样子
uncommonMeanings.example: These programmes stay on the air, though their future is up in the air; the host puts on airs, yet keeps an air of confidence. 这些节目仍在播出，尽管前景悬而未决；主持人摆着架子，却也透着一副自信的样子。（课件：与 in the air 弥漫对比记忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（气氛/情绪）弥漫着，可感觉到（虽未明说却能感受到）
uncommonMeanings.example: There was excitement in the air on the last day of school. 学期最后一天，空气中弥漫着兴奋。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（想法/计划）在酝酿中，被谈论但尚未确定
uncommonMeanings.example: Rumours of a merger were in the air for weeks. 合并的传闻酝酿了好几周。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 悬而未决的，尚未确定的（up in the air）
uncommonMeanings.example: With the storm still raging outside, our travel plans hung completely up in the air, and all we could do was wait and hope. （读后续写·旅途·不确定）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （字面）在空中，悬浮着
uncommonMeanings.example: For one breathless heartbeat the gymnast hung motionless in the air, and the whole arena seemed to forget how to breathe. （读后续写·比赛·凝固瞬间）

posExamples.sentence: I could feel it already — the excitement of the Carnival was in the air, humming through the crowded streets like an electric current no one could resist. （读后续写·节庆·氛围）
As the graduation season approaches, a bittersweet feeling of farewell is in the air on our campus, and I write to propose one final event to bind our memories together. （应用文·倡议书）
When change is in the air, the wise do not cling stubbornly to the past but ask calmly how they might turn uncertainty into opportunity. （议论文·变革·心态）
There was tension in the air the moment I entered the room; no one spoke, yet every glance seemed to carry an accusation. （读后续写·冲突·紧张）

wordForms.other: 本词条为习语/固定短语，无词形变化。构词/搭配贴士：作表语或状语，主语常为抽象的情绪或气氛（excitement/tension/change is in the air）；另一常用变体 up in the air 表'悬而未决'。区别 clear the air 消除误会（动词短语）与 in the air 弥漫（表状态）

idioms.example: The final decision was still up in the air when the meeting ended, leaving all of us in an uneasy suspense. （读后续写·悬念·等待）
A single honest conversation was all it took to clear the air, and by nightfall the two old friends were laughing again. （读后续写·和解·温情）

idioms.idiom: a change is in the air
idioms.example: You could sense that a change was in the air: the whispers in the corridors, the shuffled desks, the principal's unusually gentle smile. （读后续写·预兆·氛围）

collocations.translation: 【课件】(可感觉到的)兴奋 / 浪漫气息
collocations.example: He scored the winning goal in the final and there was excitement in the air. 他射入了决赛的制胜球，四处都能感觉到那股兴奋。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: on the air / off the air
collocations.translation: 【课件·对比】正在播送 / 停止播送
collocations.example: With such loyal viewers, these programmes don't need high ratings to stay on the air. 有这样忠实的观众，这些节目不必靠高收视率就能继续播出。（课件对比原句：on the air 正在播送 ≠ in the air 弥漫）

collocations.translation: 【课件·对比】悬而未决，尚未确定
collocations.example: The summer travel plan is still up in the air because of the tight budget. 由于预算紧张，暑期旅行计划仍悬而未决。（课件对比原句）
He is anything but an easy-going person; he is always putting on airs. 他一点也不随和，总是摆架子。（课件对比原句）
Faced with the big challenge, Amy had an air of confidence. 面对这样大的挑战，埃米一副胸有成竹的样子。（课件对比原句）

collocations.phrase: the Carnival was in the air
collocations.translation: 狂欢节的气氛在弥漫（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I could feel it already—the Carnival was in the air! 我已经能感觉到了——狂欢节的气氛正在弥漫！（课文原句）

collocations.translation: （某种气氛/情绪）弥漫着，可感觉到；（想法/计划）在酝酿中
collocations.example: Change was in the air as the new term began. 新学期开始，变革的气息在酝酿之中。
Our holiday plans are still up in the air. 我们的假期计划仍未定下来。

collocations.phrase: excitement / joy is in the air
collocations.example: Excitement was in the air as the finish line came into view, and a thousand tired legs found one last burst of strength. （读后续写·比赛·冲刺）
Tension was in the air throughout the courtroom, so thick you could almost reach out and touch it. （读后续写·对峙·紧张）

collocations.phrase: a sense of ... in the air
collocations.example: There was a sense of quiet anticipation in the air, the kind that settles over a crowd just before the curtain rises. （读后续写·期待·剧场）
With blossoms bursting on every branch, there was spring in the air, and even the busiest passers-by slowed to breathe it in. （读后续写·季节·生机）
With candles flickering and soft music drifting from the corner, there was romance in the air that no one dared to break. （读后续写·氛围·爱情）

collocations.translation: 危险的气息，隐隐的危机感
collocations.example: Something felt wrong; there was danger in the air, and every instinct told me to turn back before it was too late. （读后续写·悬疑·预感）
Whether the trip would go ahead at all was still up in the air, and the whole class waited anxiously for the final word. （读后续写·等待·悬念）

synonyms.example: The relief in the classroom was palpable the moment the exam papers were finally collected. （读后续写·如释重负）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：palpable 是形容词，直接修饰情绪（palpable tension），强调'明显到几乎可触摸'；in the air 是短语，作表语或状语，更口语生动，突出'弥漫环绕'之感

synonyms.example: A pervasive sense of unease spread through the village as the strangers rode closer. （读后续写·氛围·不安）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：pervasive 较书面正式，强调'遍及各处、无所不在'；in the air 更形象口语，多用于叙事描写当下弥漫的气氛

synonyms.translation: 未定的（对应 up in the air 义）
synonyms.example: The venue for the concert remained undecided even as ticket sales opened. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：undecided 直白中性，指'尚未做出决定'；up in the air 更形象口语，含'悬着、令人不安'的意味，情感色彩更强

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in the air 与 air 系列习语辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件·对比】in the air 可感觉到、弥漫（excitement/romance in the air）↔ on the air 正在播送 / off the air 停止播送 ↔ up in the air 悬而未决 ↔ put on airs 摆架子 ↔ an air of confidence 一副自信的样子
advancedExpressions.example: Romance was in the air, but the wedding date was still up in the air; on the air the host put on airs, while the bride kept an air of quiet confidence. 浪漫气息弥漫，可婚期仍悬而未决；直播中主持人摆足了架子，新娘却始终一副从容自信的样子。（课件语法点：一句辨析 in/on/up in the air 与 put on airs·an air of）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·in the air / air 习语
advancedExpressions.expression: sth is in the air 弥漫·在酝酿（课文）/ up in the air 悬而未决 / clear the air 消除误会 / a change is in the air 变革将至 / vanish into thin air 凭空消失 / castles in the air 空中楼阁
advancedExpressions.example: Change was in the air, our plans were up in the air, yet one honest talk cleared the air at last. （一句话串联三个 air 习语，帮助辨析）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表示'某种气氛弥漫、可感觉到'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: sth is in the air = sth is palpable = there is a sense of sth around = sth hangs over the place = you can feel sth everywhere
advancedExpressions.example: Festivity was in the air / The festive mood was palpable / You could feel the festivity everywhere — 三种表达都写'节日气氛弥漫'。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·there be / be 作表语
advancedExpressions.expression: There was + 情绪名词 + in the air / 情绪名词 + was in the air（in the air 作表语或地点状语）
advancedExpressions.example: There was tension in the air. = Tension was in the air. 空气中弥漫着紧张。（两种句式皆可，抽象名词作主语用单数动词）

advancedExpressions.expression: I could feel it already — ... was in the air
advancedExpressions.example: I could feel it already — the thrill of the festival was in the air, throbbing in the drumbeats and glittering in every stranger's smile. （用破折号 + 'in the air' 铺陈弥漫氛围，开篇即调动感官）

advancedExpressions.expression: as ... approaches, a spirit of ... is in the air; I therefore propose ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the winter break approaches, a spirit of giving is in the air; I therefore propose that our class organize a charity drive for the children's hospital. （倡议书中以'氛围'引出提议，自然而有感染力）

advancedExpressions.expression: when ... is in the air, the question is not whether ... but how ...
advancedExpressions.example: When sweeping technological change is in the air, the real question is not whether we should adapt, but how swiftly and wisely we choose to do so. （用'不是...而是...'重构议题，凸显思辨深度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I could feel that the Carnival was coming.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I could feel it already — the Carnival was in the air, pulsing in the distant drums, shimmering in the heat, glittering in the eyes of everyone I passed. （读后续写·节庆·感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号引出顿悟 + in the air 弥漫感 + 三个现在分词短语（pulsing / shimmering / glittering）排比铺陈听觉、体感、视觉，画面沸腾立体

sentenceUpgrade.original: Nobody had decided the plan yet, and everyone was worried.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With the final decision still up in the air, an anxious hush settled over us all, each mind quietly rehearsing the worst even as we hoped for the best. （读后续写·悬念·群像）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With + 独立主格（up in the air）作背景 + an anxious hush settled 拟人化氛围 + each mind rehearsing...even as... 让步分句刻画群体心理，张力十足

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: He scored the winning goal in the final and there was ____ ____ ____ ____. （四处都能感觉到兴奋的氛围）
classPractice.note: 【课件】in the air 可感觉到、弥漫着；主语为抽象情绪名词 excitement

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件对比原题）
classPractice.question: With such loyal viewers, these programmes don't need high ratings to stay ____ ____ ____. （继续播出）
classPractice.note: 【课件·对比】on the air 正在播送 ≠ in the air 弥漫；stay on the air 继续播出

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件对比原题）
classPractice.question: The summer travel plan is still ____ ____ ____ ____ because of the tight budget. （悬而未决）
classPractice.note: 【课件·对比】up in the air 悬而未决、尚未确定；in the air 只表'气氛弥漫'

classPractice.type: 语境应用·填空（课件对比原题）
classPractice.question: He is anything but an easy-going person. He is always ____ ____ ____. （摆架子）
classPractice.note: 【课件·对比】put on airs 摆架子、装腔作势（air 用复数 airs）

classPractice.question: 我已经能感觉到了——狂欢节的气氛正在弥漫！I could feel it already—the Carnival ____ ____ ____ ____!
classPractice.note: 课文原句；in the air 作表语，主语为单数，谓语用 was

classPractice.question: 选 in the air / up in the air 填空：Whether the concert will be held is still ____.
classPractice.note: up in the air 悬而未决；in the air 只表'气氛弥漫'，不表'未定'

classPractice.question: As spring returned, a sense of new hope was ____ the air across the whole town.
classPractice.note: 固定习语 in the air 弥漫着；介词 in 不可换 on/at

original_sentence: I arrived just in time—the show was about to begin as I took my place in the merry crowd.
readingExamples: I arrived just in time—the show was about to begin as I took my place in the merry crowd.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. happy and cheerful, especially in a lively, festive way
(2) adj. filled with fun, laughter and celebration (as in Merry Christmas)
(3) adj. (British, informal) slightly drunk; tipsy in a good-humoured way
(4) adj. bright and pleasant in colour or sound

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①愉快的，欢乐的（尤指热闹、喜庆场合）
uncommonMeanings.example: The children's merry laughter filled the garden. 孩子们欢快的笑声充满了花园。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (英式口语)微醉的;有几分醉意的
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time the toasts were done, Uncle Tom had grown decidedly merry, his cheeks flushed pink as he insisted, over everyone's laughter, on singing one more old sailor's song. （读后续写·家宴·热闹）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the drums began to thunder, a merry crowd surged into the square, faces painted in a hundred colours, and I found myself swept along, laughing, clapping, utterly unable to stand still. （读后续写·狂欢节·融入人群）
On behalf of the Students' Union, I warmly invite every family to our merry New Year gala, an evening of music, games and shared laughter where no one leaves as a stranger. （应用文·邀请信）
A merry heart, as the old saying reminds us, does more good than any medicine, for genuine cheerfulness lightens not only our own burdens but also those of everyone around us. （议论文·心态与健康）
Somewhere down the lane a merry tune drifted from an open window, and for a fleeting moment the tired travellers forgot the long road behind them and simply smiled. （读后续写·环境·治愈）

wordForms.adjective: merry (adj. 欢乐的);merrier / merriest (比较级/最高级)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：merry (adj.) → merrily (adv.) → merriment (n. 欢乐)。构词法/特例：以辅音+y 结尾，变副词/比较级须把 y 变 i：merry→merrily / merrier / merriest；名词 merrymaking 寻欢作乐。贴士：merry 多用于节日、聚会等热闹场景，日常'高兴'更常用 happy

idioms.translation: 人越多越热闹;多多益善
idioms.example: "Bring your friends too — the more the merrier!" she called over her shoulder, already setting extra plates around the crowded table. （读后续写·聚会·热情）
As the last lantern was lit, the whole village gathered by the river to make merry, and the sound of drums and laughter rolled on late into the warm summer night. （读后续写·节庆·欢庆）

idioms.idiom: lead sb a merry dance / chase
idioms.translation: 使某人白费力气;把某人耍得团团转
idioms.example: The clever little fox led the hunters a merry chase through the frosty woods, doubling back on its own tracks until they gave up in exhaustion. （读后续写·机智·追逐）

idioms.translation: 自顾自地(轻松愉快地)走开
idioms.example: Having said his piece and helped himself to a second slice of cake, the old man went on his merry way, whistling as though he had not a care in the world. （读后续写·人物·洒脱）

collocations.translation: 欢乐的人群（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The show was about to begin as I took my place in the merry crowd. 我在欢乐的人群中站定，演出即将开始。（课文原句）
Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year to you all! 祝大家圣诞快乐、新年幸福！
The whole village gathered to make merry on midsummer night. 全村人聚在一起，在仲夏之夜尽情欢乐。
I took my place in the merry crowd just as the first float rounded the corner, and a wave of colour and rhythm broke over us all. （读后续写·狂欢·人群）
A merry laugh escaped the little girl as the puppy chased its own tail, and even the stern old gardener could not help grinning. （读后续写·童趣·温情）
"Merry Christmas!" the children chorused at the doorstep, their breath rising in little clouds, their cheeks red with cold and delight. （读后续写·节日·温馨）
The old fiddler struck up a merry tune, and within moments feet were tapping and hands were clapping all around the firelit hall. （读后续写·乡村舞会·热闹）

collocations.phrase: a merry time / a merry evening
collocations.example: We spent a merry evening exchanging stories around the campfire until the stars faded and the first grey light crept over the hills. （读后续写·露营·欢聚）

collocations.phrase: merry with wine / merry from the punch
collocations.example: A little merry from the festive punch, the shy accountant surprised everyone by leading the whole office in a wobbly, joyful conga line. （读后续写·聚会·反差）
A steady supply of hot cocoa and silly jokes kept the stranded passengers merry despite the long delay at the snowbound station. （读后续写·困境·苦中作乐）

synonyms.example: Despite the pouring rain, the guide stayed remarkably cheerful, cracking jokes until even the grumpiest tourist began to smile. （读后续写·态度·感染力）
synonyms.usage: cheerful 侧重内在的、稳定的"心情愉快、乐观",可形容人的性格;merry 更强调外在的、当下的"欢闹、喜庆",多用于节日、聚会等热闹场合。句法：both 作定语或表语，a cheerful/merry person

synonyms.example: The jolly innkeeper flung open the door, boomed a welcome that shook the rafters, and ushered the frozen travellers toward the roaring fire. （读后续写·人物·热情）
synonyms.usage: jolly 与 merry 意思很近,都指"快活热闹";jolly 更口语、更偏英式,常形容人饱满外放的好心情,而 merry 更常搭配节日与场景(Merry Christmas / a merry crowd)

synonyms.example: By dusk the whole street had taken on a festive glow, red lanterns swaying above stalls that spilled over with sweets and toys. （读后续写·节日·氛围）
synonyms.usage: festive 专指"节日般的、喜庆的氛围",侧重场合与环境;merry 既可写氛围(a merry crowd)也可写人的心情,情感更直接

advancedExpressions.expression: a merry crowd 欢乐人群（课文）/ Merry Christmas 圣诞快乐 / make merry 寻欢作乐 / the more the merrier 多多益善 / go on one's merry way 自顾自离开 / lead sb a merry dance 把人耍得团团转
advancedExpressions.example: "The more the merrier!" she cried, and the merry crowd made merry late into the night. （一句话串起 merry 的常见搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：形容'欢乐、喜庆'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: merry = cheerful = jolly = joyful = in high spirits = full of cheer
advancedExpressions.example: The merry / cheerful / jolly crowd sang all the way home, everyone in high spirits. （多种表达可替换，写'欢乐人群'）

advancedExpressions.expression: merry (adj.) → 去 y 加 ily → merrily (adv.) → merry + ment → merriment (n.)；比较级 merrier / 最高级 merriest
advancedExpressions.example: The band played merrily, and the whole hall rang with merriment. （形容词→副词→名词，注意 y→i 的拼写变化）

advancedExpressions.expression: swept along by the merry crowd, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Swept along by the merry crowd, I forgot my shyness entirely, my feet finding the rhythm before my mind could even catch up. （过去分词短语前置写"被人群裹挟",动作先于意识,凸显忘我投入,狂欢/庆典段落常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: join us for a merry evening of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Do join us for a merry evening of music, laughter and friendship — I promise you will leave with a warmer heart than the one you came with. （祈使句 Do join... 加强邀请语气 + of 引出活动内容,邀请信温情收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: a merry heart does more good than ...
advancedExpressions.example: A merry heart, science now confirms, does more good than any bottle of pills, for laughter eases the mind, strengthens the body and knits us closer to one another. （借谚语立论 + 三重递进说明积极心态的价值,观点论证段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I joined the happy crowd and watched the show.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I slipped into the merry crowd just as the show was about to begin, and at once the drums, the colours and the swaying sea of strangers wrapped around me like a warm tide, until I was no longer a watcher but a part of it all. （读后续写·融入·多感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: slipped into 替换 joined 更有画面 + as...about to begin 制造"恰好赶上"的临场感 + 明喻(like a warm tide) + no longer...but 由"旁观"到"融入"的身份转变升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Being cheerful is good for your health.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is by now well established that a merry, hopeful disposition is one of the surest safeguards of our health, easing the tension of the mind and, in doing so, quietly strengthening the body it inhabits. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is well established that... 正式立论句式 + one of the surest safeguards 名词化提升书面感 + 现在分词状语(easing..., strengthening...)展开机制,层层论证

classPractice.question: The band played on and the children danced ____ (merry) around the fire.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 danced 须用副词 merrily；merry 以辅音+y 结尾，变副词把 y 变 i

classPractice.question: The whole village gathered by the river to ____ ____ late into the night. （尽情欢乐）
classPractice.note: make merry 寻欢作乐，尽情欢乐；固定搭配

classPractice.question: 选 merry / cheerful 填空：By the fireside the ____ crowd sang carol after carol on Christmas Eve.
classPractice.note: merry 多用于节日/热闹场合（a merry crowd, Merry Christmas）；cheerful 侧重个人稳定的乐观心情

translation: 乐队，乐团；一伙，一帮；带，箍
original_sentence: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street.
readingExamples: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a group of musicians who play popular music together
(2) n. a group of people who share a common purpose or act together; a gang or company
(3) n. a thin, flat strip of material used for fastening, binding or decorating
(4) n. a range of numbers, values or frequencies within a larger set (e.g. an age band, a radio band)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①乐队，乐团（演奏流行、爵士、进行曲等的一群乐手）
uncommonMeanings.example: The band played on the stage all evening. 乐队整晚都在台上演奏。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一伙人;一帮(常指志同道合或聚在一起行动的一群人)
uncommonMeanings.example: By nightfall a small band of villagers had gathered at the flooded bridge, ropes and lanterns in hand, each silently resolved to reach the stranded family on the far bank. （读后续写·救援·团结）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 带;箍;条纹(细长的一条材料或颜色)
uncommonMeanings.example: She wore a plain silver band on her wrist, worn thin by the years, and whenever the road grew hard she would touch it and remember the mother who had given it to her. （读后续写·信物·思念）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (数值/频率的)范围;等级;波段
uncommonMeanings.example: Students whose scores fall within the top band will be invited to represent the school at the national contest, so every mark you earn this term truly counts. （应用文·通知）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （band together）联合，团结起来
uncommonMeanings.example: The workers banded together to demand fairer pay. 工人们联合起来要求更公平的工资。

posExamples.sentence: As I turned the corner, I could see a group of dancers and a band in dazzling costumes filling the narrow street, brass horns flashing in the sunlight, drums already trembling with a rhythm that would soon set the whole crowd alight. （读后续写·狂欢节·登场）
On behalf of the music society, I am writing to invite your band to perform at our annual charity concert, an event whose proceeds will support children in remote mountain schools. （应用文·邀请信）

A band is far more than a collection of talented individuals; it succeeds only when each player learns to listen, to yield and to blend, so that many separate voices become a single, unforgettable sound. （议论文·团队合作）
Together this ragged band of volunteers rebuilt the flood-ruined library shelf by shelf, and though not one of them was paid a single coin, none of them had ever felt richer. （读后续写·公益·奉献）

wordForms.noun: band / bandstand (n. 乐队;露天音乐台)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：band (n./v.) → banded (adj.) → bandstand (n. 露天音乐台)。一词多义速记：band = 乐队（a jazz band）/ 一伙人（a band of robbers）/ 带·箍（a rubber band）/ 等级·波段（an age band）。特例：band together 联合起来（作动词，常加 together）

idioms.example: When the drought threatened to ruin every farm in the valley, the families finally banded together, sharing what little water they had until the first rains returned. （读后续写·困境·团结）
The wind howled to beat the band that night, rattling every shutter, yet inside the little cottage the fire crackled on and no one felt the least bit afraid. （读后续写·风暴·反衬温暖）

collocations.translation: 一支穿着华丽服装的乐队（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street. 我能看到约二十名巴西舞者和一支穿着华丽服装的乐队站在街上。（课文原句）
She tied her hair back with a rubber band. 她用一根橡皮筋把头发扎起来。
A band of robbers hid in the forest. 一伙强盗藏在森林里。

collocations.phrase: a rock / jazz / brass / marching band
collocations.translation: 摇滚/爵士/铜管/行进乐队
collocations.example: The marching band swept past in perfect formation, every trumpet lifted to the sun, and the pavement itself seemed to vibrate beneath our feet. （读后续写·游行·气势）
Four shy classmates who could barely speak to one another decided to form a band, and it was on that cramped garage stage that they finally found their voices. （读后续写·青春·成长）
Nervous but determined, she asked to join the school band, never guessing that the drum sticks she picked up that afternoon would one day carry her onto a national stage. （读后续写·转折·梦想）
The band struck up an energetic samba beat, and in a single heartbeat the whole square dissolved into a swirl of colour, motion and joy. （读后续写·狂欢·爆发）
A small band of friends stood by him when everyone else turned away, and years later he would say that those few loyal souls had saved his life. （读后续写·友情·患难）

collocations.translation: 联合起来(对抗/去做某事)
collocations.example: The residents banded together to protest against the plan to fell the ancient oak, and their united voice proved impossible to ignore. （议论文·公民行动）
She bound the old letters with a fraying rubber band and tucked them away, a small brittle bundle that held forty years of a marriage inside it. （读后续写·信物·岁月）
The survey grouped respondents into four age bands so that the changing attitudes of each generation could be compared at a glance. （应用文·调查报告）
A thin band of gold appeared along the horizon, widening with every second, until at last the sun broke free and set the whole sea ablaze. （读后续写·日出·希望）

synonyms.example: A small group of hikers huddled beneath the cliff, waiting for the storm to pass and trusting the guide to lead them safely down. （读后续写·登山·信任）
synonyms.usage: group 是最通用的"一群/一组",范围极广;band 更强调成员因共同目的而聚集、行动一致,常带"一伙、一帮"的抱团感,情感色彩更浓

synonyms.example: As the conductor raised his baton, the entire orchestra fell silent, poised on the edge of the first great chord. （读后续写·音乐会·蓄势）
synonyms.usage: orchestra 特指规模较大、以弦乐为主的"管弦乐队",演奏古典音乐;band 通常规模较小,以铜管、打击乐或流行乐器为主,演奏流行、爵士、进行曲等

synonyms.example: A gang of masked figures slipped through the back alley, and the shopkeeper's hand froze halfway to the light switch. （读后续写·悬疑·危险）
synonyms.usage: gang 多指"帮派、团伙",常带贬义或指从事不法之事的一伙;band 中性偏正面,可指志愿者、旅人、乐手等因共同目标聚在一起的一群人

advancedExpressions.expression: a band in fancy costumes 乐队（课文）/ a band of robbers 一伙人 / a rubber band 橡皮筋 / an age band 年龄段 / band together 联合起来 / a marching band 行进乐队 / strike up a band 乐队奏响
advancedExpressions.example: A band of villagers banded together, a rubber band round each lantern, while the marching band struck up. （一句话贯通 band 的'乐队·一伙·带子·联合'四义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表示'一群/一帮人'（可替换，据感情色彩选词）
advancedExpressions.expression: a band of people = a group of people = a company of people = a gang of people(贬) = a party of people
advancedExpressions.example: A band / group / party of travellers set off at dawn. 一群旅人黎明出发。（band 含'抱团、志同道合'色彩，gang 多贬义）

advancedExpressions.expression: band (n. 乐队/带) → band (v.) + together → band together 联合；band + ed → banded 有条纹的；band + stand → bandstand 露天音乐台
advancedExpressions.example: The banded flag flew above the bandstand as the villagers banded together to sing. （名词转动词、加后缀、合成词一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.expression: the band struck up ..., and in a single heartbeat ...
advancedExpressions.example: The band struck up its first thunderous note, and in a single heartbeat the sleepy street exploded into music, motion and light. （strike up 专业动词写"乐队奏响" + in a single heartbeat 极短时间状语 + 三名词并列渲染瞬间的爆发,庆典场面常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: we would be honoured if your band could ...
advancedExpressions.example: We would be truly honoured if your band could perform at our charity gala, for your music has a rare power to open hearts and loosen purse strings alike. （We would be honoured if... 谦敬邀请句式,兼顾礼貌与理由,邀请信高级表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: a band succeeds only when each member learns to ...
advancedExpressions.example: A band succeeds only when each member learns to sacrifice a little of his own brilliance for the beauty of the whole — and the same, surely, is true of any team worth belonging to. （以乐队类比团队 + only when 条件强调 + 破折号推及普遍真理,论证结构清晰）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I saw some dancers and a band in the street.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rounding the corner, I came upon a whole troupe of dancers and a band in glittering costumes, their instruments raised and gleaming, poised on the very brink of a music that had not yet begun. （读后续写·登场·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语前置(Rounding the corner)引出视角 + came upon 替换 saw 带偶遇感 + 独立主格(their instruments raised) + poised on the very brink of 制造"蓄势待发"的悬念

sentenceUpgrade.original: The team did well because everyone worked together.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Like a band in which no single instrument dares to drown out the rest, the team triumphed precisely because each member had learned to listen as carefully as to play. （议论文·团队论证）

original_sentence: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street.
readingExamples: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a set of clothes worn by an actor or performer to look like a particular character
(2) n. clothes worn for a special occasion or activity, or typical of a particular country, period or group
(3) n. a set of clothes worn to a party in which people dress up (fancy dress)
(4) n. (British, dated) a woman's matching jacket and skirt; also a swimming costume

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·随costume讲】戏装；装扮用的成套服装（clothes worn by actors or for a special activity）；be in costume (演员)穿着戏装
uncommonMeanings.example: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street; even after the show the actors were still in costume and make-up. 我看到约二十名巴西舞者和一支穿着华丽戏装的乐队站在街上；演出结束后演员们仍是戏装未卸、妆容犹在。（课件：costume 指表演/民族的成套服装，区别于日常 clothes）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①戏装，演出服；化装服（演员/表演者为扮演角色所穿）
uncommonMeanings.example: The actors changed into their costumes backstage. 演员们在后台换上戏装。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (某地区/某时期/某民族)特有的服饰;传统装束
uncommonMeanings.example: On festival mornings the whole village came alive with national costume — embroidered vests, silver headdresses and skirts that swept the ground — as if the old paintings on the temple walls had suddenly stepped into the sunlight. （读后续写·民俗·文化画面）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (英式旧用)游泳衣(swimming costume);女式套装
uncommonMeanings.example: She rolled up her swimming costume in a striped towel, slipped out before dawn, and reached the cold grey sea just as the first swimmers were wading in. （读后续写·清晨·海边）

posExamples.sentence: I could see a group of dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street, and even from a distance the feathers, sequins and streaming ribbons blazed so brightly that I had to shield my eyes. （读后续写·狂欢节·视觉冲击）
I am writing to remind all performers that costumes for Saturday's cultural show must be collected from the drama room by Friday noon, and any damage should be reported at once. （应用文·通知）

Far from being mere decoration, a nation's traditional costume is a wearable history, stitching centuries of belief, climate and craft into every fold, so that to preserve it is to preserve a memory. （议论文·文化传承）

The moment she slipped into the swan costume, something in her transformed; the timid girl vanished, and in her place stood a creature of grace who seemed to have been born for the stage. （读后续写·蜕变·舞台）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：costume (n./vt.) → costumed (adj.) → costumier (n. 制作/供应戏装者)。构词/搭配贴士：'化装舞会'为 costume party / costume ball（costume 作定语，不加 -d）；'穿着戏装'为 in costume / be costumed；辨析 costume（成套表演·民族服装）≠ clothes（日常衣服总称）

collocations.translation: 【课件】穿着华丽的戏装/服装（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street. 我看到约二十名巴西舞者和一支穿着华丽服装的乐队站在街上。（课文原句）
The actors were still in costume and make-up when the reporters rushed backstage. 记者冲进后台时，演员们仍是戏装打扮、妆容未卸。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 穿着华丽的服装（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street. 我能看到约二十名巴西舞者和一支穿着华丽服装的乐队站在街上。（课文原句）
Everyone came to the costume party dressed as their favourite hero. 大家都装扮成自己最喜欢的英雄来参加化装舞会。
The dancers wore the traditional costume of their region. 舞者们穿着他们家乡的传统服饰。

collocations.translation: 华丽的戏装;化装舞会的服装
collocations.example: The dancers whirled past in fancy costumes of scarlet and gold, and the whole street seemed to catch fire with colour. （读后续写·游行·绚烂）
Every child arrived in costume, and for one magical afternoon the classroom was crowded with pirates, princesses and at least three very small dragons. （读后续写·童趣·派对）

collocations.phrase: put on / take off a costume
collocations.example: As she put on the heavy embroidered costume, the weight of a hundred years of tradition seemed to settle gently onto her young shoulders. （读后续写·传承·仪式感）
Guests were kindly encouraged to come in the traditional costume of their home region, turning the hall into a living museum of colour and craft. （应用文·活动邀请）
At the costume ball she recognised no one behind the masks, and the mystery of it all made the evening shimmer with a strange, delicious excitement. （读后续写·舞会·悬念）
Behind the curtain the actors hurried into their stage costumes, hearts pounding, as the murmur of the waiting audience swelled beyond the velvet folds. （读后续写·后台·临演）
The costume designer spent months studying old portraits, determined that every stitch on stage should breathe the very spirit of the age. （议论文·工匠精神）
She packed a spare swimming costume just in case, and it was that small habit of caution that saved the trip when the first one tore on the rocks. （读后续写·细节·未雨绸缪）

synonyms.example: She quickly changed her clothes and hurried out. 她匆匆换了衣服就出门了。
synonyms.usage: clothes 是最普通的'衣服'总称，永远用复数、不可数计数（用 a piece of clothing）；costume 特指演出、化装、民族或某历史时期的成套服装，可数。日常穿的衣服说 clothes，不说 costume

synonyms.translation: 服装;着装(不可数);连衣裙(可数)
synonyms.example: The invitation specified formal dress, so he spent the whole afternoon wrestling with a tie he had not worn in years. （应用文·着装要求）
synonyms.usage: dress 作"着装、装束"讲时较抽象、泛指(formal dress / fancy dress);作可数名词指'连衣裙'。costume 更具体,指某个角色、民族或时期成套的服装实体

synonyms.example: She had chosen the outfit with great care, and as she stepped into the interview room, its quiet elegance said everything her nerves would not let her speak. （读后续写·面试·细节）
synonyms.usage: outfit 泛指"一整套搭配好的日常或场合服装",范围广、日常;costume 特指演出、化装、民族或特定时期的服装,带表演或文化色彩

synonyms.example: The dignitaries arrived in formal attire, their measured steps and sober suits lending the ceremony an air of grave importance. （议论文/应用文·正式场合）
synonyms.usage: attire 是非常正式、书面的"衣着",多用于礼仪、公文语境;costume 侧重表演性或文化性的成套服装,语体较中性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·感官动词 see sb doing / see sb do (省to)
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】感官动词 see/watch/notice/hear/feel + 宾语 + 宾补：宾补用 doing 表'正在进行/一个片段'（see sb doing sth），用省 to 的不定式 do 表'全过程/一次性'（see sb do sth）。课文：I could see ... a band in fancy costumes standing in the street.（see sb doing）；同结构句：I hardly noticed five hours fly by.（notice sb/sth do，省 to）
advancedExpressions.example: I saw the dancers whirling in costume (doing·进行片段), and later I noticed five whole hours fly by (do·全过程，省 to). 我看见舞者们穿着戏装旋转（正在进行）；后来才发觉整整五个小时飞逝而过（全过程，不定式省 to）。（课件语法点·感官动词 see sb doing vs see sb do）

advancedExpressions.example: In fancy costumes and national costume alike, the dancers filled the costume ball with colour. （一句话串起 costume 的常见搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表示'服装/衣着'（据语体·场合选词）
advancedExpressions.expression: costume(表演·民族·成套) / clothes(日常总称) / dress(着装或连衣裙) / outfit(一套搭配) / attire(正式书面)
advancedExpressions.example: For the show she wore a splendid costume; for the interview, a smart outfit; for the gala, formal attire. （三种场合三种词，凸显 costume 的表演文化色彩）

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment she slipped into the costume, something in her ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment she slipped into the costume, something in her quietly changed, and the frightened child who had entered the wings walked out, moments later, as a queen. （The moment... 引导瞬时转变 + something in her changed 内在觉醒 + child...queen 前后身份对照,凸显蜕变,续写高潮段常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: participants are kindly reminded to ... their costumes by ...

advancedExpressions.expression: a costume is not merely ... but a wearable ...
advancedExpressions.example: A traditional costume is not merely cloth and thread but a wearable history, in every fold of which the beliefs of a whole people are quietly kept alive. （not merely...but... 递进否定 + wearable history 新颖比喻 + in every fold of which 定语从句深化,文化保护主题升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dancers wore beautiful costumes.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The dancers swept by in costumes so dazzling — a riot of feathers, sequins and streaming silk — that for a moment I forgot to breathe, and the ordinary street seemed to melt into a dream. （读后续写·视觉冲击·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: so...that 结果状语强调震撼程度 + 破折号插入细节(feathers, sequins, silk) + forgot to breathe 以生理反应写惊艳 + melt into a dream 虚实转化收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Traditional costumes are an important part of our culture.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Traditional costume is among the most eloquent of all cultural treasures, for it carries in every embroidered thread the climate, the faith and the craft of the ancestors who first wore it. （议论文·文化传承）

original_sentence: The band started playing an energetic samba beat, the dancers twisted and turned, and the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing.
readingExamples: The band started playing an energetic samba beat, the dancers twisted and turned, and the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a lively Brazilian dance with African roots, performed with quick, swinging steps
(2) n. a piece of music with a strong, syncopated rhythm written for this dance
(3) vi. to dance the samba

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①桑巴舞（起源于巴西、有非洲根源、节奏欢快的一种舞蹈）
uncommonMeanings.example: The samba is Brazil's most famous dance. 桑巴舞是巴西最著名的舞蹈。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②桑巴舞曲（为这种舞蹈所写的、节奏强烈切分的乐曲）
uncommonMeanings.example: The band played a lively samba. 乐队演奏了一首欢快的桑巴舞曲。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③跳桑巴舞
uncommonMeanings.example: They sambaed through the streets until dawn. 他们跳着桑巴舞穿过大街，直到天亮。

posExamples.sentence: The band struck up an energetic samba beat, and at once the dancers twisted and turned like flames in the wind, while the crowd around me began to cheer, clap and sing until the whole street pulsed as one living thing. （读后续写·狂欢节·律动）
I am writing to invite all students to our Culture Festival, where a Brazilian teacher will lead a beginner's samba workshop, so bring comfortable shoes and an open heart. （应用文·邀请信）
The samba is far more than a dance; born of hardship and hope in Brazil's crowded neighbourhoods, it shows how a people can turn suffering into rhythm and sorrow into celebration. （议论文·文化与民族精神）
Long after midnight the last couples were still sambaing beneath the swaying lanterns, their tireless feet keeping a rhythm that seemed as if it might never, ever stop. （读后续写·狂欢·尽兴）

wordForms.other: 专有名词/文化词，词形变化少。搭配贴士：既可作名词（dance the samba，前加定冠词 the 指这一舞种），也可作不及物动词（they sambaed 他们跳桑巴）；相关词 sambista 桑巴舞者/音乐人、samba school 桑巴舞团。同类舞种词：tango 探戈、waltz 华尔兹、salsa 萨尔萨

collocations.translation: 充满活力的桑巴节奏（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The band started playing an energetic samba beat, the dancers twisted and turned. 乐队奏起充满活力的桑巴节奏，舞者们扭动旋转。（课文原句）
She learned to dance the samba in Rio. 她在里约学会了跳桑巴舞。
The very first samba beat set my heart racing, and before I knew it my feet had found the pulse of it all on their own. （读后续写·狂欢·身不由己）

collocations.phrase: dance the samba / do the samba
collocations.example: Shy as she was, she let a laughing stranger pull her into the crowd, and soon she was dancing the samba as though she had known the steps all her life. （读后续写·突破自我·融入）

collocations.translation: 桑巴舞团(尤指里约狂欢节参赛团体)
collocations.example: Each samba school had spent an entire year rehearsing, and now, as their float rounded the corner, that year of sweat and hope blazed into a single glorious parade. （读后续写·狂欢节·厚积薄发）
When the band struck up a samba, even the tired policemen at the barrier began, ever so slightly, to sway. （读后续写·氛围·感染力）
A samba dancer in a headdress of scarlet feathers led the procession, her every step so effortless that the drums seemed to follow her rather than the other way round. （读后续写·领舞·风采）

synonyms.example: As the music swelled, they rose and joined the dance, their earlier quarrel forgotten in the shared joy of the moment. （读后续写·和解·欢庆）
synonyms.usage: dance 是"舞蹈/跳舞"的统称,涵盖一切舞种;samba 特指起源于巴西、节奏欢快的一种具体舞蹈,写异域文化或狂欢场景时用之更精准生动

synonyms.example: The whole town gave itself over to the carnival, and for three days work, worry and rank all dissolved into one great river of music and colour. （读后续写·节庆·全民狂欢）
synonyms.usage: carnival 指整个"狂欢节/嘉年华"活动或氛围;samba 是狂欢节中的核心舞蹈与音乐,二者是"整体"与"元素"的关系,不可互换

advancedExpressions.expression: an energetic samba beat 充满活力的桑巴节奏（课文）/ dance·do the samba 跳桑巴 / a samba school 桑巴舞团 / play·strike up a samba 奏起桑巴曲 / a samba dancer 桑巴舞者

advancedExpressions.expression: the band struck up a samba, and at once ...
advancedExpressions.example: The band struck up a samba, and at once the crowd dissolved into a swirl of colour and motion, every stranger suddenly a friend, every heartbeat suddenly a drum. （strike up 写乐起 + at once 承接瞬间反应 + dissolved into a swirl 化人群为漩涡 + every...suddenly... 排比升华集体狂欢）

advancedExpressions.expression: join us and let the rhythm of the samba ...
advancedExpressions.example: Come and join us, and let the joyful rhythm of the samba sweep away a whole term's worries in a single unforgettable evening. （祈使句 Come and join us + let 引导使役,以"节奏扫去烦恼"作诱人号召,邀请信生动收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: the samba shows how a people can turn ... into ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The samba is a famous dance from Brazil.

(2) v. to wind or wrap things around each other; to curve or wind (of a road, river, etc.)
(3) v. to injure a joint by turning it suddenly and awkwardly
