uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】旋，拧，转动（手柄、瓶盖、绳等）；扭（头、身体）（twist the knob / twist off the cap / twist one's head）
uncommonMeanings.example: Twist the knob to the left to open the door; then twist off the cap of the bottle. 向左转动手柄开门，再旋开瓶盖。（课件搭配 twist the knob / twist off the lid/cap）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】the twists and turns 一波三折；曲折起伏（既指山路蜿蜒，也指经历/故事的跌宕）
uncommonMeanings.example: the twists and turns of his political career 他政治生涯的一波三折（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (情节的)意外转折；出人意料的变化（a twist in the plot；a strange twist of fate 命运的捉弄）
uncommonMeanings.example: The story took a sudden twist when the beggar turned out to be a rich stranger. 当那乞丐原来是个富有的陌生人时，故事陡然反转。（读后续写·反转）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 命运的捉弄，造化弄人（by a twist of fate）
uncommonMeanings.example: By a strange twist of fate, his old rival became his son's coach. 命运弄人，他昔日的对手竟成了他儿子的教练。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 歪曲；曲解(话语、事实)
uncommonMeanings.example: The newspaper twisted her words until she looked like a fool. 报纸曲解她的话，直到把她说成个傻瓜。（议论文·舆论）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 扭伤(关节)
uncommonMeanings.example: She twisted her ankle badly yet limped to the finish line. 她扭伤了脚踝，却一瘸一拐走到了终点。

posExamples.sentence: The dancers twisted and turned in a blur of feathers and light, their bodies bending to the drumbeat as if the music itself were pulling invisible strings, and I felt my own feet begin to move against my will. （读后续写·狂欢·律动）
Please do not twist the safety valve too far to the right, as over-tightening it may damage the seal and cause the machine to leak. （应用文·操作说明/须知）
Those who twist the truth for short-term gain may win an argument today, but they slowly forfeit the one thing no clever words can ever buy back — the trust of the people around them. （议论文·诚信）

The narrow mountain path twisted upward through the pines, doubling back on itself so often that the weary travellers began to fear the summit was nothing more than a cruel and beautiful lie. （读后续写·登山·艰险）

wordForms.noun: twist（扭转；转折）/ twister（旋风；绕口令）
wordForms.verb: twist（过去式/过去分词 twisted，规则变化）
wordForms.adjective: twisted（扭曲的）/ twisty（弯弯曲曲的）
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：twist(v.扭/n.转折) → twisted(adj.扭曲的、变态的) → twister(n.龙卷风)。贴士：twist and turn 三义合一（舞动/道路蜿蜒/辗转反侧），靠语境判断；a twist of fate 是固定搭配，twist 此处为名词'转折'。

idioms.example: By a strange twist of fate, the very rival who had once cost him the championship became, years later, the coach who guided his son to gold. （读后续写·命运·因果轮回）

idioms.translation: (半开玩笑地)极力劝说;施压逼迫某人
idioms.example: "You don't need to twist my arm," she laughed, already reaching for her coat; a chance to see the sea again was the easiest 'yes' she had ever given. （读后续写·邀约·爽快）

idioms.translation: (道路/河流)蜿蜒曲折;辗转反侧
idioms.example: The road twisted and turned along the cliff edge, and with every hairpin bend the drop below yawned wider and the driver's knuckles grew a shade whiter. （读后续写·险途·紧张）

idioms.idiom: twist sb round one's little finger
idioms.translation: 把某人玩弄于股掌之间;任意摆布
idioms.example: The clever child could twist her grandfather round her little finger, and one pleading look was enough to melt every stern rule he had ever laid down. （读后续写·祖孙·亲情）

collocations.example: He twisted his head around to look at her. 他扭过头去看她。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】转动手柄/旋钮；捻/转（绳子）
collocations.example: Twist the knob to the left to open the door. 向左转动手柄把门打开。（课件原句；Nervously I twisted the string on my hoodie. 我紧张地转着连帽衫上的绳子）
She twisted off the lid and poured out the last of the water. 她旋开盖子，倒出了最后一点水。（课件搭配 twist off the lid/cap）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（道路/河流）蜿蜒曲折；扭动；辗转（课文原句：the dancers twisted and turned）
collocations.example: The road twists and turns along the coast. 道路沿着海滨蜿蜒曲折。（课件原句；课文：The dancers twisted and turned, and the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing.）
The newspaper was accused of twisting the facts. 这家报纸被指责歪曲事实。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: the twists and turns of sth (n.)
collocations.translation: 【课件】（经历/故事/道路的）一波三折；曲折起伏
collocations.example: the twists and turns of his political career 他政治生涯的一波三折（课件原句；... of the mountain road / ... in the story 山路的蜿蜒 / 故事的曲折）
He twisted his wrist in the fall but never stopped smiling. 他摔倒时扭伤了手腕，却始终微笑着。
With trembling hands she twisted open the rusted lid. 她双手颤抖，拧开了生锈的盖子。

collocations.phrase: twist the truth / twist sb's words
collocations.translation: 歪曲事实/曲解某人的话
collocations.example: It is all too easy to twist a person's words online. 在网上曲解一个人的话太容易了。

collocations.phrase: a twist in the plot / a plot twist
collocations.example: A final twist in the plot turned everything on its head. 最后的情节反转让一切彻底翻转。
The little boy twisted and squirmed in his seat throughout the long ceremony. 整场漫长仪式里小男孩都在座位上扭来扭去。

collocations.phrase: give sth a twist / add a twist to sth
collocations.example: The young chef gave the family recipe a modern twist. 年轻厨师给家传食谱加了现代新意。
Pain twisted his features for the briefest instant. 痛苦在瞬间扭曲了他的面容。

synonyms.example: She turned the ancient key slowly, and with a groan of protesting iron the door swung inward onto a room untouched for half a century. （读后续写·探秘·悬念）
synonyms.usage: turn 是最普通的"转动/转弯",动作单一;twist 强调"扭动、拧转",常含反复、用力或身体的弯曲,画面感更强,也可指情节反转、歪曲事实等抽象义

synonyms.example: The little stream wound lazily through the meadow, catching the last of the evening light in its slow silver curves. （读后续写·环境·宁静）
synonyms.usage: wind 侧重"平缓地蜿蜒、缠绕",常写河流、道路、藤蔓;twist 蜿蜒时更强调急促、曲折、反复(twist and turn),动态更强烈

synonyms.example: Fear has a way of distorting memory, so that the harmless shadow he passed becomes, in the retelling, a monster with glowing eyes. （议论文·记忆与心理）
synonyms.usage: distort 是较正式的"扭曲、使失真",可指形状、声音、事实;twist 作"歪曲"讲更口语、更具体,常指故意曲解话语或事实(twist sb's words)

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·twist 词块（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: twist one's head 扭头 · twist the knob 转动手柄 · twist off the cap 旋开瓶盖 · twist and turn 蜿蜒/扭动 · twist the facts 歪曲事实 · the twists and turns 一波三折
advancedExpressions.example: He twisted his head around, twisted off the cap, and told a story full of the twists and turns of his own life. 他扭头旋开瓶盖，讲起自己一波三折的人生。（课件短语群串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·twist 词块（课堂重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: twist and turn 扭动/蜿蜒/辗转 · twist the truth 歪曲事实 · a twist of fate 命运的捉弄 · a plot twist 情节反转 · twist sb's arm 极力劝说某人
advancedExpressions.example: By a twist of fate, the road that twisted and turned for hours led them straight home. 命运弄人，那条蜿蜒数小时的路竟直通他们的家。（短语群串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达'转动/弯曲'（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: twist / turn / wind / curve / coil（均可表'转、弯、绕'，据画面强度替换）
advancedExpressions.example: The path twisted (turned / wound / curved) up the hill. 小路蜿蜒上山。（twist 最强调急促曲折，wind 最平缓）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. twisted and turned as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The dancers twisted and turned as if the drumbeat had set their bones alight. 舞者们扭动旋转，仿佛鼓点点燃了他们的骨骼。（twist and turn 写舞动 + as if 虚拟夸张，感官渲染狂欢）

advancedExpressions.expression: please do not twist ... too far, as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please do not twist the knob too far, as forcing it may strip the thread. 请勿把旋钮拧得过头，用力过猛会滑丝。（祈使句 + as 引原因，说明书规范句）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who twist the truth may ..., but they forfeit ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who twist the truth may win an argument today, but they forfeit the trust no clever words can buy back. 歪曲真相者今日或能赢得争论，却失去了再巧的言辞也买不回的信任。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dancers twisted and turned to the music.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To the pounding pulse of the drums the dancers twisted and turned, their bodies flowing like water one instant and snapping like whips the next, until it was impossible to tell where the music ended and the movement began. （读后续写·舞蹈·动态美）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 状语前置(To the pounding pulse...)定基调 + like water / like whips 一柔一刚双重明喻 + until it was impossible to tell... 虚实交融升华,写出人乐合一

sentenceUpgrade.original: The road was very winding and dangerous.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mountain road twisted and turned along the sheer cliff face, each blind bend swallowing the last, so that the drivers could do nothing but trust the crumbling edge and pray. （读后续写·险途·紧张）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: twist and turn 生动化"蜿蜒" + each...swallowing the last 分词写弯道相接的连绵 + could do nothing but... 强调无助感 + trust...and pray 收束制造悬念

classPractice.question: 用 twist 译：他扭过头去看她。He ____ his head ____ to look at her.
classPractice.note: 课件原句 He twisted his head around to look at her；twist one's head around 扭头

classPractice.question: 用 twist 译：向左转动手柄把门打开。____ the knob to the left to open the door.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；祈使句用动词原形 Twist；twist the knob 转动手柄/旋钮

classPractice.question: 这家报纸被指责歪曲事实。The newspaper was accused of ____ the facts.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；be accused of doing sth，twist the facts 歪曲事实，用动名词 twisting

classPractice.question: 他政治生涯的一波三折 = the ____ ____ ____ of his political career.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；the twists and turns of sth 一波三折/曲折起伏，twist 作名词，复数

classPractice.question: 舞者们扭动旋转，人群开始欢呼、鼓掌、歌唱。The dancers ____ ____ ____, and the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；twist and turn 表'扭动旋转'，此处作不及物动词

classPractice.question: 选 twist 的恰当义项填空：By a strange ____ of fate, the two strangers met again ten years later.
classPractice.note: a twist of fate 命运的捉弄；此处 twist 为名词'转折'

classPractice.question: The mountain road ____ (twist) and turned along the cliff, making every driver nervous.
classPractice.note: 描述过去情景，与并列的 turned 时态一致，用过去式

classPractice.question: 选词：Don't ____ (twist / distort) my words — I never said I would quit.
classPractice.note: 口语中'曲解某人的话'多用 twist sb's words；distort 较正式，多指形状/声音失真

original_sentence: the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing
readingExamples: the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing
definitionEn:
(1) vi. & vt. to hit your hands together repeatedly to show approval, enjoyment or to get attention
(2) vt. to put or place something somewhere quickly and firmly
(3) vt. to hit someone in a friendly way, usually on the back or shoulder
(4) n. a sudden loud noise, especially of thunder; the act or sound of clapping

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (雷的)一声轰响；霹雳（a clap of thunder 一声雷响）
uncommonMeanings.example: A sudden clap of thunder split the silence, and the horses bolted. 一声炸雷划破寂静，马匹惊逃而去。（读后续写·暴风雨）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 迅速(而有力)地放上；猛地拍上（clap a hand over one's mouth 一把捂住嘴）
uncommonMeanings.example: The boy clapped a hand over his mouth, his eyes shining with joy. 男孩一把捂住嘴，双眼因喜悦而发亮。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 友好地拍(某人的肩/背)
uncommonMeanings.example: The old coach clapped him warmly on the shoulder. 老教练亲切地拍了拍他的肩膀。

posExamples.sentence: The moment the dancers finished, the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing all at once, hundreds of hands beating the air together until the whole square seemed to shake with sheer, unstoppable delight. （读后续写·狂欢·全场沸腾）
At the end of each performance, please clap warmly to encourage the young performers, and kindly refrain from taking flash photographs during the show. （应用文·观演须知）
We are quick to clap our hands for the champion who crosses the line first, yet true respect belongs no less to the last runner who, though far behind, refuses to give up. （议论文·体育精神）
A deafening clap of thunder rolled across the valley, and in the sudden silence that followed, the frightened child crept closer and slipped a small trembling hand into mine. （读后续写·暴风雨·亲情）

wordForms.noun: clap（掌声；一声雷）/ clapping（鼓掌）/ clapper（拍手者；铃舌）
wordForms.verb: clap（过去式/过去分词 clapped，双写 p，规则变化）
wordForms.other: 拼写贴士：clap 以'短元音+单辅音'结尾，加 -ed/-ing 时双写 p → clapped / clapping。近义名词 applause（掌声，不可数）比 clap 更正式。

idioms.example: The moment she clapped eyes on the ramshackle little cottage, ivy climbing its crooked walls, she knew beyond all doubt that she had come home at last. （读后续写·一见倾心·归属）

idioms.translation: 把某人投入牢狱;给某人戴上镣铐
idioms.example: In the harsh old days a starving man might be clapped in prison merely for stealing a loaf of bread to feed his crying children. （议论文·历史·法与情）

idioms.idiom: give sb a clap / a big hand
idioms.example: "Let's give our youngest volunteer a big clap!" the host cried, and the applause that followed brought a shy, delighted flush to the little girl's cheeks. （读后续写·表彰·温情）

collocations.translation: 欢呼、鼓掌、歌唱（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The crowd began to cheer, clap and sing. 人群开始欢呼、鼓掌、歌唱。（课文原句）
She clapped her hands with childlike delight at the first snow. 看见初雪，她像孩子般高兴地拍起手来。
With a sudden clap of thunder the storm broke. 随着一声炸雷，暴风雨骤然降临。
The audience clapped so warmly that the young pianist dared to smile. 观众鼓掌如此热烈，年轻钢琴家才敢露出微笑。

collocations.phrase: a round of applause / a clap
collocations.example: A thunderous round of applause swept through the hall. 雷鸣般的掌声席卷了整个大厅。

collocations.phrase: clap sb on the back / shoulder
collocations.translation: 拍某人的背/肩(表鼓励或祝贺)
collocations.example: His teammates crowded round to clap him on the back. 队友们围上来拍他的背。

collocations.phrase: clap one's hand(s) over / to sth
collocations.example: She clapped a hand to her mouth to smother the gasp. 她一把捂住嘴，压住了惊呼。
Soon the whole crowd was clapping along to the samba. 很快全场都跟着桑巴打起了拍子。

synonyms.example: The whole auditorium rose to applaud the young inventor, whose small quiet idea had grown into something that would change countless lives. （议论文/读后续写·赞许）
synonyms.usage: applaud 较正式,既可指"鼓掌"这一动作,也常引申为"赞赏、称许"(applaud a decision);clap 更口语、更具体,专指"拍手"这一物理动作

synonyms.example: As the exhausted runner staggered across the line, the crowd rose to cheer, and the roar of thousands of voices seemed to carry him the final desperate steps. （读后续写·赛场·鼓舞）
synonyms.usage: cheer 是"高声欢呼、喝彩",用嗓音表达兴奋;clap 是"拍手",用手表达赞许。二者常并列出现(cheer and clap),但方式不同

synonyms.example: The nurse patted the frightened old man's hand gently, and something in that small, wordless kindness eased the fear in his tired eyes. （读后续写·安慰·温情）
synonyms.usage: pat 指"轻轻地拍",力度小、动作温柔(pat sb's hand/head);clap 作"拍"讲时力度较大、动作利落(clap sb on the back),二者力度与语气不同

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·clap 词块（课堂重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: clap one's hands 拍手 · cheer, clap and sing 欢呼鼓掌歌唱(课文) · a clap of thunder 一声雷 · clap sb on the back 拍某人的背 · a round of applause 一阵掌声
advancedExpressions.example: As a clap of thunder faded, the crowd began to clap and cheer for the brave singer. 雷声一落，人群便为勇敢的歌手鼓掌欢呼。（短语群串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达'赞许/回应'（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: clap（拍手）/ applaud（鼓掌、赞许）/ cheer（欢呼）/ give sb a big hand（为某人鼓掌）
advancedExpressions.example: The whole hall rose to applaud (clap for / cheer / give a big hand to) the winner. 全场起立为优胜者鼓掌欢呼。

advancedExpressions.expression: the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: The crowd began to cheer, clap and sing, until the ground seemed to tremble with joy. 人群开始欢呼、鼓掌、歌唱，直到脚下的大地都似为喜悦而颤动。（三动词并列 + until 结果 + 夸张渲染集体欢腾）

advancedExpressions.expression: please clap warmly to ..., and kindly refrain from ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please clap warmly to encourage every performer, and kindly refrain from using your phone. 请热情鼓掌鼓励每位表演者，并请勿使用手机。（一正一反，观演须知标配）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are quick to clap for ..., yet ... deserves no less
advancedExpressions.example: We are quick to clap for the winner, yet the quiet worker deserves our applause no less. 我们急于为赢家鼓掌，然而默默耕耘者同样值得掌声。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The crowd clapped and cheered when the dance ended.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant the last dancer froze in her final pose, the crowd erupted, cheering, clapping and stamping as one, and the roar of it rolled down the street like a wave that refused to break. （读后续写·谢幕·沸腾）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant... 引导瞬时反应 + erupted 化静为动 + 三个现在分词并列(cheering, clapping, stamping)叠加动作 + like a wave that refused to break 明喻延展声浪的持久

sentenceUpgrade.original: People clapped for the winner, but the others tried hard too.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We are always ready to clap for the one who finishes first, but the courage of those who stumble, rise and press on to the very end is surely no less worthy of our applause. （议论文·价值论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be always ready to... 概括普遍现象 + but 转折 + stumble, rise and press on 三动词递进写坚持 + no less worthy of... 比较结构强调平等的敬意,升华论点

classPractice.question: 人群开始欢呼、鼓掌、歌唱。The crowd began to ____, ____ and sing.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；cheer, clap and sing 三个动词原形并列作 began to 的宾语

classPractice.question: A sudden ____ (clap) of thunder frightened the children as they slept.
classPractice.note: a clap of thunder 一声雷响；此处 clap 为可数名词

classPractice.question: The audience ____ (clap) enthusiastically the moment the curtain fell.
classPractice.note: clap 双写 p 加 -ed；由 the moment 从句和语境判断为过去时

classPractice.question: 选词：The coach ____ (clapped / patted) him hard on the back to congratulate him.
classPractice.note: clap sb on the back 力度大、动作利落；pat 是'轻拍'，力度小

original_sentence: The whole group started marching down the street.
readingExamples: The whole group started marching down the street.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to walk with regular steps as a group, especially soldiers or marchers moving together
(2) vi. to walk somewhere quickly and in a determined way, often because you are angry or have a clear purpose
(3) vi. to take part in an organized public demonstration by walking through a place
(4) n. an organized walk by many people to express protest or support, or the act of marching

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 行军；游行示威（an organized march 有组织的游行；a protest march 抗议游行；on the march 在行进中）
uncommonMeanings.example: The peaceful march for climate action drew tens of thousands. 那场为气候行动而进行的和平游行吸引了数万人。（议论文·公民行动）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (时间、事件不可阻挡的)进程，推移（the march of time 时间的推移）
uncommonMeanings.example: She felt the relentless march of time pressing upon every weathered stone. 她感到时间无情的脚步压在每一块风化的石头上。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 强行押送，迫使(某人)走（march sb somewhere）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 熟词僻义提示：首字母大写 March 意为'三月'（专有名词，与本词同形不同义）

posExamples.sentence: Drums thundering and banners aloft, the whole team marched down the sunlit street, their heads held high and their voices rising into one triumphant roar that echoed off every building. （读后续写·游行狂欢·画面感）
I would therefore like to propose that on National Fitness Day we march together from the school gate to the city square, spreading the joyful message that exercise belongs to everyone. （应用文·倡议书）
The peaceful march for climate action demonstrated that when ordinary citizens unite behind a common cause, their collective voice can no longer be ignored by those in power. （议论文·公民行动主题）
Furious at the unfair result, he marched straight up to the referee, demanding an explanation before the whole silent stadium. （读后续写·体育冲突·愤怒动作）

wordForms.noun: march（行军；游行）/ marcher（游行者，行进者）
wordForms.verb: march（过去式/过去分词 marched，规则变化）

idioms.translation: 在行军中；在进行中，在发展中
idioms.example: As spring advanced, life was visibly on the march everywhere — buds swelling, streams quickening, and the whole valley stirring back to green. （读后续写·季节·生机复苏）
By launching their eco-project a week early, the rival class stole a march on us and won the school's green award. （读后续写·校园竞争）
When the manager discovered the theft, he gave the dishonest clerk his marching orders on the spot. （读后续写·职场·被辞退）

collocations.translation: 沿街行进（课文原句：started marching down the street）
collocations.example: The whole group started marching down the street. 整队人开始沿街行进。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 抗议游行 / 和平游行
collocations.example: Thousands joined the peace march through the city centre. 数千人加入了穿过市中心的和平游行。

collocations.translation: 在行军中；在进行中，在发展中

As the honour guard marched past, a hush of respect settled over the crowd. 仪仗队走过时，人群肃然起敬，一片寂静。
Undeterred by the storm, the explorers marched on towards the ridge. 探险者不为风暴所阻，向山脊挺进。
Insulted by the remark, she marched off without a backward glance. 被那句话激怒，她头也不回地大步走开。

collocations.translation: 进步 / 历史 / 时间的进程
collocations.example: No one can halt the march of progress once an idea captures people's hearts. 一旦某个理念深入人心，无人能阻挡进步的脚步。
By dawn the volunteers stood in marching order, backpacks strapped tight, ready to set out for the flood-hit village. （读后续写·救灾·出发）

synonyms.example: The winning float paraded slowly through the square while children waved flags from every balcony. （读后续写·庆典）
synonyms.usage: 侧重庆祝、展示性的盛装列队；march 侧重齐步、有节奏或有明确目的（军队/抗议）的行进

synonyms.example: He strode across the room with an air of unshakeable confidence, every step announcing that he had already made up his mind. （读后续写·人物气场）
synonyms.usage: 侧重单人步幅大、有气势的走法；march 强调节奏一致或群体性、目的性

synonyms.example: As the troops advanced under cover of night, an uneasy silence gripped the sleeping town. （读后续写·紧张推进）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，侧重朝目标（尤其军事或抽象目标）向前推进的方向感；march 更强调具体的走的动作

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·march 词块（课堂重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: march down the street 沿街行进(课文) · a protest march 抗议游行 · on the march 在行进中/发展中 · march past 列队走过 · the march of time 时间的进程
advancedExpressions.example: As the parade marched past, the whole town felt the march of history beneath its feet. 游行队伍列队走过，全城都感到历史的脚步在脚下推进。（短语群串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达'行走前进'（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: march（齐步/有目的地行进）/ parade（盛装游行展示）/ stride（大步走）/ advance（推进）
advancedExpressions.example: The soldiers marched (paraded / strode / advanced) across the square. 士兵们走过广场。（march 强调节奏一致或目的性，parade 强调展示）

advancedExpressions.expression: with ... aloft and ... thundering, sb. marched ...
advancedExpressions.example: With banners aloft and drums thundering, the crowd marched forward as one. 旌旗高扬、鼓声如雷，人群齐步向前。（独立主格伴随状语 + as one 强调团结，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us march side by side to ...

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing can halt the march of ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Determined to give voice to the voiceless, thousands marched in solemn protest, urging the authorities to safeguard the ancient forest before it was lost to us forever. （议论文/应用文·公共议题）

original_sentence: The Carnival current carried us through the ever-growing sea of people, dancing all the way.
readingExamples: The Carnival current carried us through the ever-growing sea of people, dancing all the way.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a continuous flowing movement of water, air, or electricity in a particular direction
(2) n. a general tendency or course of events, opinions, or feelings
(3) adj. happening or existing now; belonging to the present time
(4) adj. generally accepted or in common use at the present time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 当前的，现今的（current affairs 时事；current situation 现状）——最常考义项
uncommonMeanings.example: Under current circumstances, the ability to think critically is a necessity. 在当前形势下，批判性思考的能力是一种必需。（议论文·信息时代）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 水流；气流；电流（有方向、有力量的一股流；an electric current 电流）
uncommonMeanings.example: A powerful current suddenly seized the small boat. 一股强劲的水流猛然攫住了小船。（读后续写·遇险）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 思潮，潮流；(情感、思想中潜藏的)暗流，潜流
uncommonMeanings.example: Beneath his polite smile ran a current of resentment. 在他礼貌的微笑之下涌动着一股怨恨的暗流。（读后续写·人物心理）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (货币、票据等)现行流通的，通用的（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old coins were no longer current, yet the grandmother kept them dear. 那些旧币已不再流通，祖母却视若珍宝。

posExamples.sentence: The festive current carried us through the ever-growing sea of dancers, and before I knew it, my feet had surrendered to the rhythm and my worries had melted into the music. （读后续写·嘉年华·随波逐流的沉醉）
I am writing to share my views on the current practice of assigning excessive homework, which, in my humble opinion, deserves serious rethinking by both teachers and parents. （应用文·建议信）
Under current circumstances, where information travels faster than ever, the ability to think critically is no longer a luxury but an absolute necessity. （议论文·信息时代主题）
A powerful current suddenly seized the small boat, and for one heart-stopping moment the fishermen were sure the river would swallow them whole. （读后续写·遇险·惊险瞬间）

wordForms.noun: current（水流/电流/潮流）/ currency（货币；流通）
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：current(n.水流/adj.当前的) → currently(adv.目前) → currency(n.货币，同根'流通'义)。辨形贴士：current 词根 curr-'流'（cf. occur, recur），故'水流'与'当前/流通'义相通。

idioms.translation: 逆流而行；反潮流，特立独行
idioms.example: While her classmates all chased the same fashionable major, she chose to swim against the current and follow her love of ancient languages. （读后续写·坚持自我）
It is easy to go with the current and stay silent, but true character reveals itself the moment we dare to speak up. （议论文·独立人格）

collocations.phrase: the Carnival current / a current of people
collocations.translation: 狂欢的人流（课文原句，把人群喻为水流）
collocations.example: The Carnival current carried us through the ever-growing sea of people, dancing all the way. 狂欢的人流载着我们穿过越聚越多的人海，一路舞动。（课文原句）
Reading about current affairs every morning has broadened my horizons. 每天早晨读时事拓宽了我的视野。
A sudden surge of electric current plunged the lab into darkness. 一股突如其来的电流让实验室陷入黑暗。

collocations.translation: 洋流 / 海流 / 河水
collocations.example: A hidden river current had swept many a strong swimmer far from shore. 暗藏的河流把许多强壮的泳者冲离了岸边。
Rowing against the current tested every ounce of the boy's strength. 逆流划桨考验着男孩的每一分力气。
Given the current situation, we should adopt a more flexible plan. 鉴于当前形势，我们应采取更灵活的方案。
The current trend towards online learning offers great flexibility. 当前的在线学习趋势带来了极大的灵活性。

collocations.translation: 一股气流 / 情绪暗流
collocations.example: As the door creaked open, a cold current of air slipped in. 门吱呀开启，一股冷气流溜了进来。
At its current price, the second-hand telescope was a bargain. 按现价，那台二手望远镜非常划算。

synonyms.example: The steady flow of the stream lulled the weary traveller into a peaceful, dreamless sleep. （读后续写·自然·安宁）
synonyms.usage: 泛指流动本身或流速，较中性；current 更强调有方向、有力量的那股水流/气流/电流

synonyms.example: In the present age of rapid change, adaptability has become the most valuable skill of all. （议论文·时代主题）
synonyms.usage: 作形容词与 current 近义，但 present 更中性平实；current 常暗含'目前正在流行/使用/发生'的动态感

synonyms.example: A worrying trend of screen addiction is quietly reshaping how the young generation communicates. （议论文·社会现象）
synonyms.usage: 名词，侧重可观察的发展方向；current 作'思潮/潮流'义时更文学化、更抽象

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·current 词块（课堂重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: current affairs 时事 · current situation 现状 · electric current 电流 · against the current 逆流/反潮流 · a current of air 一股气流
advancedExpressions.example: Following current affairs helps us judge whether to go with or against the current of opinion. 关注时事有助于我们判断是随波逐流还是逆流而上。（短语群串记）

advancedExpressions.expression: curr-（流动）：current 流/当前的 → currency 货币(流通物) → occur 发生 → recur 再发生
advancedExpressions.example: The word current shares its root with currency: both come from the idea of flowing. current 与 currency 同根，都源于'流动'之义。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达'当前的'（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: current / present / present-day / existing / prevailing 当前的，现行的
advancedExpressions.example: the current (present / existing / prevailing) situation 当前形势。（current 常暗含'正在流行/使用'的动态感）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... current carried sb. through ..., ...ing all the way
advancedExpressions.example: The festive current carried me through the swirling crowd, laughing all the way. 节庆的人流载着我穿过旋转的人群，一路欢笑。（拟物把人群写成水流 + 现在分词伴随）

advancedExpressions.expression: to go against the current requires ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: To go against the current requires uncommon courage, yet such courage has propelled every reformer. 逆流而行需要非凡的勇气，然而正是这种勇气推动了每一位改革者。

advancedExpressions.expression: regarding the current ..., I would like to suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Regarding the current shortage of reading materials in our library, I would like to suggest that a book-donation week be launched this term. （就事论事式建议开头，语气得体）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The crowd took us forward as we danced.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In light of 正式引出背景 + it is imperative that + 虚拟语气 + however 让步插入语 + before 从句制造紧迫感

original_sentence: Iceboxes of soft drinks and beer lined the narrow streets

(1) n. an alcoholic drink made from grain, typically barley, flavoured with hops
(2) n. a glass, bottle, or can of this drink

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 可数与不可数辨析：泛指'啤酒'这种饮料时不可数(drink beer)；点单/指一杯一瓶时可数(two beers 两杯啤酒 = two glasses of beer)

Please be reminded that no beer or other alcoholic drinks may be brought onto the campus during the sports festival, in accordance with school regulations. （应用文·通知）

collocations.phrase: iceboxes of beer / a can of beer

collocations.phrase: a bottle / can / glass of beer

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·beer 词块（课堂重点）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (口语)严厉批评，狠狠数落（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The coach roasted the players for their careless mistakes. 教练为球员们的粗心失误狠狠训了他们一顿。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一块烤肉；一顿烤肉聚餐
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandma's Sunday roast was the highlight of the whole week. 祖母的周日烤肉是整周的重头戏。

posExamples.sentence: The mouth-watering smell of roasting meat filled the air as we passed wave after wave of street stands, and my stomach growled in helpless anticipation. （读后续写·街头美食·嗅觉画面）
For our charity food fair, volunteers will roast sweet potatoes and chestnuts over open coals, with every cent of the proceeds going to the mountain school. （应用文·活动通知）
A steaming plate of roast chicken was placed at the centre of the table, and for the first time in months the whole family gathered, laughing, around one warm meal. （读后续写·团圆·温情）
Some nutritionists argue that roasting vegetables, rather than deep-frying them, preserves far more of their nutrients while cutting harmful fats. （议论文·健康饮食主题）

wordForms.noun: roast（烤肉；烤肉聚餐）/ roaster（烤具；烤肉用的鸡等）
wordForms.verb: roast（过去式/过去分词 roasted，规则变化）
wordForms.adjective: roast（烤的，多作前置定语）/ roasted（烤过的，可后置）
wordForms.other: 形容词辨析贴士：作前置定语惯用 roast chicken / roast beef（固定搭配）；表'已被烤过'的状态或后置修饰多用 roasted（roasted meat / evenly roasted）。课文中 roasted meat 即过去分词作定语。

collocations.translation: 烤肉（课文原句：the smell of roasted meat filled the air）
collocations.example: The smell of roasted meat filled the air as we passed wave after wave of street stands. 我们经过一波又一波的街边摊，烤肉的香味弥漫在空气中。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 烤鸡 / 烤肉 / 烤牛肉
collocations.example: A steaming plate of roast chicken was placed at the centre of the table. 一盘热气腾腾的烤鸡摆在了餐桌中央。
An old man patiently roasted coffee beans by hand. 一位老人耐心地手工烘焙咖啡豆。

collocations.phrase: roast sth. over a fire / on a spit
collocations.translation: 在火上 / 用烤叉烤某物
collocations.example: The scouts roasted marshmallows over the crackling fire. 童子军们在噼啪作响的篝火上烤棉花糖。
She carefully roasted the vegetables in the oven. 她小心地把蔬菜放进烤箱烤。
A traditional roast dinner brought the scattered relatives home. 一顿传统的烤肉大餐把散居的亲人聚回了家。

collocations.translation: 烤得恰到好处的 / 受热均匀的
collocations.example: The evenly roasted chestnuts split open at a touch. 烤得均匀的栗子一碰就裂开。

collocations.translation: 烤肉 / 烤鸡 / 烤牛肉
collocations.example: The aroma of roast beef drifting from the kitchen told the hungry children that Grandma's feast was almost ready. （读后续写·家庭·温馨）

synonyms.example: She spent the whole rainy afternoon baking bread, and the warm scent turned the empty house into a home. （读后续写·治愈·温暖）
synonyms.usage: bake 多用于面包、蛋糕、糕点，靠烤箱干热；roast 多用于肉类、坚果、咖啡豆，可用火或烤箱，常涉及油脂焦香

synonyms.example: Father grilled the fish over glowing charcoal while the children set the picnic table by the lake. （读后续写·郊游）
synonyms.usage: grill 强调用铁架直接近火烤，常见于烧烤；roast 更常指整块肉或坚果的慢火/烤箱烤制

synonyms.translation: 烤（面包、片状食物）至焦黄
synonyms.example: He toasted a few slices of bread over the fire, the edges curling and crisping to a perfect gold. （读后续写·野外早餐）
synonyms.usage: toast 特指把面包等薄片烤脆变色；roast 用于块状肉类或颗粒状食材

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·roast 词块（课堂重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: roasted meat 烤肉(课文) · roast chicken/beef 烤鸡/烤牛肉 · roast over a fire 在火上烤 · roast in the oven 在烤箱里烤 · a roast dinner 烤肉大餐
advancedExpressions.example: She roasted the chicken in the oven while the children roasted chestnuts over the fire. 她在烤箱里烤鸡，孩子们在火上烤栗子。（短语群串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达'烹烤'（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: roast（块状肉/坚果，火或烤箱）/ bake（面包糕点，烤箱干热）/ grill（铁架近火炙烤）/ toast（薄片烤脆变色）
advancedExpressions.example: She baked the bread, roasted the beef and grilled the fish for the feast. 她为宴席烤了面包、烤了牛肉、炙了鱼。（据食材选词）

advancedExpressions.expression: the smell of roasting ... filled the air as ...
advancedExpressions.example: The smell of roasting meat filled the air as we wove through the bustling stalls. 我们在熙攘的摊位间穿行，烤肉的香味弥漫在空气中。（嗅觉描写开场 + as 从句推进）

advancedExpressions.expression: we will roast ... , with all proceeds going to ...
advancedExpressions.example: At the bazaar we will roast chestnuts, with all proceeds going to children in remote areas. 义卖会上我们将烤栗子，全部收益捐给偏远地区的孩子。（with 独立结构说明善款去向）

advancedExpressions.expression: roasting ... rather than ...ing ... helps to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Roasting food rather than frying it helps to cut down on unhealthy fats. 烤制食物而非油炸有助于减少不健康的脂肪。（对比论证句式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We could smell roasted meat as we walked past the stands.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mouth-watering smell of roasting meat drifted through the air as we passed wave after wave of street stands, until hunger and wonder tugged at us in equal measure. （读后续写·感官+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: mouth-watering 前置形容词 + drifted through the air 拟物动词 + wave after wave 叠词渲染 + until 结果从句写心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: It is healthier to roast food than to fry it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is growing evidence that roasting food, rather than frying it, not only reduces harmful fats but also retains the natural nutrients our bodies crave. （议论文·健康主张）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There is growing evidence that 引出论据 + rather than 对比 + not only...but also 递进结构强化论证力度

classPractice.question: 烤肉的香味弥漫在空气中。The smell of ____ ____ filled the air as we passed the street stands.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；roasted 为过去分词作定语修饰 meat

classPractice.question: 选词：A steaming plate of ____ (roast / roasting) chicken sat at the centre of the table.
classPractice.note: roast chicken 为固定搭配，作前置定语；roasting 是现在分词'正在烤的'

classPractice.question: By noon the whole team was ____ (roast) on the treeless field under the blazing sun.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义：roast 作不及物动词'(被晒得)酷热难受'，用过去进行时 was roasting

classPractice.question: 用 roast 的适当形式填空：The scouts ____ marshmallows over the crackling fire last night.
classPractice.note: 由 last night 判断用过去式；roast sth over a fire 在火上烤某物

original_sentence: I was so caught up in the party fever that I hardly noticed five hours fly by!
readingExamples: I was so caught up in the party fever that I hardly noticed five hours fly by!
definitionEn:
(1) to be so involved or absorbed in an activity or feeling that you do not notice other things
(2) to become unintentionally involved in a situation, especially an unpleasant or difficult one
(3) to be physically swept along or entangled by something such as a crowd or current

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①沉浸于，全神贯注于(某活动/情绪)而忘却其他（褒义/中性：be caught up in the fever/excitement）——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: I was so caught up in the party fever that I hardly noticed time fly by. 我完全沉浸在派对的狂热里，几乎没察觉时间飞逝。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②(不由自主地)卷入，陷入(常指不愉快、麻烦的处境)（贬义：be caught up in a conflict/scandal）
uncommonMeanings.example: The two boys were unexpectedly caught up in a bitter quarrel. 两个男孩意外卷入了一场激烈的争吵。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③被(人群、水流等)裹挟、席卷着走
uncommonMeanings.example: Caught up in the current of the crowd, she could do nothing but move along. 被人流裹挟，她只能随之移动。

posExamples.sentence: I was so caught up in the party fever that I hardly noticed five hours fly by, the music and laughter dissolving every trace of time. （读后续写·狂欢·忘我沉醉）
I sincerely apologize for my late reply; I was caught up in preparing for the final examinations and simply lost track of the days. （应用文·道歉信）
When people are caught up in the pursuit of material wealth, they often overlook the very things that give life its deepest meaning. （议论文·价值取向主题）
The two boys, once close friends, were unexpectedly caught up in a bitter quarrel that neither of them had ever wanted. （读后续写·友情·冲突）

wordForms.other: 语块贴士：核心动词 catch 不规则变化 catch-caught-caught；短语 be/get caught up in sth，'介词 in + 名词/动名词'。主动式 catch sb up in sth 少见，考试几乎只考被动 be caught up in。

collocations.phrase: be caught up in sth（= be involved in sth）
collocations.translation: 【课件】被卷入；被陷入；被绊住（尤指不受欢迎、身不由己的处境）
collocations.example: I didn't want to be caught up in endless unimportant arguments. 我不想陷入无休止的无关紧要的争论中。（课件原句）
She was caught in a heavy storm. 她突然遭遇了一场大暴雨。（课件例句；Sorry I'm late – I was caught in the heavy traffic. 对不起我迟到了，遇上交通堵塞了）
It's a shame that he was caught cheating in an exam. 真难为情，他考试作弊被逮了个正着。（课件例句）
The idea of book-sharing has been around for ages without catching on. 图书共享的理念存在已久，却始终没有真正流行起来。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】补上；补做（欠下的事/觉/功课）
collocations.example: I burned the midnight oil last night and now I just want to catch up on some sleep. 我昨晚熬夜了，现在只想补点觉。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: be so caught up in ... that ...
collocations.translation: 如此沉浸于……以至于……（课文原句结构）
collocations.example: I was so caught up in the party fever that I hardly noticed five hours fly by! 我完全沉浸在派对的狂热里，几乎没察觉五个小时飞逝而过！（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be caught up in the excitement / fever
collocations.translation: 沉浸在兴奋 / 狂热之中
collocations.example: Caught up in the excitement of the final whistle, the crowd surged onto the pitch. 沉浸在终场哨响的兴奋中，人群涌向球场。

collocations.phrase: be caught up in one's work / studies
collocations.example: So caught up was she in her research that she forgot to eat. 她如此埋头于研究，竟忘了吃饭。

collocations.phrase: be caught up in a conflict / dispute / war
collocations.translation: 卷入冲突 / 纠纷 / 战争
collocations.example: Innocent villagers were tragically caught up in a conflict they never wanted. 无辜的村民不幸卷入了一场他们从未想要的冲突。

collocations.phrase: be caught up in the crowd
collocations.example: Caught up in the surging crowd, I moved wherever the tide of people carried me. 被涌动的人群裹挟，我随着人潮任其带向何方。

collocations.phrase: be caught up in a scandal / trouble
collocations.example: He was reluctant to be caught up in the scandal. 他不愿卷入那桩丑闻。
Don't get so caught up in the details that you lose sight of the bigger picture. 别过于纠缠细节，以致看不到全局。

synonyms.example: He was so absorbed in the old letters that he did not hear the rain begin to fall against the window. （读后续写·专注·环境反衬）
synonyms.usage: be absorbed in 纯指主动的专注投入，语气中性偏正面；be caught up in 可指专注，也常含'不由自主被卷入'的被动色彩

synonyms.example: Every student was involved in organizing the charity concert, and the shared effort forged bonds that lasted for years. （应用文·活动感悟）
synonyms.usage: be involved in 中性，指参与某事；be caught up in 更强调深陷、身不由己或未曾预料地卷入

synonyms.example: Swept up in a wave of patriotism, the young crowd sang the anthem at the top of their lungs. （读后续写·集体情感）
synonyms.usage: be swept up in 与 be caught up in 极近义，均含被裹挟感；swept up 更强调突如其来的强烈情绪浪潮

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·catch 短语群（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: be caught up in sth 被卷入/沉浸（= be involved in）· be caught in sth 突然遇上 · catch sb doing sth 当场发现某人做事 · catch on 流行 · catch up on sth 补上/补做
advancedExpressions.example: Caught in the storm on my way home, I was caught cheating by no one but simply wanted to catch up on the sleep I had lost — an idea that never seems to catch on with my busy classmates. 回家路上遇上暴风雨，我没被逮到作弊，只想补回失去的觉——这想法在忙碌的同学中却从没流行过。（catch 短语群串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·caught up 词块（课堂重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: be caught up in the fever 沉浸于狂热(课文) · be caught up in one's studies 埋头学业 · be caught up in a conflict 卷入冲突 · get caught up in details 纠缠细节
advancedExpressions.example: So caught up was he in his studies that he never got caught up in the campus gossip. 他如此埋头学业，从不卷入校园八卦。（短语群串记，一褒一贬）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达'专注/卷入'（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: be caught up in（沉浸/身不由己卷入）/ be absorbed in（主动专注）/ be involved in（参与）/ be swept up in（被情绪潮流席卷）
advancedExpressions.example: He was caught up in (absorbed in / involved in / swept up in) the celebration. 他沉浸在庆典之中。（caught up in 与 swept up in 含'被裹挟'感）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·so + 过去分词 + that 倒装
advancedExpressions.expression: So caught up was sb. in ... that ...（so + 过去分词提前，主谓部分倒装，强调程度）
advancedExpressions.example: So caught up was I in the swirl of colour and sound that I hardly noticed the hours slipping away. 我如此沉醉于色彩与声响的旋涡，几乎没察觉时光悄然流逝。（倒装强调，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: I was caught up in ... and failed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I was caught up in a family emergency and failed to submit the report on time. 我当时忙于处理一件家庭急事，未能按时提交报告。（道歉信说明缘由，语气诚恳）

advancedExpressions.expression: when we are caught up in ..., we tend to lose sight of ...
advancedExpressions.example: When we are caught up in the endless race for success, we tend to lose sight of the quiet joys. 当我们深陷于对成功无休止的追逐时，往往会忽略那些平静的欢愉。

advancedExpressions.expression: so caught up ... that sb. hardly noticed ...
advancedExpressions.example: So caught up was I in the swirl of colour and sound that I hardly noticed the hours slipping quietly away. （倒装 so + adj. 提前 + that 结果从句，续写沉浸高潮）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was enjoying the party so much that I forgot the time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So caught up was I in the party fever that I hardly noticed five hours fly by, each moment melting seamlessly into the next. （读后续写·忘我）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: So + adj. 倒装 + be caught up in 替换 enjoy 更生动 + party fever 隐喻 + melting into 拟物收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: People who only care about money often forget what really matters.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When people are caught up in the relentless pursuit of wealth, they all too often lose sight of the simple treasures — a shared meal, a kind word, an unhurried afternoon — that give life its true worth. （议论文·价值取向）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: When 状语从句起势 + be caught up in 表身不由己 + 破折号列举具体细节 + that 定语从句收束升华

classPractice.note: so + 过去分词提前引起主谓倒装：So caught up was I ...
