definitionEn:
(1) adj. happening once every year or produced once a year
(2) adj. calculated over or covering a period of one year
(3) n. a book or magazine published once a year with the same title but new content
(4) n. a plant that lives for only one year or season

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一年生植物
uncommonMeanings.example: Unlike the sturdy oak, the annuals in her garden blazed gloriously for a single summer and then were gone — yet she loved them all the more for their fleeting brilliance. （读后续写·园艺·短暂之美）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 年刊，年鉴（每年出一期的刊物）
uncommonMeanings.example: Tucked in the attic was the school annual from 1985, its faded photographs summoning a whole generation of forgotten faces. （读后续写·旧物·追忆）

posExamples.sentence: As the annual charity gala drew near, the entire school buzzed with excitement, and even the shyest students volunteered to lend a hand. （读后续写·校园盛事·热闹）
We warmly invite you to attend our school's annual English Speech Festival, which will be held in the auditorium on the last Friday of this month. （应用文·邀请函）
The company's annual report reveals that its steady investment in green technology has begun to pay off, both financially and environmentally. （议论文·可持续发展主题）
Their annual family reunion, held faithfully every Spring Festival, was the one unbreakable thread binding the scattered relatives together. （读后续写·亲情·传统）

collocations.translation: 一年一度的节日／活动（本单元'节日/庆典'主题核心搭配）
collocations.example: Spring Festival is China's biggest annual festival. 春节是中国最盛大的年度节日。
The company published its annual report last week. 公司上周发布了年度报告。
The prize is given on an annual basis. 该奖每年颁发一次。

collocations.translation: 年度活动 / 节日 / 会议
collocations.example: The annual sports meeting has become a cherished tradition that draws the whole community together each autumn. （读后续写·校园传统）
Though his annual income was modest, he insisted on setting aside a little each month for children who could not afford books. （读后续写·善良·质朴）
She spent her entire annual leave rebuilding the flood-damaged village school, asking for nothing in return. （读后续写·奉献）
The steady annual growth in library visits proves that reading is far from a dying habit among the young. （议论文·阅读主题）
The annual gathering of old classmates, though brief, rekindled friendships that time had nearly let fade. （读后续写·同窗情）

synonyms.example: The yearly migration of the swallows never failed to fill the old man with a quiet, familiar joy. （读后续写·自然·情感）
synonyms.usage: yearly 与 annual 基本同义，但更口语、更日常；annual 更正式，常用于书面报告、活动、财务语境

synonyms.example: The festival is celebrated annually, drawing visitors from every corner of the province. （应用文·活动介绍）
synonyms.usage: annually 是 annual 的副词形式，表'每年地';作副词时用 annually，作形容词修饰名词时用 annual

synonyms.example: Kindness, unlike fashion, is a perennial virtue that never goes out of season. （议论文·品德主题）
synonyms.usage: perennial 指'多年生的/常年持续的'，与 annual('每年一次的/一年生的')在植物与'持续时间'含义上恰成对比，勿混用

advancedExpressions.expression: annual (adj.) → annually (adv.) 每年地
advancedExpressions.example: The festival is held annually in early spring. 该节日每年初春举行。（形容词修饰名词 annual festival；副词修饰动词 held annually，句法位置不同）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'每年的'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: annual = yearly（更口语）；once a year（短语）
advancedExpressions.example: an annual / a yearly checkup = a checkup once a year 每年一次的体检

advancedExpressions.expression: annual 一年生的/每年一次的；perennial 多年生的/常年不断的（正好相对）
advancedExpressions.example: Annuals last one season; perennials return year after year. 一年生植物只活一季，多年生植物年年重生。

advancedExpressions.expression: as the annual ... drew near, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the annual harvest festival drew near, the whole village stirred with a restless, joyful energy, and even the air seemed to hum with anticipation. （as 时间状语铺陈 + 拟人 air seemed to hum，续写氛围渲染）

advancedExpressions.expression: we sincerely invite you to our annual ...
advancedExpressions.example: We sincerely invite you to our annual Cultural Week, an event that promises both a feast for the eyes and food for thought. （邀请函正式句式 + a feast for the eyes 对仗修辞）

advancedExpressions.expression: the annual ... has risen steadily, which suggests that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The annual number of tree-planting volunteers has risen steadily, which suggests that environmental awareness is finally taking root among the young. （用年度数据切入 + which 非限制性从句引出结论 + take root 一词双关）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our school holds a speech contest every year.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Our school's annual speech contest has grown, year by year, into a much-loved tradition where timid voices learn at last to ring out with confidence. （应用文/读后续写·校园传统）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 annual 替换 every year 更凝练 + year by year 插入语显传承 + where 定语从句写意义升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: The number of visitors goes up every year.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The steady annual increase in visitors bears eloquent testimony to the enduring appeal of this ancient town. （议论文·数据+论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: annual increase 名词化表达更书面 + bear testimony to 高级搭配 + enduring appeal 正式措辞提升论证质感

classPractice.question: The Water-Splashing Festival, held ____ (annual), attracts thousands of tourists to Yunnan every April.
classPractice.note: 空格作状语修饰动词 held，须用副词 annually；若修饰名词则用形容词 annual

classPractice.question: annual / perennial：Sunflowers are ____ plants, blooming for just one summer, while roses are ____ and return each year.
classPractice.note: annual 一年生 vs perennial 多年生，语义相对，靠 for just one summer / return each year 定答案

classPractice.question: 作为一年一度的盛事，端午节把整个社区凝聚在一起。As ____ ____ ____, the Dragon Boat Festival brings the whole community together.
classPractice.note: '一年一度的盛事'= an annual event，annual 作形容词修饰单数可数名词须加冠词 an

definitionEn:
(1) n. a machine that changes energy, especially from burning fuel or electricity, into movement
(2) n. the part of a vehicle, such as a car or plane, that produces power to make it move
(3) n. something that is used to make something happen or develop; a driving force
(4) n. a computer program that performs a particular function (as in 'search engine')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （社会、经济发展的）驱动力，引擎
uncommonMeanings.example: In her essay she called education 'the quiet engine of a nation's rise' — not the roar of factories, but the steady turning of curious young minds. （议论文·教育的作用）

posExamples.sentence: With a cough and a shudder, the old truck's engine finally came to life, and Grandpa's weathered face broke into the widest grin I had seen in years. （读后续写·亲情·修好旧车）
I am writing to report that the engine of the school minibus has been making a strange rattling noise, and I sincerely hope the matter can be inspected before our field trip next week. （应用文·报告/建议信）
Innovation, rather than cheap labour, has become the true engine of sustainable economic growth in the twenty-first century. （议论文·创新与发展）
Curiosity is the engine that has propelled humanity from the mouth of a cave to the surface of the moon, driving us to ask questions long before we can answer them. （议论文·科技/探索精神）

collocations.translation: 搜索引擎（信息时代高频，本单元语法/写作常用）
collocations.example: I found the answer with a search engine. 我用搜索引擎找到了答案。
He started the engine and drove off. 他发动引擎开走了。

collocations.translation: 增长／进步的引擎（比喻·议论文）
collocations.example: Innovation is the engine of economic growth. 创新是经济增长的引擎。
She started the engine, took a deep breath, and steered the car out of the driveway towards a future she could not yet imagine. （读后续写·踏上旅程）

collocations.phrase: turn off / switch off the engine
collocations.example: He switched off the engine and sat in the sudden silence, gathering the courage to walk into the hospital. （读后续写·心理·探病）
As the plane taxied down the runway, the engines roared with a power that pressed us all back into our seats. （读后续写·旅行·起飞）
The rescue boat was fitted with a powerful engine capable of cutting through the fiercest waves. （读后续写·救援）
The invention of the steam engine did more than move machines — it moved history, ushering in the Industrial Revolution. （议论文·科技史）

collocations.phrase: the engine of growth / progress / change
collocations.example: Small businesses have long been regarded as the engine of growth in any healthy economy. （议论文·经济）
With a single tap on a search engine, today's students can access more information in a second than a scholar once gathered in a lifetime. （议论文·信息时代）
It took the mechanic the whole afternoon to repair the engine, but at last it purred as smoothly as new. （读后续写·修理）

synonyms.example: The tiny electric motor whirred to life, and the model boat glided across the pond to the children's delight. （读后续写·童年）
synonyms.usage: motor 多指较小的、由电力驱动的马达；engine 常指燃料驱动、功率较大的发动机（如汽车、飞机）

synonyms.example: Her mother's quiet sacrifice was the driving force behind every award she ever won. （读后续写·亲情·感恩）
synonyms.usage: driving force 为抽象比喻，强调推动某事发展的力量；engine 作此义时更形象、更书面

synonyms.translation: 强大的力量源泉，动力室
synonyms.example: The coastal city soon became the industrial powerhouse of the entire region. （议论文·经济）
synonyms.usage: powerhouse 强调能量或影响力的集中来源，常修饰地区、机构或人；engine 更侧重‘推动前进’的动作意象

advancedExpressions.expression: engine (n.引擎) → engineer (n.工程师 / v.设计策划) → engineering (n.工程学)
advancedExpressions.example: The engineer engineered a clever solution using engineering principles. 那位工程师运用工程学原理设计出巧妙方案。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'引擎/动力源'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: engine = motor（多指小型电动机）；driving force / powerhouse（比喻义）
advancedExpressions.example: Curiosity is the engine / the driving force behind all discovery. 好奇心是一切发现的引擎／驱动力。

advancedExpressions.expression: search engine 搜索引擎；type ... into a search engine 在搜索引擎里输入……
advancedExpressions.example: Just type the keyword into a search engine. 只需把关键词输入搜索引擎。

advancedExpressions.expression: with a + n. + and a + n., the engine + v.
advancedExpressions.example: With a cough and a splutter, the engine finally caught, and hope surged back into our hearts. （名词并列拟声 + 动作与情绪呼应，续写转折段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to report that the engine ... , and I hope ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to report that the engine of the coach requires urgent inspection, and I hope the school will arrange a check before our departure. （报告问题 + 礼貌请求的应用文套路）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is the engine that drives / propels ...
advancedExpressions.example: Innovation is the engine that drives a nation forward, converting raw curiosity into concrete progress. （以'引擎'作喻体，将抽象概念具象化，增强论证画面感）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He started the car and drove away.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He turned the key, and as the engine growled awake beneath the hood, he pulled away from the kerb without so much as a glance in the rear-view mirror — leaving the old life, and all its regrets, behind. （读后续写·决绝离开）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化引擎(growled awake) + without so much as 强调决绝 + 破折号补充心理，画面与情感双重升级

sentenceUpgrade.original: Technology helps the economy grow.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere convenience, technology has become the very engine of economic growth, transforming how nations produce, trade, and prosper. （议论文·科技与经济）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being 让步开头 + the very engine of 比喻强调 + 三动词排比(produce, trade, prosper)，正式且有力

classPractice.question: 如果你不知道这个词的意思，就用搜索引擎查一下。If you don't know the word, look it up with ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 search engine 搜索引擎，单数可数名词前加不定冠词 a

classPractice.question: engine / motor：A car is driven by a petrol ____, while a small electric toy runs on a tiny ____.
classPractice.note: engine 多指燃料驱动、功率大的发动机；motor 多指小型电动机，靠 petrol / electric toy 定选

classPractice.question: 创新是经济发展的引擎。（用 the engine of）
classPractice.answer: Innovation is the engine of economic growth / development. / Innovation is the engine that drives economic growth.
classPractice.note: engine 的比喻义'驱动力'，固定框架 the engine of + 名词

definitionEn:
(1) n. a large vehicle that carries firefighters and equipment such as hoses and ladders to put out fires
(2) n. (BrE) the standard term for what is called a 'fire truck' in American English

posExamples.sentence: The wail of a fire engine tore through the quiet street, and within seconds neighbours were spilling out of their doors, faces pale with alarm. （读后续写·突发火灾）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to thank the brave crew of the fire engine who arrived within minutes and rescued the trapped kitten from the burning shed. （应用文·感谢信）

A well-equipped fire engine, staffed by trained professionals, can mean the difference between a minor incident and a catastrophe — which is why funding for public safety must never be cut. （议论文·公共安全）

collocations.translation: 叫消防车（合成词 fire+engine=消防车，注意非'着火的引擎'）
collocations.example: Someone called a fire engine at once. 有人立刻叫来了消防车。

collocations.phrase: a fire engine arrives / pulls up
collocations.example: A fire engine pulled up in minutes. 消防车几分钟内就赶到了。

collocations.phrase: the siren of a fire engine
collocations.example: The siren of a fire engine echoed through the night, growing louder with every passing second. （读后续写·氛围渲染）
The little boy pressed his nose against the glass, mesmerised by the gleaming red fire engine parked outside the station. （读后续写·童年憧憬）
As a reward for his bravery, the child was invited to ride on a fire engine around the town square. （读后续写·温情）

synonyms.example: Three fire trucks screeched to a halt outside the blazing warehouse, sirens howling. （读后续写·美式语境）
synonyms.usage: fire truck 为美式英语，与英式 fire engine 同义；作文中保持一种拼法即可，切勿混用

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词 fire + engine
advancedExpressions.expression: fire (火) + engine (机器) → fire engine 消防车；同类合成：fire fighter 消防员, fire station 消防站, fire alarm 火警
advancedExpressions.example: The fire fighters jumped off the fire engine and rushed towards the fire station's alarm. 消防员跳下消防车，冲向拉响火警的方向。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'消防车'(英/美)
advancedExpressions.expression: fire engine（英式）= fire truck（美式），同一作文中只用一种拼法
advancedExpressions.example: In Britain it's a fire engine; in America, a fire truck. 英国叫 fire engine，美国叫 fire truck。

advancedExpressions.expression: the wail / siren of a fire engine + v. + through ...
advancedExpressions.example: The wail of a fire engine tore through the still afternoon, shattering the calm of the sleepy town. （以声音开场制造紧张感，续写场景切换）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would like to thank the crew of the fire engine who ...
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of my family, I would like to thank the crew of the fire engine who risked their lives to save our home. （感谢对象 + 定语从句说明事迹，感谢信标准结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: a well-equipped fire engine can mean the difference between ... and ...
advancedExpressions.example: A well-equipped fire engine can mean the difference between a rescued family and an unspeakable tragedy. （'the difference between A and B' 强化对比，凸显投入的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A fire engine came and put out the fire.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Sirens screaming, a fire engine roared round the corner, and moments later powerful jets of water arced through the smoke, beating back the flames inch by stubborn inch. （读后续写·救火高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 独立主格(Sirens screaming) + 动词升级(roared) + 画面动作(arced through the smoke) + inch by inch 渲染艰难过程

sentenceUpgrade.original: Fire engines are important for safety.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Behind every fire engine that races to a scene lies a promise society makes to its members: that no one will be left to face the flames alone. （议论文·公共安全的意义）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 倒装(Behind ... lies) + 冒号引出抽象命题 + 拟人化承诺，将具体事物升华为社会价值

classPractice.question: 浓烟一冒出来，邻居们就立刻叫来了消防车。The moment smoke appeared, the neighbours ____ ____ ____ ____ at once.
classPractice.note: call a fire engine 叫消防车；the moment 引导时间状语从句，主句用一般过去时 called

classPractice.question: 消防车几分钟内就赶到了，消防员迅速扑灭了大火。
classPractice.answer: A fire engine arrived / pulled up in (a few) minutes, and the firefighters quickly put out the fire.
classPractice.note: a fire engine arrives / pulls up 消防车赶到；put out the fire 扑灭大火

definitionEn:
(1) n. a chemical substance, usually a liquid, with a pH lower than 7 that can burn or dissolve things and turns litmus paper red
(2) n. a substance with a sour taste, such as that found in lemons or vinegar
(3) adj. having a sour, sharp taste, like that of a lemon
(4) adj. (of remarks or humour) sharp and critical in a way that is unkind

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （言语、语气）尖刻的，刻薄的（熟词僻义：'酸'引申为'刺人的'）
uncommonMeanings.example: 'How kind of you to come at last,' she said in an acid voice. '你总算肯来了，真是难为你。'她用尖刻的语气说。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （味道）酸的，酸味的
uncommonMeanings.example: The lemon had a sharp, acid taste. 这柠檬有一股刺鼻的酸味。

posExamples.sentence: A single drop of the acid hissed as it touched the metal, and thin curls of smoke rose from the bench, sending the young chemist stumbling backwards in alarm. （读后续写·实验事故）
I am writing to remind all members of the science club that any acid used in experiments must be stored in labelled bottles and never poured down the sink. （应用文·安全通知）
His acid remarks, though cloaked in a smile, cut deeper than any open insult could have. （读后续写·人物·冷嘲）

Acid rain, formed when pollutants dissolve in moisture, is silently corroding our forests, lakes and monuments — a stark reminder that the price of unchecked industry is paid by nature itself. （议论文·环境保护）

idioms.translation: 严峻的考验，决定性的检验
idioms.example: The final match against last year's champions would be the acid test of everything the team had trained for. （读后续写·比赛·决胜时刻）

collocations.translation: 酸雨（环保主题高频，本单元语法/写作常用）
collocations.example: Acid rain is harmful to plants and buildings. 酸雨对植物和建筑有害。

collocations.translation: 尖刻的话／语气（熟词僻义：酸→刻薄）
collocations.example: Her acid remark hurt him deeply. 她尖刻的话深深伤了他。
Tea plants grow well in acid soil. 茶树在酸性土壤中长得好。
The teacher carefully added a few drops of hydrochloric acid to the test tube and watched the mixture begin to fizz. （读后续写·课堂实验）
The wine had turned, leaving an unpleasantly acid taste that lingered long after the first sip. （读后续写·味觉）
For all his acid remarks, everyone knew he had a soft heart beneath the sharp words. （读后续写·人物反差）
The delicate coin dissolved slowly in the acid, leaving only a faint metallic haze in the beaker. （读后续写·实验观察）
Always wear gloves when you handle acid, the instructor warned, or one careless moment could scar you for life. （应用文·安全指导）

synonyms.example: The milk had gone sour overnight, and its smell filled the whole kitchen. （读后续写·日常）
synonyms.usage: sour 为最常用的口语化‘酸味’词；acid 作味觉义时更正式、更强调刺激感，也可指化学上的酸

synonyms.example: Her sharp reply silenced the room in an instant. （读后续写·冲突）
synonyms.usage: 形容言语时 sharp 强调直接、锋利；acid 更强调带有腐蚀性的恶意与讽刺

synonyms.example: The critic was famous for his caustic reviews, which could end a career overnight. （议论文/书面）
synonyms.usage: caustic 书面色彩更浓，语气也更狠；acid 略温和一些，日常与文学中均常见

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·acid 一词多角度
advancedExpressions.expression: acid rain 酸雨（环保）；acid soil 酸性土壤（农业）；an acid remark 尖刻的话（人物）；the acid test 严峻考验（比喻）
advancedExpressions.example: The championship was the acid test of the team's true strength. 这场冠军赛是对球队真正实力的严峻考验。

advancedExpressions.expression: acid (n./adj.) → acidic (adj.酸性的) → acidity (n.酸度) → acidify (v.使酸化)
advancedExpressions.example: Pollution has increased the acidity of the lake and acidified the soil around it. 污染增加了湖水的酸度，也使周边土壤酸化。

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·acid vs sour vs sharp/caustic(形容言语)
advancedExpressions.expression: 味道'酸'：sour 最口语，acid 更正式且强调刺激；言语'刻薄'：sharp 直接锋利，acid/caustic 带腐蚀性恶意
advancedExpressions.example: The milk tasted sour; her acid / caustic reply cut deeper than the insult. 牛奶发酸了；她刻薄的回答比辱骂更伤人。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. said, one's acid tone / voice leaving no doubt about ...
advancedExpressions.example: 'Perfect timing, as always,' he muttered, his acid tone leaving no doubt about his displeasure. （引语 + acid tone 独立主格补充语气，塑造人物冲突）

advancedExpressions.expression: any acid used in ... must be ... and never ...
advancedExpressions.example: Any acid used in the laboratory must be clearly labelled and never left unattended. （'must ... and never ...' 一正一反明确规定，通知文体的规范句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: acid rain is silently ...-ing ..., a stark reminder that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Acid rain is silently corroding our heritage, a stark reminder that the cost of pollution outlives those who cause it. （现在进行时凸显持续危害 + 同位语点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The acid burned the table.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment the acid met the wooden bench, it hissed and spat, eating a charred, smoking hole clean through the surface before anyone could react. （读后续写·实验事故）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化(hissed and spat) + 动作递进(eating ... clean through) + before anyone could react 制造紧迫感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Acid rain harms the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Acid rain, an invisible legacy of our smokestacks, quietly poisons rivers and dissolves the stone faces of statues that have watched over cities for centuries. （议论文·环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 同位语(an invisible legacy) + 拟人(watched over) + 具体意象(dissolves the stone faces)，抽象危害具象化

classPractice.question: acid rain / acid remark：Years of ____ have eaten away at the ancient statue, while her ____ still stings whenever he recalls it.
classPractice.note: acid rain 酸雨（腐蚀雕像）vs acid remark 尖刻的话（刺痛人心），靠 eaten away / stings 定语义

classPractice.question: Pollution has greatly increased the ____ (acid) of the lake, killing most of the fish.
classPractice.note: the 后缺名词作宾语，用名词形式 acidity 酸度；acidic 是形容词不合句法

classPractice.question: sour / acid：The critic was famous for his ____ tongue, and even the milk he complained about had gone ____.
classPractice.note: 形容'刻薄'用 acid tongue；形容牛奶'变酸'口语用 sour go sour

definitionEn:
(1) n. (informal) things in general, used to refer to objects, substances, or activities without naming them exactly
(2) n. (informal) the personal belongings of a particular person; possessions
(3) n. (informal) subject matter, ideas, or things that someone says or does
(4) vt. to fill something tightly with a substance or with things; to push something quickly into a space

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】装满，填满；（草率地）把……塞进（stuff sth into/with sth；be stuffed with）
uncommonMeanings.example: All the drawers were stuffed with letters and papers, and she stuffed a few more into the last free corner. 所有抽屉都塞满了信函文件，她又往最后的空隙塞进几张。（课件搭配 stuff sth into/with；be stuffed with）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】给（禽类等）装馅（stuff the turkey）
uncommonMeanings.example: Are you going to stuff the turkey this Christmas? 今年圣诞你打算给火鸡装馅吗？（课件原句 stuff the turkey）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （构成某物的）材料，本质；the stuff of ... 构成……的东西
uncommonMeanings.example: Courage and kindness are the very stuff of true heroism. 勇气与善良正是真正英雄气概的本质。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （笼统所指的）东西，物品；话，活儿（口语，不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: Leave your stuff here and come in. 把东西放这儿，进来吧。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把……塞满；把……塞进
uncommonMeanings.example: She hurriedly stuffed the crumpled letter into her pocket the instant she heard footsteps on the stairs. （读后续写·紧张·藏东西）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （构成某物的）材料，本质；'stuff of ...' 意为'构成……的东西'
uncommonMeanings.example: Courage and kindness — these, he realised, were the very stuff of true heroism. （读后续写·主题升华）

posExamples.sentence: 'Just leave your stuff by the door,' Grandma called from the kitchen, and the familiar smell of her stew wrapped around me like a warm embrace. （读后续写·归家·温情）
I am writing to remind everyone attending the camp to pack only essential stuff, as storage space in the cabins is extremely limited. （应用文·通知）
He stuffed his backpack with everything he could grab and slipped out of the window before dawn broke over the silent town. （读后续写·出走·动作）
Endless practice and quiet perseverance may sound dull, but this is the stuff that champions are truly made of. （议论文·成功与努力）

idioms.example: The young guide clearly knew his stuff, answering every tricky question about the ruins without a moment's hesitation. （读后续写·人物·专业）

idioms.idiom: the stuff of dreams / nightmares / legends
idioms.translation: 梦想／噩梦／传奇般的事物
idioms.example: That last-minute goal was the stuff of legends, and the whole stadium erupted in disbelief and joy. （读后续写·比赛·高光）
As the music began, she stepped onto the stage to strut her stuff before a hushed, expectant crowd. （读后续写·表演）

collocations.translation: 【课件】我所有的东西 / ……之类的（口语，不可数）
collocations.example: All my stuff was lost due to my carelessness. 由于我的粗心，我所有的东西都丢了。I like reading and stuff. 我喜欢阅读之类的。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: stuff sth into sth / stuff sth with sth
collocations.example: stuff 500 leaflets into envelopes = stuff 500 envelopes with leaflets 把500份传单装进信封 = 用500份传单把信封装满。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be stuffed with / be full of sth
collocations.example: All the drawers were stuffed with letters and papers. 所有抽屉里都放满了信函文件。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: stuff sth into a small space
collocations.translation: 【课件】（草率地）把……塞进（狭小的地方）
collocations.example: She stuffed the money under a cushion. 她把钱塞到软垫底下。His hands were stuffed in his pockets. 他两手插在口袋里。（课件原句）
Are you going to stuff the turkey? 你要给火鸡装馅吗？（课件原句）
He stuffed the papers into his bag. 他把文件塞进包里。
The turkey was stuffed with rice and nuts. 火鸡里塞满了米和坚果。

collocations.translation: 各种各样的东西（口语·不可数）
collocations.example: The box was full of all sorts of stuff. 盒子里装满了各种各样的东西。
The guide really knows his stuff. 这位导游真的很内行。
After the final bell rang, she packed up her stuff and lingered by the door, reluctant to say goodbye to the classroom forever. （读后续写·毕业·不舍）
'Climbing that wall? That's kid stuff,' the veteran hiker laughed, and led the way up without a rope. （读后续写·人物·自信）
When the crisis hit, each volunteer did their stuff, and order was restored within the hour. （读后续写·团队合作）
'Stuff and nonsense!' the old professor snorted, dismissing the rumour with a wave of his hand. （读后续写·人物·态度）
Everyone thought the new recruit was hot stuff until the first real challenge exposed his inexperience. （读后续写·反转）
Grit under pressure showed that, beneath her quiet manner, she had the right stuff after all. （读后续写·人物成长）

synonyms.example: She gathered her things and left without a word. （读后续写·日常）
synonyms.usage: things 为可数、最中性的说法；stuff 不可数、更口语化，语气更随意，正式作文中慎用

synonyms.example: The passengers were asked to keep their belongings with them at all times. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: belongings 更正式，专指随身个人物品；应用文中优先于 stuff

synonyms.example: The reporter gathered enough material for a front-page story. （议论文/书面）
synonyms.usage: material 指用于制作或写作的原料、素材；stuff 作‘材料’义时更口语、更笼统

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·stuff 词块（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: un. all my stuff 我所有的东西 · and stuff ……之类的 · v. stuff sth into/with sth 塞进/装满 · be stuffed with 被塞满 · stuff the turkey 给火鸡装馅
advancedExpressions.example: All my stuff was stuffed into one bag while Mum stuffed the turkey for dinner. 我把所有东西塞进一个包，妈妈则在给晚餐的火鸡装馅。（课件名词义与动词义串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·know one's stuff 等口语习语
advancedExpressions.expression: know one's stuff 精通业务；do one's stuff 各显神通；the stuff of dreams/legends 梦想／传奇般的事物
advancedExpressions.example: That winning goal was the stuff of legends, and the new coach clearly knows his stuff. 那个制胜球堪称传奇，新教练显然很内行。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·stuff 作名词不可数
advancedExpressions.expression: stuff 作'东西/材料'时不可数：much / a lot of / some stuff（不加 s，不用 a stuff）
advancedExpressions.example: There is too much stuff on the desk. 桌上东西太多了。（不可数，用 much，谓语用 is）

advancedExpressions.expression: stuff (n./v.) → stuffing (n.填料) → stuffed (adj.塞满的/吃撑的) → stuffy (adj.闷热不透气的)
advancedExpressions.example: After the stuffed turkey, I felt so stuffed I could barely move in the stuffy room. 吃完塞满馅的火鸡，我撑得几乎动不了，屋里还闷得慌。

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·stuff vs things vs belongings/material
advancedExpressions.expression: stuff 不可数、最随意（作文慎用）；things 可数中性；belongings 正式指随身财物；material 指素材/原料
advancedExpressions.example: Pack your things (belongings), not just random stuff. 收拾好你的东西（随身物品），别只带些杂七杂八的。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. hurriedly stuffed ... into ... the instant ...
advancedExpressions.example: She hurriedly stuffed the note into her sleeve the instant the door swung open. （stuff 动作 + the instant 引导的瞬时状语，营造紧张感）

advancedExpressions.expression: please pack only essential stuff, as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please bring only essential stuff, as luggage space on the coach is strictly limited. （祈使句提醒 + as 说明理由，通知文体常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... — this is the stuff that ... are made of
advancedExpressions.example: Discipline, patience and an unbreakable will — this is the stuff that true leaders are made of. （名词并列蓄势 + 'the stuff ... are made of' 定格式收束，铿锵有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He put his things in his bag and left.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a backward glance, he stuffed his belongings into a battered rucksack, shouldered it, and stepped out into a morning that promised nothing but uncertainty. （读后续写·离家）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Without a backward glance 开头定基调 + 三连动词(stuffed, shouldered, stepped) + that 定语从句收尾渲染前景

sentenceUpgrade.original: Success needs hard work and patience.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Talent may open the door, but it is grit, patience and relentless practice — the unglamorous stuff of everyday effort — that carry one all the way through. （议论文·成功）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步(may open the door, but) + 强调句(it is ... that) + 破折号插入语点明主旨，句式富层次

classPractice.question: 把500份传单装进信封（两种表达）：____ 500 leaflets ____ envelopes = ____ 500 envelopes ____ leaflets.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；stuff sth into sth 与 stuff sth with sth 互换，注意 into 后接被装的容器、with 后接填充物

classPractice.question: 所有抽屉里都放满了信函文件。All the drawers ____ ____ ____ letters and papers.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；be stuffed with sth 被……塞满，被动语态

classPractice.question: 用 stuff 译：你要给火鸡装馅吗？Are you going to ____ ____ ____?
classPractice.note: 课件原句；stuff the turkey 给火鸡装馅（此处 stuff 作及物动词'装馅'）

classPractice.question: Hearing footsteps, he ____ (stuff) the crumpled note into his pocket and pretended to be reading.
classPractice.note: 此处 stuff 作及物动词'塞进'，与 pretended 并列用一般过去时 stuffed

classPractice.question: stuff / things / belongings：Passengers must keep their ____ (随身财物，正式) with them, but please don't bring too much random ____ (杂物，口语) on the coach.
classPractice.note: belongings 正式指随身财物；stuff 口语泛指杂物、不可数，靠语境正式度定选

classPractice.question: 这位年轻导游对每个问题对答如流，显然很精通业务。The young guide answered every question fluently; he clearly ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.answer: knew his stuff / knows his stuff
classPractice.note: 习语 know one's stuff 精通业务；与前句 answered 保持过去时用 knew

translation: 交通工具，车辆；手段，工具
definitionEn:
(1) n. a machine, usually with an engine and wheels, that is used to carry people or goods from one place to another, such as a car, bus, or truck
(2) n. something that can be used to express your ideas or feelings, or to achieve a particular purpose; a means or medium
(3) n. (formal) a play, film, or piece of music that is intended to display the talents of a particular performer

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（赖以表达思想、感情或达到目的的）手段，工具，媒介，载体（a vehicle for expressing yourself）
uncommonMeanings.example: Art may be used as a vehicle for expressing yourself. 艺术可以用作表达自己的工具。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （表达思想、达成目的的）手段，媒介，载体（熟词僻义：由'车辆→承载→媒介'）
uncommonMeanings.example: For the poet, verse was a vehicle for feelings he could not otherwise express. 对诗人而言，诗是他抒发难言之情的载体。

posExamples.sentence: A battered old vehicle rattled to a stop beside us, and out climbed a stranger whose kind eyes would change the course of my journey forever. （读后续写·陌生人相助）
I am writing to suggest that no motor vehicle be allowed to enter the school grounds during break time, so as to guarantee the safety of every pupil. （应用文·建议信）
Language is not merely a tool for communication but a vehicle for culture, carrying the memories, values and dreams of an entire people across generations. （议论文·语言与文化）
As the rescue vehicle wound its way up the treacherous mountain road, we clung to one another, praying it would reach the stranded climbers in time. （读后续写·救援·紧张）

collocations.example: Motor vehicles are not allowed beyond this gate. 机动车辆不得驶入此门。（课件原句 motor vehicles 机动车辆）

collocations.phrase: a vehicle for expressing / doing sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】（赖以表达思想、感情或达到目的的）手段，工具，载体
collocations.example: Art may be used as a vehicle for expressing yourself. 艺术可以用作表达自己的工具。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 机动车（正式，告示/规则常用）
collocations.example: No motor vehicle is allowed beyond this gate. 机动车不得驶入此门。

collocations.translation: ……的媒介／载体（熟词僻义：抽象'手段、媒介'）
collocations.example: Language is a vehicle for culture. 语言是文化的载体。
The city replaced old buses with electric vehicles. 该市用电动车辆取代了旧公交。
He had driven the same vehicle for twenty years, and knew its every rattle and groan by heart. （读后续写·人物）
The city's decision to replace old buses with electric vehicles was praised as a bold step towards cleaner air. （议论文·环保）

collocations.phrase: a vehicle for change / expression / hope
collocations.example: Music, in her hands, became a vehicle for hope, lifting the spirits of everyone in the crowded shelter. （读后续写·艺术的力量）
An abandoned vehicle sat rusting at the roadside, its windows shattered, its story untold. （读后续写·环境描写）
When our vehicle broke down in the middle of nowhere, the silence of the desert pressed in on us. （读后续写·困境）

collocations.phrase: use sth as a vehicle to do sth
collocations.translation: 利用某物作为达成……的手段
collocations.example: The charity used the concert as a vehicle to raise both funds and awareness for children in need. （应用文·活动报道）

synonyms.example: Reading was, for the lonely child, a means of escape into brighter worlds. （议论文/书面）
synonyms.usage: means 更抽象、更常用于‘方法/途径’；vehicle 作此义时更形象，强调‘承载并传递’的意象

synonyms.example: Painting proved a powerful medium for expressing what words could not. （议论文·艺术）
synonyms.usage: medium 侧重信息或艺术传播的载体；vehicle 更强调借以‘实现目的’的工具性

synonyms.example: In those days the only conveyance across the valley was a rickety wooden cart. （读后续写·旧时代）
synonyms.usage: conveyance 为正式书面词，专指运输工具，日常罕用；vehicle 通用且中性

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·vehicle 具体义与抽象义（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: 具体：motor vehicles 机动车辆；抽象：a vehicle for expressing yourself 表达自己的工具 / a vehicle for/of + 抽象名词（culture, hope, change）载体、媒介
advancedExpressions.example: Motor vehicles carry people from place to place, but art is a vehicle for expressing what words cannot. 机动车辆载人往来，而艺术是表达言语所不能之物的工具。（课件具体义与抽象义对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: vehicle (n.车辆) → vehicular (adj.车辆的，机动车的，如 vehicular traffic)
advancedExpressions.example: Vehicular traffic is banned in the old town centre. 老城中心禁止机动车通行。

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·vehicle vs means vs medium(作'手段/媒介')
advancedExpressions.expression: means 最抽象泛指'方法/途径'；medium 侧重信息/艺术'传播载体'；vehicle 强调'承载并传递'的形象工具性
advancedExpressions.example: Reading is a means of learning; painting is a medium of art; language is a vehicle of culture. 阅读是学习的途径，绘画是艺术的媒介，语言是文化的载体。

advancedExpressions.expression: a + adj. + vehicle + rattled / pulled up ..., and out climbed ...
advancedExpressions.example: A weather-beaten vehicle pulled up beside us, and out climbed a figure who seemed to have stepped straight out of a dream. （交通工具登场 + out climbed 倒装引出关键人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: I suggest that no vehicle be allowed to ..., so as to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I suggest that no vehicle be allowed near the playground during recess, so as to protect the safety of younger children. （虚拟语气 suggest that ... be + so as to 目的状语，建议信规范句）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is not merely ... but a vehicle for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Language is not merely a means of communication but a vehicle for the collective memory of a civilisation. （not merely ... but ... 递进 + vehicle 比喻，将抽象概念形象化）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A car stopped and a man got out.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A mud-splattered vehicle ground to a halt on the gravel, and from it emerged a broad-shouldered stranger whose weathered face broke into an unexpected, disarming smile. （读后续写·陌生人）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 细节形容(mud-splattered) + 动词升级(ground to a halt) + from it emerged 倒装 + 外貌与神态描写引出人物

sentenceUpgrade.original: Language carries culture.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far more than a mere means of exchange, language serves as the living vehicle of a culture, ferrying its stories, wisdom and identity safely across the currents of time. （议论文·语言与文化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far more than 让步开头 + the living vehicle 比喻 + 现在分词状语(ferrying ...) + across the currents of time 意象化时间

classPractice.question: 艺术可以用作表达自己的工具。Art may be used as ____ ____ ____ expressing yourself.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；a vehicle for doing sth 表'（表达/达成……的）手段、载体'，介词 for 后接动名词

classPractice.question: vehicle / means / medium：A bus is a ____ for travel, TV is a powerful ____ for spreading ideas, and hard work is the surest ____ of success.
classPractice.note: vehicle 具体载体/工具；medium 信息传播媒介；means 抽象途径，靠 travel / spreading ideas / success 定位

classPractice.question: 语言不仅是交流的工具，更是文化的载体。（用 vehicle）
classPractice.answer: Language is not merely a means of communication but (also) a vehicle for / of culture.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义 a vehicle for/of sth 某物的载体/媒介；not merely ... but (also) ... 递进结构

classPractice.question: 我建议休息时间不准任何机动车进入操场。I suggest that no ____ ____ ____ allowed to enter the playground during break.
classPractice.note: suggest that 从句用虚拟语气 (should) be；motor vehicle 机动车

sub_section: A: The Gift of the Magi
original_sentence: But how could she earn some? Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment.
readingExamples: But how could she earn some? Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to receive money as payment for work that you do
(2) vt. to get something that you deserve because of your qualities, efforts, or achievements
(3) vt. (of money, investments) to gain interest or produce profit
(4) vt. to cause someone to gain or receive something (as in 'earn sb. sth.')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （凭品质或努力）赢得，博得（尊重、信任、名声等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Through years of quiet honesty, the old shopkeeper had earned the trust of everyone in the village. （读后续写·人物·口碑）

posExamples.sentence: But how could she earn some money? Della stood before the mirror, twisting her long hair through her fingers as a desperate plan slowly took shape in her mind. （读后续写·困境·内心挣扎）
I am writing to apply for the part-time position at your bookshop, as I hope to earn some pocket money while gaining valuable work experience this summer. （应用文·求职信）
Respect is not handed out on demand; it must be earned through consistent integrity, hard work and genuine care for others. （议论文·尊重与努力）
By staying up night after night to nurse the injured stray, the boy earned not only its loyalty but a quiet pride he had never felt before. （读后续写·成长·善良）

idioms.example: After his father fell ill, the teenager had to earn a living by delivering newspapers before dawn each day. （读后续写·家庭变故·担当）
Even as a guest on the farm, she insisted on earning her keep by mending fences and feeding the animals. （读后续写·人物·自立）
The rookie firefighter earned his stripes the night he carried two children out of the blaze. （读后续写·成长·认可）

collocations.translation: 赚点钱（课文原句：Della 想为丈夫买礼物而发愁没钱）
collocations.example: But how could she earn some? 可是她怎么才能赚到钱呢？（课文原句）
He earns a living by teaching English. 他靠教英语谋生。

collocations.translation: 赢得尊重／信任（熟词僻义：凭品质赢得）
collocations.example: She earned everyone's respect through hard work. 她凭努力赢得了大家的尊重。

collocations.phrase: earn money / a salary / a wage
collocations.example: She worked two jobs to earn enough money to keep her little brother in school. （读后续写·亲情·牺牲）
It takes years to earn a good reputation, yet a single lie can destroy it in a moment. （议论文·诚信）
He earned a modest living as a street painter, yet no millionaire seemed happier than he. （读后续写·知足）
Through sheer determination, she earned her place on the national team. （读后续写·奋斗）
Working by day and studying by night, he finally earned his degree at the age of forty. （读后续写·励志）
After weeks of relentless rehearsal, the cast sank into their seats for a well-earned rest. （读后续写·如释重负）
Her selfless act earned her the admiration of the entire community. （读后续写·善举）

collocations.phrase: earn a place in sb.'s heart
collocations.translation: 在某人心中占据一席之地
collocations.example: With his gentle patience, the old teacher earned a lasting place in the hearts of all his students. （读后续写·师生情）

synonyms.example: Through the exchange programme she gained not only knowledge but a broader view of the world. （议论文·成长）
synonyms.usage: gain 泛指获得（好处、经验、知识等），不强调付出代价；earn 强调通过劳动或努力‘应得’

synonyms.example: After all her sacrifices, she truly deserved the award. （议论文·公平）
synonyms.usage: deserve 强调‘配得上、理应得到’的资格；earn 强调通过实际行动‘挣得’这一结果

synonyms.example: Over the years he acquired a wealth of experience in the trade. （议论文/书面）
synonyms.usage: acquire 书面、正式，多指逐渐取得技能、习惯或财产；earn 更强调劳动或品德换来的回报

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·earn 的固定搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: earn a living 谋生；earn one's keep 自食其力；earn one's stripes 凭本事赢得资历；earn sb. sth. 为某人赢得某物
advancedExpressions.example: By working part-time she earned her keep and, in time, earned her family's pride. 靠打零工她自食其力，最终也为自己赢得了家人的骄傲。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'赢得(尊重/信任)'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: earn respect = win respect = gain respect（earn 最强调'凭努力应得'）
advancedExpressions.example: He earned / won / gained the respect of his rivals. 他赢得了对手的尊重。

advancedExpressions.expression: earn (v.) → earnings (n.收入，恒用复数) → earner (n.挣钱者，如 a wage-earner)
advancedExpressions.example: As the family's only wage-earner, his monthly earnings barely covered the rent. 作为家里唯一的挣钱者，他每月的收入勉强够付房租。

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·earn vs gain vs win
advancedExpressions.expression: earn 凭劳动/努力'应得'（钱、尊重）；gain 泛指'获得'（好处、经验），不强调代价；win 靠竞争/运气'赢得'（比赛、奖项）
advancedExpressions.example: She earned her salary, gained experience, and won the top prize. 她挣得薪水，收获经验，赢得头奖。

advancedExpressions.expression: but how could sb. earn ... ? sb. + 动作 as a plan took shape
advancedExpressions.example: But how could she earn the fare in a single night? She paced the tiny room as a bold, risky plan slowly took shape. （自问句制造悬念 + as 从句表现思考过程，续写心理段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I hope to earn ... while gaining ...
advancedExpressions.example: I hope to earn some pocket money while gaining hands-on experience through this internship. （'earn ... while gaining ...' 一举两得句式，求职信表明动机）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is not given but earned through ...
advancedExpressions.example: Genuine respect is not given but earned through years of integrity and quiet perseverance. （not ... but ... 对比结构 + through 短语说明途径，凸显努力的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She wanted to earn money to buy a gift.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Determined to earn enough for the one gift that would make his Christmas complete, Della counted her meagre savings again and again, her heart sinking with every coin. （读后续写·牺牲·心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Determined to 分词状语开头 + that 定语从句强化动机 + again and again 与 sinking 呼应，层层渲染心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: You must work hard to earn respect.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Respect, unlike a gift, cannot simply be bestowed; it must be painstakingly earned, day by day, through deeds that speak far louder than any promise. （议论文·尊重）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语对比(unlike a gift) + 分号平衡结构 + day by day 递进 + deeds ... louder than promise 对照，论证有力

classPractice.question: earn / gain / win：Through honest work she ____ a fair wage, ____ rich experience, and finally ____ the championship.
classPractice.note: earn 凭劳动挣得(工资)；gain 泛指获得(经验)；win 靠竞争赢得(冠军)

classPractice.question: 尊重不是天生就有的，而是通过多年的正直赢得的。Respect is not given but ____ ____ years of integrity.
classPractice.note: not given but earned 对比结构；earn ... through 通过……赢得，被动分词作表语

classPractice.question: As the only wage-earner, he handed over all his monthly ____ (earn) to support the whole family.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词'收入'，earn 的名词 earnings 恒用复数形式

sub_section: A: The Gift of the Magi
original_sentence: Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment.
readingExamples: Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a piece of special glass in which you can see yourself or things behind you
(2) n. something that gives a true or clear representation of something else
(3) v. to reflect an image, as in a mirror
(4) v. to be very similar to something, or to copy its features closely

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反映；如实呈现（熟词僻义，高考爱考）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her trembling voice mirrored the fear she was struggling so hard to hide, and everyone in the courtroom fell silent. （读后续写·心理外化）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 与……极为相似；映照
uncommonMeanings.example: The still lake mirrored the golden clouds so perfectly that for a moment I could not tell where the sky ended and the water began. （读后续写·环境描写）

posExamples.sentence: Standing before the cracked mirror, Della stared at the stranger looking back — hollow cheeks, tired eyes, yet a stubborn spark of hope that no hardship had ever managed to put out. （读后续写·人物出场）
I am writing to suggest that a full-length mirror be installed in the school gym, as many students find it helpful to check their posture while practising basketball or dance. （应用文·建议信）
Literature, in a sense, serves as a mirror of society, reflecting both its brightest virtues and its most uncomfortable truths for readers to confront. （议论文·文学与社会）
The child's cheerful chatter mirrored his mother's warmth so faithfully that neighbours often smiled, saying the apple had not fallen far from the tree. （读后续写·亲情）

idioms.idiom: hold a mirror up to sth
idioms.example: A good documentary holds a mirror up to reality, forcing us to look honestly at problems we would rather ignore. （议论文·媒体作用）
The twins were mirror images of each other, and even their closest friends struggled to tell them apart. （读后续写·人物）

idioms.translation: 靠障眼法（暗指其中有诈）
idioms.example: The company's sudden profits looked as if they had been done with mirrors — impressive on paper, yet impossible to explain. （议论文·质疑）

collocations.translation: 在镜子前（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment. 德拉站在她公寓里的镜子前。（课文原句）
Whenever she doubted herself, her grandmother urged her to look in the mirror and greet the brave girl standing there. （读后续写·励志）
The grey, drizzling sky seemed to mirror the sorrow of the whole town. 阴沉的细雨天仿佛映照着全城的哀伤。
Glancing into the rear-view mirror, the driver saw the flooded road vanishing behind them and let out a long breath of relief. （读后续写·惊险）
In the corner of the fitting room stood a full-length mirror framed in faded gold. （读后续写·场景）
The ball flew off course and shattered the hallway mirror, sending glittering fragments across the polished floor. （读后续写·意外）
The younger brother's ambition was almost a mirror image of the man who had raised him. （读后续写·家庭）
The grey, drizzling sky seemed to mirror the mood of the entire town on the day of the farewell. （读后续写·情景交融）
The candlelight reflected in the mirror danced softly, filling the tiny apartment with a fragile, golden warmth. （读后续写·环境）

synonyms.example: His essay reflected a maturity far beyond his years, and the judges exchanged impressed glances. （议论文·评价）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:reflect 是最常用的‘反映/反射’动词，抽象具体皆可；mirror 作动词更强调‘如实、完整地映照’，画面感和文学性更强，续写升华段更爱用。

synonyms.example: The applause echoed her own thumping heartbeat, and she suddenly understood that the stage was where she belonged. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:echo 侧重‘声音／情感的回响与呼应’，常指一方重复或应和另一方；mirror 侧重‘视觉上的对称映照’或‘整体相似’。

synonyms.example: Her handwriting closely resembled her late father's, and seeing it always brought a lump to her throat. （读后续写·睹物思人）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:resemble 是静态的‘相像’，只表相似；mirror 隐含‘一方映照／复制另一方’的动态关联，语气更文学。

advancedExpressions.expression: in front of the mirror 在镜子前 / look in the mirror 照镜子 / a mirror image of 的翻版 / hold a mirror up to 如实映照
advancedExpressions.example: Standing in front of the mirror, she held a mirror up to her own fears — and slowly, the girl looking back began to smile. （一句串起多个短语，续写心理）

advancedExpressions.expression: mirror sth = reflect sth = echo sth（三者均可表'反映、呼应'，mirror 最有画面感和文学性）
advancedExpressions.example: The still lake mirrored / reflected the golden clouds so perfectly that sky and water became one. （三词可替换，mirror 最富诗意）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth mirror(s) sth 主语直接接宾语，不加介词（≠ reflect on 反思）
advancedExpressions.example: Her trembling voice mirrored the fear she was struggling to hide. 她颤抖的声音反映出她极力掩饰的恐惧。（mirror 后直接跟宾语）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... seemed to mirror the ... in one's heart
advancedExpressions.example: The frozen river seemed to mirror the numbness in her heart, until the first crack of spring reminded her that nothing stays frozen forever. （借景写情，末段转折升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: installing ... would allow students to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Installing a mirror in the practice room would allow students to correct their movements independently, making our club sessions far more effective. （建议+效果论证）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., in essence, is a mirror that reflects ...
advancedExpressions.example: Language, in essence, is a mirror that reflects the soul of a nation — its history, its values and its dreams all captured in a handful of words. （比喻立论，破题句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She looked at herself in the mirror.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She dared, at last, to lift her eyes to the mirror, and the weary reflection that met her gaze slowly softened into a smile — for behind the shadows of these long, hard years, she could still recognise the girl who had never once stopped hoping. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动词升级(dared to lift)+反射画面外化心理 + 破折号补充+定语从句(who had never...)收束情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The film shows real life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than offering hollow entertainment, the film holds a mirror up to ordinary life, inviting audiences to see their own struggles, hopes and quiet acts of courage reflected on the screen. （议论文·文艺评论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than...对比开头 + 习语 hold a mirror up to + 三名词并列(struggles, hopes, acts)增强气势

classPractice.question: Della stood in front of the ____ (mirror) in her apartment and stared at her long, beautiful hair.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；in front of the mirror 在镜子前，此处作可数名词单数

classPractice.question: 选词填空（mirror / reflect）：The dark, silent sky seemed to ____ the sorrow hidden deep in her heart.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义：mirror 作动词'反映、如实映照'，后直接接宾语，画面感强于 reflect

classPractice.question: 文学在某种意义上是一面反映社会的镜子。Literature, in a sense, serves as a ____ that ____ (reflect) society.
classPractice.note: a mirror that reflects sth 反映……的镜子；that 引导定语从句，先行词 mirror 单数用 reflects

sub_section: A: The Gift of the Magi
original_sentence: Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment.
readingExamples: Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building (American English; British English: flat)
(2) n. a group of large rooms, usually in an impressive building, used by an important person
(3) n. (apartments) a suite of rooms rented out to tourists or visitors

posExamples.sentence: The tiny apartment held little more than a bed, a stove and a cracked window, yet the moment Jim walked in each evening, its bare walls seemed to fill with a warmth no money could ever buy. （读后续写·贫寒中的温情）
I am writing to complain about the constant noise from the apartment above mine, which has made it almost impossible for me to concentrate on my studies at night. （应用文·投诉信）
As more young people flock to big cities, the shortage of affordable apartments has become a pressing social issue that governments can no longer afford to ignore. （议论文·社会问题）
Climbing the narrow, creaking stairs to their fifth-floor apartment, Della clutched the two hard-earned dollars and rehearsed, again and again, how she would surprise Jim. （读后续写·叙事画面）

collocations.translation: 在某人的公寓里（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Della stood in front of the mirror in her apartment. 德拉站在她公寓里的镜子前。（课文原句）
The newly-weds could only afford a cramped one-bedroom apartment, but they decorated every corner of it with laughter and dreams. （读后续写·新婚）
To save money for his mother's operation, he rented the cheapest apartment he could find, right beside the roaring railway line. （读后续写·孝心）
A fire broke out on the top floor of the apartment building, and neighbours rushed out into the freezing night, helping one another to safety. （读后续写·危难互助）
The day they finally moved into their own apartment, the young couple sat on the floor among the boxes, too happy to feel tired. （读后续写·安家）
During my exchange year, I shared an apartment with two local students, and their kindness turned a foreign city into a second home. （应用文·经历分享）
The website advertised a fully furnished apartment near campus, which suited a busy student like me perfectly. （应用文·咨询信）
From his luxury apartment on the thirtieth floor, the city lights spread out like a sea of stars, yet he had never felt so lonely. （读后续写·反差）

synonyms.example: The two sisters saved for years before they could buy a modest flat on the outskirts of London. （读后续写·奋斗）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:flat 是英式英语，apartment 是美式英语，含义相同；书面写作时全文用词应保持一致，不要 flat 与 apartment 混用。

synonyms.example: The mayor kindly opened his official residence to the flood victims until temporary housing was arranged. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:residence 更正式、书面，可指官邸或大宅；apartment 只指楼房中的一套居所，日常、中性。

synonyms.example: For millions of families, a safe and affordable dwelling remains a distant dream rather than a basic right. （议论文·民生）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:dwelling 是书面、笼统的‘住处’，可指任何形式的居所，议论文中显得典雅；apartment 具体指公寓。

advancedExpressions.expression: rent / share an apartment 租/合租公寓 / move into an apartment 搬进公寓 / an apartment building 公寓楼 / a furnished apartment 带家具的公寓
advancedExpressions.example: After months of house-hunting, the couple finally rented a furnished apartment and moved into their new home on a snowy December morning. （一句串起多个短语）

advancedExpressions.expression: apart（分开）+ -ment（名词后缀）→ apartment '（隔开的）一套房间' → 公寓；美式 apartment = 英式 flat
advancedExpressions.example: In America she lived in an apartment; in Britain her sister lived in a flat — same rooms, different words. 在美国她住apartment，在英国她姐姐住flat——一样的房间，不同的叫法。

advancedExpressions.expression: the tiny apartment, though ..., was filled with ...
advancedExpressions.example: The tiny apartment, though bare and cold, was filled with a warmth that no palace could rival. （让步+对比，以陋室写深情）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to draw your attention to ... in the apartment ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to draw your attention to the broken heating system in the apartment I rent, which has left my family shivering for a week. （礼貌陈述问题+具体后果）

advancedExpressions.expression: the shortage of affordable apartments has become ...
advancedExpressions.example: The shortage of affordable apartments has become a barrier that keeps countless young dreamers from putting down roots in the cities they help to build. （现象+隐喻升华矛盾）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They lived in a small apartment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: They lived in a small apartment tucked beneath the eaves, where the ceiling sloped so low that Jim had to stoop at the doorway — yet within those cramped four walls, they had built a happiness far grander than the space that held it. （读后续写·陋室深情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词后置(tucked beneath)+where 定语从句写细节 + 破折号转折 + 空间与情感的对比(cramped walls vs grander happiness)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many young people cannot buy an apartment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For a growing number of young people, owning even a modest apartment has slipped from a reasonable goal into a lifelong aspiration, casting a long shadow over their sense of security and belonging. （议论文·民生）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: For+群体开头 + slip from...into 对比递进 + 现在分词状语(casting a shadow)引出后果，抽象化提升

classPractice.question: Della stood in front of the mirror in her ____ (apartment), where every corner told a story of quiet love.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块 in one's apartment 在某人公寓里；apartment 可数名词

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（apartment / flat）：In American English, a set of rooms on one floor is usually called an ____.
classPractice.note: apartment 美式=flat 英式；同一篇作文中用词应保持一致，不要混用

classPractice.question: 汉译英：这对新婚夫妇搬进了一套小小的一居室公寓。The newly-weds ____ ____ a small one-bedroom apartment.
classPractice.note: move into an apartment 搬进公寓；注意介词 into

translation: 寻找，搜寻；打猎，猎杀；追捕
sub_section: A: The Gift of the Magi
original_sentence: She spent the next two hours hunting for Jim's gift.
readingExamples: She spent the next two hours hunting for Jim's gift.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to chase and kill wild animals or birds for food, sport, or profit
(2) v. to search carefully for something that is difficult to find
(3) v. to search for and try to catch a criminal or an enemy
(4) n. an act of searching for something; the activity of chasing and killing wild animals

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 搜寻，寻找（费力地找，常 hunt for sth，即课文用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: She spent the next two hours hunting for Jim's gift. 她接下来花了两个小时到处寻找送给吉姆的礼物。（课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 追捕；搜捕（罪犯／敌人，常 hunt sb down）
uncommonMeanings.example: For three long nights the police hunted the escaped prisoner through the fog-drenched marshes, their torch-beams sweeping the reeds like restless ghosts. （读后续写·追捕悬疑）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 打猎，猎杀（chase and kill wild animals）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the harsh winter, wolves must hunt in packs, for a lone hunter rarely survives the frozen months alone. （议论文/科普·自然）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 搜寻；狩猎活动（a job hunt 找工作；a treasure hunt 寻宝）
uncommonMeanings.example: The treasure hunt her grandfather had designed led the children from the attic to the old apple tree, each clue soaked in memories of summers long gone. （读后续写·童年回忆）

posExamples.sentence: She spent the whole afternoon hunting for a gift worthy of Jim, going in and out of every shop until, at last, her eyes fell upon a simple watch chain that made her heart leap. （读后续写·寻礼）
If you happen to see a small brown notebook while hunting through the library shelves, please hand it in at the front desk, as it contains a term's worth of my chemistry notes. （应用文·寻物启事）
In an age when jobs are hunted online and interviews conducted by video, students must learn to present themselves convincingly on a screen as well as in person. （议论文·就业与科技）
The frantic hunt for the missing boy ended at dawn, when a farmer spotted a small figure curled asleep beneath a haystack, cold but unharmed. （读后续写·营救）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：'寻找'义必须加介词 hunt for sth（≠及物直接接宾语）；'打猎/追捕'义则及物 hunt animals / hunt sb down；派生 huntsman 猎人、manhunt 大搜捕、job-hunt 找工作

idioms.example: She hunted high and low for the lost ticket, turning the apartment upside down before finding it tucked inside a coat she had not worn all winter. （读后续写·找东西）
The online campaign against the young teacher soon turned into a cruel witch-hunt, driven more by rumour than by any real evidence. （议论文·网络暴力）
Fresh out of college and on the hunt for opportunities, he sent out a hundred letters before a single reply arrived. （读后续写·求职）

collocations.translation: 搜寻/寻找某物（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: She spent the next two hours hunting for Jim's gift. 她接下来花了两个小时寻找送给吉姆的礼物。（课文原句）
The detective was determined to hunt down the truth, no matter how many locked doors stood in her way. （读后续写·探案）
After months of anxious job-hunting, Mei finally received the offer letter and had to read it three times before daring to believe it. （读后续写·励志）
House-hunting in the crowded city proved exhausting, but the couple refused to settle until they found a home their child could grow up in. （读后续写·安家）
Our class organised a treasure hunt across the campus, and the winning team unearthed a box of handwritten notes from graduating seniors. （应用文·活动报道）
In the harsh winter, wolves must hunt in packs, for a lone hunter rarely survives the frozen months alone. （议论文／科普·自然）
A nationwide manhunt was launched the moment the news broke, and roadblocks appeared on every highway leading out of the city. （读后续写·追捕）
As a boy he had gone hunting with his father in these very woods, and every rustling leaf now whispered of those lost, golden mornings. （读后续写·怀旧）

synonyms.example: Rescue teams searched the collapsed building through the night, refusing to stop while the faintest hope of survivors remained. （读后续写·救援）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:search 是最中性、最通用的‘搜寻’，可搭配 for；hunt 更强调‘执着地、辛苦地翻找’或‘追捕’，画面感和紧张感更强。

synonyms.example: Throughout history, humankind has sought not merely to survive, but to understand the very stars above. （议论文·探索精神）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:seek 多用于抽象目标（真理、帮助、机会），书面正式；hunt 偏具体的‘找东西／找人／打猎’，口语和叙事更常见。

synonyms.example: The officers pursued the thief down the winding alleys, their footsteps echoing off the rain-slicked walls. （读后续写·追逐）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:pursue 强调‘持续追赶／追求’的过程，可指追罪犯也可指追理想；hunt 更突出‘搜寻、猎捕’的目的性。

advancedExpressions.expression: hunt for sth 搜寻某物 / hunt sb down 追捕到 / go hunting 去打猎 / a job hunt 找工作 / on the hunt for 正在物色
advancedExpressions.example: Fresh out of college and on the hunt for a job, he hunted for openings online by day and rehearsed interviews by night. （一句串多个短语）

advancedExpressions.expression: hunt for = search for = seek = look for（找）；hunt 强调'执着费力地翻找'，seek 最正式抽象
advancedExpressions.example: For weeks the archaeologists hunted for / searched for the lost tomb. 考古学家搜寻失落古墓数周。（可替换，hunt 更显艰辛）

advancedExpressions.expression: hunt + -er → hunter 猎人；man + hunt → manhunt 大搜捕；job + hunt + ing → job-hunting 找工作
advancedExpressions.example: The lone hunter set off before dawn, unaware that he himself was the target of a silent manhunt. 那孤独的猎人黎明前出发，浑然不知自己正是一场无声大搜捕的目标。

advancedExpressions.expression: the hunt for ... ended when ...
advancedExpressions.example: The desperate hunt for the missing child ended when a trembling hand emerged from the rubble, and a cheer, half sob, rose from the exhausted rescuers. （悬念铺垫+转折收束+群像反应）

advancedExpressions.expression: if you come across ... while hunting through ..., please ...
advancedExpressions.example: If you happen to come across a silver bracelet while hunting through the lost-and-found box, please contact me at once, as it was a keepsake from my late grandmother. （礼貌请求+情感理由）

advancedExpressions.expression: the hunt for ... has never ceased, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The hunt for knowledge has never ceased, for it is precisely this restless curiosity that separates a stagnant society from a thriving one. （破题句+because 因果论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She hunted for a gift for a long time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Hour after hour Della hunted for the perfect gift, weaving through crowded stalls and pressing her nose to frosted shop windows, until — just as her hope was wearing thin — a simple watch chain caught the light and, with it, her breath. （读后续写·寻礼画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词并列状语(weaving...pressing) + until 时间从句制造悬念 + 破折号插入 + 一语双关(caught the light and her breath)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Young people find it hard to look for jobs.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For today's graduates, hunting for a decent job has become a marathon rather than a sprint, demanding not only solid qualifications but also resilience in the face of repeated rejection. （议论文·就业）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动名词作主语 + marathon/sprint 隐喻对比 + not only...but also 并列强调综合素质

classPractice.question: She spent the next two hours ____ (hunt) for Jim's gift, going in and out of every shop on the street.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；spend time (in) doing sth，故用动名词 hunting；hunt for 搜寻

classPractice.question: The detective was determined to hunt ____ the thief, no matter how far he had run.
classPractice.note: hunt sb/sth down 追捕到、搜寻到（表结果，找到为止）

sub_section: A: The Gift of the Magi
original_sentence: She found it at last: a simple but beautiful watch chain for his gold watch
readingExamples: She found it at last: a simple but beautiful watch chain for his gold watch
definitionEn:
(1) n. a series of connected metal rings, used for fastening, pulling, or as jewellery
(2) n. a group of shops, hotels, or businesses owned by the same company
(3) n. a connected series of things or events
(4) v. to fasten or restrict someone or something with a chain

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 链子，链条（金属环相连，即课文 watch chain 表链）
uncommonMeanings.example: She found it at last: a simple but beautiful watch chain for his gold watch. 她终于找到了：一条朴素却精美的表链，配他的金表。（课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 连锁店；连锁企业（熟词僻义，高考爱考，a chain store 连锁店）
uncommonMeanings.example: What had begun as a single roadside noodle stall grew, over twenty patient years, into a chain that stretched across the whole province. （读后续写·创业励志）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一系列，一连串（相连的事物/事件，a chain of events 一连串事件）
uncommonMeanings.example: A small act of kindness can set off a chain of goodwill, spreading from one stranger to the next. （议论文·善的传递）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 用链子拴住；束缚（chain sth to sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: He felt chained to a desk he had never chosen, dreaming each dull afternoon of the open road and the salt wind of the sea. （读后续写·心理压抑）

posExamples.sentence: At last she found it: a simple but beautiful watch chain, plain enough to suit Jim's quiet dignity, yet so fitting for his treasured gold watch that she knew, at once, it was the one. （读后续写·选礼）
I would like to recommend that our school canteen work with a reliable supply chain, so that fresh vegetables can reach students' plates every single morning. （应用文·建议信）
A small act of kindness can set off a chain of goodwill, spreading from one stranger to the next until an entire community is quietly transformed. （议论文·善的传递）
The old dog had been chained in the yard for years, yet the moment the boy loosened the rusty links, it bounded free with a joy that brought tears to his eyes. （读后续写·自由与温情）

idioms.example: One careless rumour triggered a chain reaction of panic, and by nightfall half the town was queuing outside the shops. （议论文·舆论）

collocations.example: She found it at last: a simple but beautiful watch chain for his gold watch. 她终于找到了：一条朴素却精美的表链，配他的金表。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: a chain of shops / restaurants / hotels
collocations.translation: 连锁店／连锁餐厅／连锁酒店
collocations.example: Within a decade, the humble family bakery had blossomed into a chain of restaurants known throughout the city. （读后续写·创业）
The new chain store on the corner sold everything from bread to batteries, and the whole neighbourhood soon depended on it. 街角新开的连锁店什么都卖，整个社区很快就离不开它了。
One careless rumour triggered a chain reaction of panic, and by nightfall half the town was queuing outside the shops. （议论文·舆论）
Looking back, she realised that a single missed train had set off the strange chain of events that led her to the love of her life. （读后续写·命运）

When one species vanishes, the entire food chain trembles, reminding us how delicately the natural world is balanced. （议论文·生态）

collocations.example: Beyond the valley rose an endless chain of mountains, their snow-capped peaks glowing rose-gold in the last light of day. （读后续写·壮景）

synonyms.example: A series of unexpected setbacks tested the team's spirit, yet each failure only sharpened their determination to win. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:series 指抽象的‘一系列（事件、比赛、行动）’，最通用；chain 强调各环节像链条一样‘环环相扣、彼此牵连’，因果关联更紧。

synonyms.example: The detective retraced the exact sequence of events, convinced that one small overlooked detail held the key. （读后续写·探案）

synonyms.example: After a string of impressive victories, the young team walked onto the final court with quiet, unshakeable confidence. （读后续写·体育）

advancedExpressions.expression: a chain store 连锁店 / a chain reaction 连锁反应 / a chain of events 一连串事件 / the supply / food chain 供应链/食物链 / break the chain 打破链条

sub_section: A: The Gift of the Magi
original_sentence: which had been passed down to him from his grandfather
readingExamples: which had been passed down to him from his grandfather
definitionEn:
(1) phr v. to give or teach something to people who will live after you, especially within a family (customs, traditions, knowledge, or possessions)
(2) phr v. to officially announce a decision, especially in a court of law
(3) phr v. to hand something to someone at a lower level or position

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法庭）宣布（判决）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the judge passed down the sentence, a heavy silence gripped the courtroom, and the old man's shoulders sank as if the weight of years had suddenly found him. （读后续写·法庭）

posExamples.sentence: The gold watch had been passed down to Jim from his grandfather, and every time he wound it, he felt the quiet presence of the men who had carried it before him. （读后续写·传家宝）
In our village, the art of paper-cutting is passed down from grandmother to granddaughter, and I sincerely hope more young people will help keep this beautiful tradition alive. （应用文·文化介绍）
If the wisdom of the past is not carefully passed down to the next generation, a nation risks losing the very roots from which its identity grows. （议论文·文化传承）
The recipe, scribbled on a yellowed card and passed down through four generations, still filled the kitchen each New Year with the same fragrance of home. （读后续写·亲情记忆）

idioms.idiom: pass down = hand down = pass on
idioms.translation: （把传统/物品/技艺）世代相传，传下去
idioms.example: Skills passed down / handed down / passed on from master to apprentice kept the ancient craft alive. 师徒相传的技艺让古老手艺得以存续。（三者近义可互换）

collocations.phrase: be passed down to sb from sb
collocations.translation: 被从（某人）传给（某人）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: the gold watch, which had been passed down to him from his grandfather 那块金表，是他祖父传给他的。（课文原句）
Before she left this world, Grandmother passed down her worn jade bracelet to me, whispering that it had guarded three generations of brave women. （读后续写·遗物）

collocations.phrase: be passed down from generation to generation
collocations.example: These folk songs have been passed down from generation to generation, carrying within their simple melodies the joys and sorrows of an entire people. （议论文·文化）
It is our duty to pass down the customs of the Spring Festival, so that our children may know where they come from. （应用文·倡议书）
The old craftsman was eager to pass down his skills before they vanished with him, and he taught the eager apprentice late into every night. （读后续写·师徒）
The legend of the brave fisherman had been passed down for centuries, growing more magical with every retelling around the fire. （读后续写·传说）
The heavy oak table, handed down through the family, had witnessed a hundred years of laughter, quarrels and reconciliation. （读后续写·家族）

synonyms.example: The silver locket had been handed down through five generations of daughters, each adding a single memory of her own. （读后续写·传家）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:hand down 与 pass down 几乎完全同义，都指‘代代相传（物品／传统／判决）’，可互换；写作时选其一以避免重复即可。

synonyms.example: He inherited not only his father's workshop but also his stubborn refusal to ever cut corners. （读后续写·品质）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:inherit 是‘继承（接收方视角）’，主语是继承者；pass down 是‘传下（给予方视角）’，主语是长辈／源头。方向相反，注意主语选择。

synonyms.example: Language transmits not merely words but the collective memory and values of a civilisation. （议论文·文化）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:transmit 更正式、书面，可指传播信息、疾病、信号，抽象；pass down 专指‘世代相传’，多用于家族与文化传统，更有温度。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·pass down 及近义
advancedExpressions.expression: pass down 传下来 = hand down = pass on；be passed down from generation to generation 代代相传；pass down customs / skills / a legend 传承习俗/技艺/传说
advancedExpressions.example: The recipe, passed down / handed down through four generations, still filled the kitchen with the fragrance of home. （近义互换，避免重复）

advancedExpressions.expression: pass down（传下，给予方视角）↔ inherit（继承，接收方视角）；transmit 更正式抽象
advancedExpressions.example: Grandfather passed down the watch to Jim; Jim inherited the watch from Grandfather. 祖父把表传给吉姆；吉姆从祖父那儿继承了表。（主语方向相反）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·被动语态高频考点
advancedExpressions.expression: pass down 常用被动 be passed down（to sb / from sb / from generation to generation），课文即用过去完成时被动 had been passed down
advancedExpressions.example: The gold watch had been passed down to him from his grandfather. 那块金表是从祖父传给他的。（过去完成时被动，课文原句结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., passed down from ... to ..., still ...
advancedExpressions.example: The lullaby, passed down from mother to daughter across four generations, still had the power to soothe a crying child to sleep in an instant. （过去分词后置定语 + still 强调传承的生命力）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is our shared duty to pass down ... so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is our shared duty to pass down these time-honoured traditions, so that future generations may inherit not just customs, but a sense of who they are. （呼吁句式 + so that 目的状语 + 情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: if ... is not passed down, ... risks losing ...
advancedExpressions.example: If the wisdom of our ancestors is not faithfully passed down, a civilisation risks losing the compass by which it once found its way. （if 条件句 + risk losing + compass 隐喻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The watch was passed down from his grandfather.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The gold watch, passed down from his grandfather and worn smooth by three generations of loving hands, was more than an heirloom to Jim — it was a golden thread binding him to everyone who had gone before. （读后续写·传家宝深情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词并列后置定语(passed down...and worn smooth) + more than...it was 递进 + golden thread 隐喻串联亲情

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only by faithfully passing down the treasures of our culture — its stories, its festivals, its unspoken values — can we ensure that the roots of our identity remain firmly anchored in an ever-changing world. （议论文·文化传承）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only by...倒装强调 + 破折号三名词列举(stories, festivals, values) + roots/anchored 隐喻收束

original_sentence: With an income of twenty dollars per week, life was hard for the couple
readingExamples: With an income of twenty dollars per week, life was hard for the couple
definitionEn:
(1) n. the money that a person, family, or organization earns, usually through work or investments
(2) n. money received during a particular period, especially in return for work or from investment
(3) n. (economics) the flow of money going to an individual or group over a period of time

posExamples.sentence: With an income of just twenty dollars a week, the young couple counted every coin, yet somehow their tiny apartment always overflowed with a happiness the rich could not buy. （读后续写·贫寒温情）
I am writing to apply for the part-time tutoring position, hoping to earn a modest income that will ease the financial burden on my hardworking parents. （应用文·申请信）
A widening gap between high and low incomes not only breeds resentment but also threatens the very stability on which a healthy society depends. （议论文·贫富差距）
When his father lost his only source of income, the boy quietly took on two paper routes, determined that his little sister would never go without her morning milk. （读后续写·担当）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：income 是 in（进）+ come（来）→'进来的钱'=收入；反义 expenditure / outgoings 支出、outcome 是'结果'≠收入；固定搭配 an income of + 金额（课文），介词多用 with/on（live on a low income 靠低收入生活）

collocations.example: With an income of twenty dollars per week, life was hard for the couple. 靠着每周二十美元的收入，这对夫妇日子过得艰难。（课文原句）
Growing up in a low-income household taught her the value of every hard-earned coin, a lesson no textbook could ever match. （读后续写·成长）
Every working adult is expected to pay income tax, and that money quietly funds the schools and hospitals we all rely on. 每个有工作的成年人都要缴纳所得税，这笔钱默默供养着我们都依赖的学校和医院。
The small orchard was the family's only source of income, so when the hailstorm struck, they watched their livelihood being battered to the ground. （读后续写·天灾）
By selling her handmade cards after school, she earned a small income that felt, to her, as precious as a fortune. （读后续写·自立）
After years of odd jobs, he finally landed a position with a steady income, and for the first time in a decade he slept without worry. （读后续写·安稳）
Narrowing the income gap is not merely an economic goal but a moral one, for no child should be denied opportunity by the accident of birth. （议论文·公平）
As families' disposable income rises, more parents are willing to invest in their children's music and art education. （议论文·消费）
Our charity aims to provide free winter coats for children from low-income families before the first snow arrives. （应用文·倡议书）
To supplement the family income, Mother took in sewing late at night, the soft hum of the machine becoming the lullaby of my childhood. （读后续写·母爱）

synonyms.example: He set aside a portion of his monthly earnings for his sister's tuition, never once mentioning the sacrifice to anyone. （读后续写·无私）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:earnings 特指‘通过劳动挣得的钱（工资、报酬）’，强调‘挣’的来源；income 更宽泛，包括工资、投资、租金等一切进项。

synonyms.example: Though the salary was far from generous, the sense of purpose the job gave her was worth more than any figure on a payslip. （读后续写·价值观）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:salary 是专业岗位的‘固定薪水’（通常按月／年）；income 是总收入的上位词，含 salary、wages、投资收益等所有来源。

synonyms.example: The festival brought in record revenue for the town, funding new libraries and mending its long-neglected roads. （议论文·经济）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:revenue 多指企业营收或政府税收（组织层面）；income 既可指个人也可指组织，谈个人收入时用 income，不用 revenue。

advancedExpressions.expression: an income of + 金额（课文）/ a high / low income 高低收入 / a source of income 收入来源 / income tax 所得税 / the income gap 收入差距 / disposable income 可支配收入
advancedExpressions.example: With an income of barely two thousand a month and heavy income tax to pay, the family had little disposable income left. （一句串多个短语）

advancedExpressions.expression: income（总进项，上位词）/ earnings（劳动所得）/ salary（固定薪水）/ revenue（企业营收/政府税收）
advancedExpressions.example: His salary was only part of his income, which also came from rent and investment. 薪水只是他收入的一部分，收入还来自租金和投资。（谈个人收入用 income，不用 revenue）

advancedExpressions.expression: in（进来）+ come → income 收入；对照 out + come → outcome 结果；expenditure 支出（反义）
advancedExpressions.example: When income exceeds expenditure, savings grow; when the outcome is the reverse, debt follows. 收入大于支出，存款增加；结果相反，债务随之而来。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·贫寒中的坚韧

advancedExpressions.expression: hoping to earn a modest income that will ...

advancedExpressions.expression: a widening gap between ... incomes threatens ...
advancedExpressions.example: A widening gap between the highest and lowest incomes threatens not only economic vitality but the fragile trust that holds a community together. （现象立论 + not only...but 递进强调深层危害）

(2) prep. according to; in accordance with (as in 'as per')

original_sentence: He thought of the beautiful set of combs on show in one of the shop windows on Broadway.
readingExamples: He thought of the beautiful set of combs on show in one of the shop windows on Broadway.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a flat piece of plastic, metal or wood with a row of thin teeth, used for making the hair tidy
(2) v. to make the hair tidy and smooth with a comb
(3) v. to search a place very carefully in order to find someone or something
(4) n. the soft red part on top of a cock's head (a bird's crest)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 梳子（a set of combs 一套梳子，即课文用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: He thought of the beautiful set of combs on show in one of the shop windows on Broadway. 他想起百老汇一家橱窗里展出的那套精美梳子。（课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （地毯式地）彻底搜寻，仔细搜查（熟词僻义：comb through / comb the area）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （公鸡头顶的）肉冠；鸡冠
uncommonMeanings.example: At the first hint of dawn the old rooster stretched its neck, its scarlet comb trembling, and crowed as though the whole world depended on its call. （读后续写·乡村清晨·画面感）

posExamples.sentence: Della gazed at the beautiful set of tortoiseshell combs in the shop window, her fingers pressed against the cold glass, longing for what her empty purse could never buy. （读后续写·渴望·情感）

collocations.translation: 彻底搜查/仔细梳理（文件、地方等）

synonyms.usage: brush 用刷子，动作范围更广（刷衣、刷牙、刷漆均可）；comb 用梳子，专指用密齿工具整理，且引申义'地毯式搜寻'是 brush 所没有的
