sub_section: A: Importance of promoting traditional Chinese festivals
original_sentence: Traditional festivals have been passed down to us from previous generations.
readingExamples: Traditional festivals have been passed down to us from previous generations.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. happening or existing before the event, time, or thing mentioned
(2) adj. (of a person) having previously had the stated position, role, or experience
(3) adj. coming or occurring just before something else in a sequence; immediately preceding

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 先前的，以往的（发生/存在于所提事件之前）
uncommonMeanings.example: As I said in my previous email, the plan has not changed. 正如我在上一封邮件中所说，计划没有改变。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （紧接着的）前一个的，上一个的
uncommonMeanings.example: She scored higher than in the previous test. 她比上一次考试考得更高。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人）前任的，之前担任某职位的
uncommonMeanings.example: The previous headmaster retired last year. 前任校长去年退休了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式，英式）操之过急的，过早的
uncommonMeanings.example: "Aren't you being a little previous?" his mother teased, as he began packing for a university that had not even sent him an offer yet. （读后续写·对话·幽默口吻）

posExamples.sentence: Unlike the previous summers she had spent locked away with her books, this one unfolded like a bright ribbon — full of laughter, sea breeze, and friends she had never dared to make. （读后续写·今昔对比·成长）
As mentioned in my previous email, the charity book fair will be held next Saturday, and we sincerely hope every class will contribute a few well-loved volumes. （应用文·邮件通知）

Those who dismiss traditional festivals as outdated often overlook a simple truth: they are treasures handed down from previous generations, carrying the collective wisdom of our ancestors. （议论文·文化传承）
The coach reviewed the footage of their previous match, pointing out each missed pass until every player understood exactly where victory had slipped away. （读后续写·体育·复盘）

collocations.translation: 前几代人，先辈（课文原句）
collocations.example: Traditional festivals have been passed down to us from previous generations. 传统节日是从前几代人那里传给我们的。
He still remembered the previous day's lesson clearly. 他仍清楚记得前一天的课。
Previous to this job, she had never worked in a big city. 在这份工作之前，她从未在大城市工作过。
Although she had no previous experience of public speaking, she stepped onto the stage with a courage that silenced the whole hall. （读后续写·突破自我）
In previous years the school sports meet was a rather dull affair, but this time the students transformed it into a dazzling carnival of colour and cheer. （读后续写·校园活动）
The workshop welcomes beginners with no previous knowledge of coding, so please feel free to join us even if you are a complete newcomer. （应用文·招募通知）

collocations.phrase: as in the previous case / example
collocations.example: As in the previous example, blind imitation of foreign models seldom yields the results we hope for. （议论文·论证衔接）
I regret that a previous engagement prevents me from attending the ceremony, but my heart will be with you all. （应用文·致歉信）

synonyms.example: The former champion returned to the ring years later, greyer and slower, yet burning with the same unquenchable fire. （读后续写·人物回归）
synonyms.usage: 辨析 previous vs former：previous 强调时间上'紧接之前的、上一个'（the previous day 前一天）；former 指'昔日的、前任的'，与 latter 对举（the former president 前任总统），也表'前者'。

synonyms.example: Prior to the storm, not a single leaf stirred, as if the whole forest were holding its breath. （读后续写·环境铺垫）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，常见于 prior to（在……之前）短语，也可指'优先的'；previous 更日常，指'前一个、以往的'。

synonyms.example: The preceding paragraph laid out the problem; the following one offers a solution. （议论文·文本衔接）
synonyms.usage: 偏书面，多指文本或序列中'紧接在前的'；日常口语中 previous 更常用。

advancedExpressions.expression: the previous day / previous generations / previous experience / previous to / in previous years
advancedExpressions.example: Previous to this trip, he had never left his hometown. 在这次旅行之前，他从未离开过家乡。（枚举 previous 高频课堂短语，含 previous to）

advancedExpressions.expression: previous / former / prior / preceding（只枚举可替换处）
advancedExpressions.example: In the previous / preceding chapter, the author raised this question. 在前一章中，作者提出了这个问题。（表'前面的'时四词可替换，注意语体差异）

advancedExpressions.expression: previous (adj.) → previously (adv. 先前地)
advancedExpressions.example: The site was previously used as a factory. 该场地先前用作工厂。（形容词加 -ly 变副词，作状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: unlike the previous ..., this ...
advancedExpressions.example: Unlike the previous version of himself — timid, silent, always shrinking into corners — the boy who now stood before the class radiated quiet confidence. （unlike the previous 引导对比，凸显人物蜕变）

advancedExpressions.expression: as mentioned in my previous ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: As mentioned in my previous letter, the exchange programme aims to broaden our horizons and deepen mutual understanding. （as mentioned in my previous 回指前文，应用文过渡句）

advancedExpressions.expression: building on the wisdom of previous generations, we should ...
advancedExpressions.example: Building on the wisdom of previous generations, we should not merely preserve our traditions but breathe new life into them. （building on 引导继承 + not merely...but 递进）

sentenceUpgrade.original: This year was better than last year.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Compared with the previous year, which had drifted by in a grey haze of routine and regret, this year blazed with purpose — every dawn brought a goal, and every dusk a small victory earned. （读后续写·对比+意象）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Compared with the previous year 对比开篇 + which 定语从句渲染 + 平行结构(every dawn...every dusk) + 意象化动词(blazed, drifted)

sentenceUpgrade.original: I said this in my last email.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As I noted in my previous email, the details of the volunteer activity remain unchanged; nevertheless, I am writing once more to ensure that no one misses this rewarding opportunity. （应用文·提醒邮件）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As I noted in my previous email 正式回指 + 分号连接两分句 + nevertheless 转折衔接 + to ensure 目的状语

classPractice.question: 传统节日是从前几代人那里传给我们的。Traditional festivals have been passed down to us from ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句搭配 previous generations 先辈/前几代人。

classPractice.question: The site had been a temple long ____ (previous) to its use as a school.
classPractice.note: 考短语 previous to '在……之前'，previous 在此作形容词构成介词短语，形式不变。

classPractice.question: He recalled the ____ (previous / former) night's dream, in which his ____ (previous / former) teacher, long retired, appeared and smiled.
classPractice.note: previous night 前一晚（紧接之前）；former teacher 昔日/前任的老师，考 previous/former 辨析。

translation: 责任，义务；上班，值班；职责；税
sub_section: A: Importance of promoting traditional Chinese festivals
original_sentence: It is the duty of every one of us to protect them for generations to come.
readingExamples: It is the duty of every one of us to protect them for generations to come.
definitionEn:
(1) n. something you have to do because it is morally or legally right
(2) n. the work that you have to do as part of your job; a task you are responsible for
(3) n. a tax that you pay on things you buy, especially goods brought into a country
(4) n. the state of being on or off active service in a job such as nursing, policing, or the military

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 责任，义务（道德或法律上应做之事）
uncommonMeanings.example: It is our duty to help those in need. 帮助有需要的人是我们的责任。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 职责，本职工作（工作中须完成的任务）
uncommonMeanings.example: Cleaning the classroom is part of her daily duties. 打扫教室是她日常职责的一部分。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 值班，当班（on/off duty）
uncommonMeanings.example: The young nurse had just come off duty when the emergency bell shattered the midnight silence; without a second thought, she turned back and ran. （读后续写·奉献·抉择）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （进口）税，关税
uncommonMeanings.example: At the airport counter, the officer explained that a small duty had to be paid on the antique vase, and only then did the traveller realise how precious his souvenir truly was. （读后续写·旅途·意外插曲）

posExamples.sentence: Even as exhaustion weighed on his eyelids, the old gatekeeper refused to abandon his post, for guarding the school through the storm was a duty he had sworn never to forsake. （读后续写·坚守·奉献）
It is the duty of every one of us to protect our traditional festivals, so that the flame of culture may be passed on brightly to the generations yet to come. （应用文·倡议书）
Some argue that patriotism is an abstract emotion, yet in truth it lives in the humblest of daily duties — sorting rubbish, obeying traffic rules, and caring for one's neighbours. （议论文·公民责任）
On the day of the flood, doctors and volunteers alike stayed on duty for thirty sleepless hours, their weary faces glowing with a quiet, stubborn devotion. （读后续写·灾难·群像）

wordForms.other: duty-free (adj. 免税的)。多义提示：duty 兼表'责任/职责/值班/关税'，on/off duty 值班/下班（不可数不加冠词），a duty on sth 某物的税。

idioms.example: "I may be off duty," the young doctor whispered, rolling up his sleeves beside the injured stranger, "but I will never be off caring." （读后续写·医者仁心·台词）
He asked for no medal and no praise; he had simply done his duty, and that was reward enough. （读后续写·平凡英雄）
Just as the family raised their chopsticks for the reunion dinner, his phone rang — duty called, and the fireman rose without complaint. （读后续写·牺牲小家）

collocations.phrase: it is the duty of sb to do sth
collocations.translation: 做某事是某人的责任（课文原句）
collocations.example: It is the duty of every one of us to protect them for generations to come. 保护它们、传给后代是我们每个人的责任。
The nurse is on duty tonight but off duty tomorrow. 这名护士今晚值班，明天休班。
You can buy duty-free perfume at the airport. 你可以在机场买免税香水。
A good soldier always does his duty. 好士兵总是恪尽职守。

collocations.phrase: have a duty to do sth
collocations.example: As students of this new era, we have a duty to carry forward the fine traditions our ancestors have entrusted to us. （应用文·演讲稿）
Driven by an unshakable sense of duty, the teacher climbed the mountain path every morning to reach the tiny village school. （读后续写·乡村教师）
The class monitor performed her duties so conscientiously that even the strictest teacher could find nothing to criticise. （读后续写·校园）
Passengers may purchase duty-free goods at the airport, but please keep the receipts for inspection. （应用文·须知）
No one who shirks his duty in times of hardship deserves to share in the glory of victory. （议论文·责任担当）
Helping the fallen elderly man was not a matter of choice but a moral duty that any decent person would recognise at once. （议论文·道德）

synonyms.example: With great talent comes great responsibility, and she never once forgot the villagers who had funded her education. （议论文·担当）
synonyms.usage: 范围更广，可指'须负责的事'或'责任心'；duty 更强调道德或法律上'应尽的本分'，语气更庄重。

synonyms.example: I feel a deep obligation to repay the kindness this community showed me when I had nothing. （应用文·感谢信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重外在约束或人情、契约带来的'义务'；duty 更强调内在道德感与角色本分。

synonyms.example: Cleaning the whole laboratory before dusk seemed an impossible task, yet the volunteers tackled it with cheerful determination. （读后续写·集体劳动）
synonyms.usage: 指具体分派的'任务'，中性；duty 带有'义不容辞'的道德色彩。

advancedExpressions.expression: do one's duty / a sense of duty / on (off) duty / duty-free / have a duty to do / it is the duty of sb to do
advancedExpressions.example: It is the duty of every citizen to obey the law. 遵守法律是每个公民的责任。（枚举 duty 高频课堂短语，覆盖责任/值班/免税）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·it is one's duty to do
advancedExpressions.expression: It is the duty of sb to do sth = It is one's duty to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: It is the duty of every one of us to protect them for generations to come. 保护它们、传给后代是我们每个人的责任。（形式主语 it + to do 逻辑主语，课文原句句型）

advancedExpressions.expression: duty came before ..., and so sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Duty came before comfort, before fear, before even his own life — and so he plunged into the flames without a backward glance. （排比 before 结构 + 破折号收束，渲染无私）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is our bounden duty to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is our bounden duty to safeguard these festivals, for they are the roots from which our cultural confidence grows. （bounden duty 强化庄重感 + for 引导原因，倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: true patriotism lies not in grand gestures but in the faithful discharge of one's daily duties
advancedExpressions.example: True patriotism lies not in grand gestures but in the faithful discharge of one's daily duties, however small they may seem. （not...but 对比 + however 让步，凸显平凡中的伟大）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He did his duty and saved the child.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a moment's hesitation, driven by a sense of duty far stronger than fear, he threw himself into the icy current and pulled the drowning child back to the light of day. （读后续写·英雄行为+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Without a moment's hesitation 状语提前 + driven by...过去分词状语揭示动机 + stronger than fear 比较级渲染 + 意象(the light of day)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone should protect traditional festivals.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is the sacred duty of every one of us — young and old, near and far — to protect these traditional festivals, ensuring that the wisdom of our forebears is never lost to the tides of time. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is the sacred duty of...强调句 + 插入语(young and old, near and far)增强感染力 + ensuring 现在分词状语 + 比喻(tides of time)

classPractice.question: 保护它们、传给后代是我们每个人的责任。It is the ____ ____ every one of us to protect them for generations to come.
classPractice.note: 课文原句句型 It is the duty of sb to do sth，形式主语 it 结构。

classPractice.question: The guard was still ____ ____ (值班) at midnight, so he could not join the family dinner.
classPractice.note: on duty 值班 / off duty 下班，不可数不加冠词，考 duty 的'值班'义。

classPractice.question: Travellers may buy ____-____ (免税) goods at the airport, but a small ____ (税) must be paid on expensive antiques.
classPractice.note: duty-free 免税的；duty 此处指'关税'，一题串联 duty 的'关税'多义。

translation: 宝贵的，珍贵的；珍奇的，珍稀的
original_sentence: A precious family dinner
readingExamples: A precious family dinner
definitionEn:
(1) adj. worth a great deal of money; rare and valuable
(2) adj. very important to you and greatly loved, so that you would be very unhappy without it
(3) adj. that should be treated with great care because there is not much of it available
(4) adj. (disapproving) behaving in a very formal or unnatural way, taking too much care over small details

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （贬义）矫揉造作的，过分讲究的
uncommonMeanings.example: She was so precious about her handwriting that a single crooked letter would send her tearing the whole page from the notebook. （读后续写·人物性格·完美主义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）precious little/few：少得可怜
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time help finally arrived, there was precious little the villagers could do but watch the floodwaters swallow their fields. （读后续写·灾难·无力感）

posExamples.sentence: As the last train pulled away and her parents' waving hands blurred into the distance, she suddenly understood how precious those ordinary dinners at home had been. （读后续写·离别·亲情觉醒）
Our traditional festivals are a precious gift handed down through countless generations, and it would be a tragedy to let them fade in the rush of modern life. （应用文·倡议书）
In a world obsessed with speed and profit, we ought to remember that time spent with our loved ones is the most precious currency of all. （议论文·亲情与生活）
The old fisherman cupped the tiny, struggling turtle in his weathered hands as though it were the most precious jewel on earth, then gently released it into the waves. （读后续写·善待生命·画面感）

wordForms.other: semi-precious (adj. 半宝石的)

idioms.example: With the deadline looming and precious few clues in hand, the young detective refused to give up hope. （读后续写·悬疑·坚持）

collocations.phrase: a precious family dinner（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 一顿珍贵的家庭晚餐（课文原句）
collocations.example: A precious family dinner brings the scattered family back together. 一顿珍贵的家庭晚餐让散居各地的一家人重聚。
Gold and silver are precious metals. 金和银是贵金属。

collocations.translation: （熟词僻义）少得可怜，几乎没有
collocations.example: We had precious little time left. 我们剩下的时间少得可怜。
She treasured every one of those precious memories. 她珍藏着每一段珍贵的回忆。
Let us not waste precious time on trivial quarrels. 别把宝贵的时间浪费在琐碎的争吵上。
The values our parents held precious guided me for years. 父母珍视的价值观指引了我多年。
Health is a precious gift we often take for granted. 健康是我们常常视作理所当然的珍贵礼物。
Fresh water is a precious resource. 淡水是宝贵的资源。
We should cherish the precious bond of family. 我们应珍惜宝贵的亲情纽带。

synonyms.example: The dusty old painting in the attic turned out to be a valuable masterpiece worth a small fortune. （读后续写·意外发现）
synonyms.usage: 侧重“有价值、值钱”，可指金钱或实用价值；precious 更强调情感上的“珍爱、舍不得”。

synonyms.example: The smile on the rescued child's face was priceless — a reward no medal could ever match. （读后续写·情感升华）
synonyms.usage: 语气最强，指“无价、无法用金钱衡量”；precious 程度略轻，可与金钱价值并存。

synonyms.translation: 极其宝贵的，无法估量的
synonyms.example: The mentor's invaluable advice steered her away from a decision she would have regretted for life. （议论文·师恩）
synonyms.usage: 多形容抽象的帮助、经验、建议“极有价值”；precious 可修饰具体物品，也带浓厚感情色彩。

advancedExpressions.expression: precious metals 贵金属 / precious stones 宝石 / precious little 极少
advancedExpressions.example: Precious metals hold their value; precious little else does. 贵金属能保值，别的东西几乎都不能。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示珍贵（可替换 precious）
advancedExpressions.expression: precious ≈ valuable ≈ priceless ≈ invaluable（前置修饰名词）
advancedExpressions.example: These precious / valuable / priceless memories can never be bought. 这些珍贵的回忆无价可买。

advancedExpressions.expression: precious(adj.) → preciously(adv.) → preciousness(n.)；semi-precious(adj. 半宝石的)
advancedExpressions.example: The ring was set with semi-precious stones. 那枚戒指镶着半宝石。

advancedExpressions.expression: only when ... did sb. realize how precious ... was
advancedExpressions.example: Only when the house fell silent did she realize how precious those noisy dinners had been. 直到屋子安静下来，她才明白那些喧闹的晚餐有多珍贵。

advancedExpressions.expression: let us treasure the precious ... before it is too late
advancedExpressions.example: Let us treasure the precious traditions before they slip beyond recovery. 让我们在珍贵的传统消逝前好好珍惜它们。

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing is more precious than ...
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing is more precious than the time we spend with loved ones. 没有什么比与所爱之人共度的时光更珍贵。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The family dinner was very important to her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That simple family dinner, once dismissed as a dull routine, now glowed in her memory as something unspeakably precious — a warm island of togetherness in the cold ocean of a life spent far from home. （读后续写·回忆+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: once dismissed as...过去分词插入语对比 + now glowed 今昔转折 + unspeakably precious 程度副词 + 比喻(warm island...cold ocean)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect our traditions.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time we recognised that our traditions are a precious inheritance, one that no amount of modern convenience should ever be permitted to erase. （议论文·呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time we recognised 虚拟语气强调紧迫 + a precious inheritance 隐喻 + one that 同位语从句 + no amount of...should ever 强调结构

classPractice.question: With the deadline near and ____ (precious) few clues, the young detective refused to give up.
classPractice.note: precious little/few 意为“少得可怜”，precious 在此作副词修饰 few，原形不变。

classPractice.question: 用 precious / valuable 填空:Only when it was too late did she realize how ____ those ordinary family dinners had been.
classPractice.note: 此处带浓厚情感色彩“珍爱、舍不得”，用 precious 而非仅指“值钱”的 valuable。

classPractice.question: 没有什么比与家人共度的时光更珍贵。（用 precious 的比较结构）
classPractice.answer: Nothing is more precious than the time (we spend) with our family.
classPractice.note: “nothing is more + adj. than” 表最高级含义，凸显核心价值。

original_sentence: It is just past five o'clock on the Chinese New Year's Eve
readingExamples: It is just past five o'clock on the Chinese New Year's Eve
definitionEn:
(1) n. the day or night before a religious festival or other important event
(2) n. the period of time just before an important event

collocations.translation: 【课件】各种各样的（后接 topics/goods/foods 等复数名词）
collocations.example: the dinner table is already covered with white china plates and bowls, full of all sorts of dishes. 饭桌上已经摆满了白瓷碗碟，里面是满满当当的各色菜肴。

collocations.phrase: a / some sort of sth（【课件】）
collocations.example: They may meet with some sort of problem in adolescence. 他们在青春期可能会遇到某种问题。

collocations.translation: 【课件】有点；有几分（副词，弱化语气）
collocations.example: I sort of hate him, but I don't know why. 我有点恨他，但不知道为什么。
Rubbish can be sorted into plastic, glass and paper. 垃圾可以分类成塑料、玻璃和纸。
It has been proved that sorting out your desk regularly can improve your learning efficiency. 事实证明，定期整理你的书桌能提高学习效率。

collocations.phrase: all sorts of dishes（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 各种各样的菜（课文原句）
collocations.example: full of all sorts of dishes: chicken, duck, pork, fish and vegetables. 摆满了各种各样的菜:鸡、鸭、猪肉、鱼和蔬菜。
The fair displayed all sorts of ingenious inventions. 展会展出了各种各样的巧妙发明。

collocations.translation: 有点儿；某种程度上（弱化语气）
collocations.example: "Are you nervous?" "Sort of." “你紧张吗？”“有点儿。”
We had to sort out the confusion over the tickets. 我们得解决车票上的混乱。
A sort of hush settled over the classroom. 教室里笼罩起一种寂静。
The pupils sorted the rubbish into recyclable bins. 学生们把垃圾按可回收分类投放。
Reading to the elderly — that sort of thing gave my weekends meaning. 给老人读书——诸如此类的事让我的周末有了意义。
I feared he would scold me, but he did nothing of the sort. 我怕他会骂我，可他根本没那么做。
She is the sort of person who makes sure no one feels left out. 她是那种确保没人被冷落的人。
I sort of understood his silence, for grief has a language of its own that words can never quite reach. （读后续写·心理）

synonyms.example: This type of resilience cannot be taught in a classroom; it is forged in the quiet battles no one else can see. （议论文·品格）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:type 强调具有共同特征、可归为一类，较正式、书面；sort 更口语、更随意，且能作动词表"整理、解决"。

synonyms.example: What kind of person do you wish to become — one who follows the crowd, or one who lights his own path? （议论文·人生选择）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:kind 与 sort 极近，日常可互换；kind 略偏中性温和，另有"善良"之义，sort 更侧重口语并可作动词。

synonyms.example: The judges placed her essay in a category of its own, so far did it soar above the rest. （应用文·比赛结果）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:category 指经过明确划分、界限清晰的"范畴"，学术、正式；不能像 sort 那样口语化或作"解决"讲。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·sort 一词多义搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: all sorts of 各种 / a sort of 一种 / sort of 有点 / sort out 整理·解决 / sort into 分类
advancedExpressions.example: Please sort out this mess and sort the files into folders. 请整理好这堆乱摊子，把文件分类归档。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示“种类”（名词，可替换 sort）
advancedExpressions.expression: sort ≈ kind ≈ type ≈ category（sort/kind 口语，type 较书面，category 正式且界限清晰）
advancedExpressions.example: There are two sorts / kinds / types of readers in the world. 世上有两类读者。

advancedExpressions.expression: sort(v.分类) → sorter(n.分拣者/机) → sorted(adj.);assorted(adj.各种各样的)
advancedExpressions.example: The machine acts as an automatic sorter. 这台机器充当自动分拣机。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. was not the sort to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Father was not the sort to show his feelings. 父亲不是那种流露感情的人。

advancedExpressions.expression: there are broadly two sorts of ...: those who ... and those who ...
advancedExpressions.example: There are broadly two sorts of learners: those who wait and those who push themselves. 学习者大致分两种:等着被推的人和自我驱动的人。

advancedExpressions.expression: for the sake of clarity, we may sort them into ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the sake of clarity, we may sort the activities into indoor and outdoor ones, so that every classmate can sign up with ease. （分类陈述，条理清晰）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were many kinds of food on the table.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The table groaned under all sorts of home-cooked dishes — glistening braised pork, golden fried fish, mountains of jade-green vegetables — each one a small monument to my mother's love. （读后续写·家宴/环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the table groaned under 拟人夸张 + all sorts of 概括 + 破折号列举细节 + a monument to 隐喻升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should solve this problem calmly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than panic, we ought to sit down together and sort the matter out calmly, for hasty decisions made in fear seldom stand the test of a clearer morning. （议论文·处事态度）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than 引导对比 + sort...out 短语动词 + for 引导说理分句 + stand the test of 习语增色

classPractice.type: 语境应用·选词填空（【课件】原题）
classPractice.question: I ________ hate him, but I don't know why.（有点）
classPractice.note: 【课件】sort of 作副词，意为“有点、有几分”，弱化语气。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（【课件】原题）
classPractice.question: They may meet with ___________ problems in adolescence.（他们在青春期可能会遇到各种各样的问题。）
classPractice.note: 【课件】all sorts of + 复数名词，表“各种各样的”。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（【课件】原题）
classPractice.question: The government called on us to _____________.（垃圾分类）
classPractice.note: 【课件】sort 作动词表“分类”；此处“垃圾分类”译作 sort rubbish。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（【课件】原题）
classPractice.question: Rubbish can _____________ plastic, glass and paper.
classPractice.note: 【课件】sort sth into sth“将……分类成……”；Rubbish 为被分类对象，用被动 be sorted into。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（【课件】原题）
classPractice.question: It has been proved that ____________________________ can improve your learning efficiency.（定期整理你的书桌）
classPractice.note: 【课件】sort sth out“把……整理好”；主语用动名词短语 sorting out your desk regularly。

classPractice.type: 语法·主谓一致（【课件】原题）
classPractice.question: This sort of problem ______ quite common. / These sorts of problems ______ quite common.（填 is / are）
classPractice.note: 【课件】this sort of + 单数名词 → 谓语用单数 is；these sorts of + 复数名词 → 谓语用复数 are。

classPractice.question: The table was full of ____ sorts ____ dishes: chicken, duck, pork, fish and vegetables.（课文原句，填两个词）
classPractice.note: 课文原句;all sorts of + 名词，表“各种各样的”，of 不可省。

classPractice.question: Before we could enjoy the trip, we had to ____ ____ the confusion over the tickets.（解决/整理）
classPractice.note: sort out 意为“整理、解决（问题/混乱）”；此处宾语是 confusion，用 sort out 恰当。

classPractice.question: 口语中弱化语气“有点儿”应用:"Are you tired?" "____ ____."（填两词）
classPractice.note: sort of 用于弱化、缓和语气，相当于“有点儿、差不多”，多见于口语对话。

original_sentence: full of all sorts of dishes: chicken, duck, pork, fish and vegetables
readingExamples: full of all sorts of dishes: chicken, duck, pork, fish and vegetables
definitionEn:
(1) n. the meat from a pig, especially when it is fresh and not treated to make it last longer
(2) n. (as modifier) relating to or made from the meat of a pig, e.g. pork chop, pork pie

posExamples.sentence: The moment the lid was lifted, the rich aroma of Grandpa's slow-braised pork filled the kitchen, and suddenly I was six years old again, standing on tiptoe by the stove. （读后续写·家宴/回忆）
For the class charity sale, I suggest we prepare traditional pork buns, as their familiar taste is sure to attract both teachers and students and raise more funds for the mountain school. （应用文·活动方案）
That a simple plate of red-braised pork can summon a whole childhood proves that food is never merely food; it is memory made edible. （议论文·饮食文化）
Grandmother saved the largest piece of pork for me, waving away my protests with a smile that carried the quiet authority of a lifetime of sacrifice. （读后续写·亲情）

collocations.phrase: chicken, duck, pork, fish and vegetables（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 鸡、鸭、猪肉、鱼和蔬菜（课文原句）
collocations.example: full of all sorts of dishes: chicken, duck, pork, fish and vegetables. 摆满各种菜:鸡、鸭、猪肉、鱼和蔬菜。
The centrepiece was a bowl of braised pork. 主菜是一碗红烧肉。
She fried a golden pork chop for her son. 她给儿子煎了一块金黄的猪排。
The family gathered to wrap pork dumplings. 一家人围坐包猪肉饺子。
I recommend sweet and sour pork for our guests. 我给客人推荐糖醋里脊。
He placed the last slice of pork on his brother's plate. 他把最后一片猪肉夹到弟弟盘里。
The recipe called for lean pork. 这道菜谱要用瘦猪肉。

synonyms.example: For those who prefer not to eat meat, we have prepared a colourful selection of vegetable dishes as well. （应用文·菜单说明）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:meat 是各种肉类的总称；pork 特指猪肉，是 meat 的一种，二者为上下位关系，不可随意互换。

synonyms.example: The smell of crisp bacon drifting up the stairs was, in our house, the surest sign that Sunday had arrived. （读后续写·家庭日常）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bacon 指经过腌制/熏制的咸猪肉（培根），是猪肉的加工制品；pork 一般指未加工的鲜猪肉。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·pork 为不可数名词
advancedExpressions.expression: pork 猪肉,不可数,无复数、不加 a;计量用 a slice/piece of pork,a bowl of braised pork
advancedExpressions.example: There is some pork in the fridge. 冰箱里有一些猪肉。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:动物与其肉的对应（辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: pig 猪(活体动物,可数) → pork 猪肉(肉,不可数);同理 cow→beef,sheep→mutton,chicken 鸡/鸡肉同形
advancedExpressions.example: We raise a pig for its pork. 我们养猪是为了取猪肉。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示“肉类”（上下位辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: meat 肉（总称/上位词）> pork 猪肉;bacon 培根为猪肉的腌熏加工品
advancedExpressions.example: For those who avoid meat, we prepared vegetable dishes; others enjoyed the pork. 不吃肉的备了素菜,其他人享用猪肉。

advancedExpressions.expression: a humble dish of pork reflects ...
advancedExpressions.example: A humble dish of pork reflects how a family passes down its identity. 一道朴素的猪肉菜折射出一家人如何传承身份认同。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·嗅觉唤醒记忆
advancedExpressions.expression: the aroma of ... carried me back to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The aroma of frying pork carried me back, in a single breath, to the tiny courtyard where my grandmother had cooked for us every summer. （以气味触发倒叙，续写常用感官技法）

advancedExpressions.expression: no introduction to ... would be complete without ...
advancedExpressions.example: No introduction to Chinese home cooking would be complete without a mention of braised pork, a dish that graces almost every family table. （推荐信/介绍文强调必提项）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Grandmother cooked pork for us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For hours Grandmother had bent over the stove, coaxing an ordinary cut of pork into something extraordinary, until the whole house was wrapped in a warmth that had nothing to do with the weather. （读后续写·亲情/环境烘托）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: for hours 时间铺陈 + coax...into 拟人化动词 + ordinary→extraordinary 对比 + a warmth that... 定语从句双关（温度/温情）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Pork is an important part of Chinese cooking.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere ingredient, pork occupies a place at the very heart of Chinese cuisine, woven into countless festivals, family gatherings and the everyday rituals of the table. （议论文·饮食文化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being 让步开篇 + at the very heart of 程度强调 + woven into 隐喻 + 三项排比（festivals, gatherings, rituals）

classPractice.question: The table was full of all sorts of dishes: chicken, duck, ____ (pig), fish and vegetables.
classPractice.note: 指“猪肉”这道菜用 pork（不可数）；pig 指活猪，此处并列的是食物，故用 pork。（课文原句）

classPractice.question: 填 pig / pork:We raise a ____ in the yard, and at New Year it provides fresh ____ for the whole family.
classPractice.note: pig 指活体动物（可数），pork 指其肉（不可数），二者不可混用。

classPractice.question: 冰箱里有一些猪肉，够包一顿饺子了。（注意 pork 的可数性）
classPractice.answer: There is some pork in the fridge, enough (for us) to make a meal of dumplings.
classPractice.note: pork 不可数，用 some 修饰，谓语用 is，不可说 a pork / porks。

original_sentence: Luo Yan's son, Bofeng, happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him.
readingExamples: Luo Yan's son, Bofeng, happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an act of biting something, especially a piece of food; the amount of food taken in one bite
(2) n. a wound or mark made by an animal's or insect's teeth
(3) v. to cut into or through something with your teeth
(4) v. (of an insect or snake) to wound someone with a sting or fangs

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （咬下的）一口；咬（take a bite of 咬一口）
uncommonMeanings.example: Bofeng happily takes a bite of the chicken. 博峰高兴地咬了一口鸡肉。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用牙）咬；（虫、蛇）叮咬（bite-bit-bitten）
uncommonMeanings.example: Keep food sealed, or insects that bite may come. 把食物封好，否则会招来咬人的虫子。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一点吃的；便餐（常作 a bite to eat）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grab a bite to eat before you collapse. 累垮之前先随便吃点东西。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （食物的）刺激性味道；辣味；（言语的）尖刻
uncommonMeanings.example: The soup had a welcome bite of ginger. 这汤带着一股宜人的姜的辣味。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （政策、寒冷等）开始产生（不良）影响；使遭受痛苦
uncommonMeanings.example: As the economic winter began to bite, the bakery closed. 经济寒冬开始发威，那家面包店关了门。

posExamples.sentence: Bofeng took an eager bite of the crispy chicken his grandfather had chosen, and the pure delight on his greasy little face made every tired mile of the journey home worthwhile. （读后续写·亲情/团圆）
May I remind all campers to keep food sealed at night, for a single careless mistake could invite ants or worse — creatures that bite while you sleep. （应用文·通知/提醒）
Fear, if we let it, will bite deeper than any hardship; the truly brave are not those who feel no fear but those who act in spite of it. （议论文·勇气）
The mosquito bite on my ankle itched maddeningly, yet I dared not move, for the fawn had finally crept close enough for me to see the trust in its liquid eyes. （读后续写·人与自然）

wordForms.other: bitten (过去分词)

idioms.translation: 咬紧牙关；硬着头皮做（不愉快之事）
idioms.example: Knowing the surgery could not be delayed, she bit the bullet and signed the form. 知道手术拖不得，她硬着头皮签了字。
After rehearsal, we slipped out for a bite to eat. 排练后我们溜出去随便吃了点。

idioms.idiom: bite off more than one can chew
idioms.example: Taking on five clubs at once, he had bitten off more than he could chew. 一下子参加五个社团，他贪多嚼不烂。

idioms.translation: 忍住不说；话到嘴边又咽下
idioms.example: I bit my tongue and swallowed the sharp reply. 我忍住不说，把尖刻的话咽了回去。

idioms.idiom: sb.'s bark is worse than their bite
idioms.translation: 刀子嘴豆腐心；嘴硬心软
idioms.example: The old caretaker grumbled, but his bark was worse than his bite. 老看门人爱抱怨，其实刀子嘴豆腐心。

collocations.phrase: take a bite of sth（【课件】n. 咬下的一口）
collocations.translation: 【课件】咬一口某物（bite 为名词，the act of cutting sth with your teeth）
collocations.example: Bofeng happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him. 博峰美滋滋地咬了一口爷爷为他挑选的鸡肉。

collocations.phrase: take a couple of bites of sth（【课件】原题）
collocations.translation: 【课件】咬几口某物（吃两口三明治）
collocations.example: He took a couple of bites of sandwich. 他吃了两口三明治。

collocations.phrase: a dog / insect bite（【课件】n. 咬伤，咬的伤口）
collocations.example: Dog bites can get infected. 狗咬的伤口会感染。

collocations.phrase: bite into sth（【课件】v. 咬入）
collocations.example: She bit into a ripe juicy peach. 她咬了一口熟透多汁的桃子。

collocations.phrase: bite sth off / bite off sth（【课件】v. 咬下）
collocations.example: He bit off a large chunk of bread. = He bit a large chunk of bread off. 他咬下了一大块面包。

collocations.phrase: bite (bit, bitten)（【课件】v.&vi. 咬；（昆虫）叮）
collocations.translation: 【课件】咬；（虫、蛇）叮咬（不规则变化 bite-bit-bitten）
collocations.example: She was bitten by a wild dog. / An insect bit me badly on the arm. 她被野狗咬了。/ 一只昆虫在我胳膊上狠狠叮了一下。

collocations.phrase: have a bite of one's food（【课件】n. 一口吃的）
collocations.example: I am so busy with the work that I haven't had a bite of my food since morning. 我忙于工作，早晨以来还没有吃过一口东西。

collocations.phrase: take a bite of the chicken（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Bofeng happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him. 博峰高兴地咬了一口爷爷为他挑的鸡肉。
She took a tentative bite of the strange fruit. 她试探性地咬了一口那种奇怪的水果。
Between the two exams we barely had time for a bite to eat. 两场考试之间我们几乎没时间随便吃口东西。

collocations.translation: 虫咬 / 蛇咬 / 狗咬（的伤口）
collocations.example: The nurse cleaned the dog bite gently. 护士轻轻清理狗咬的伤口。
He bit into the warm bun. 他一口咬进热腾腾的包子。
The biting wind cut through my thin coat. 刺骨的寒风穿透了我单薄的外套。
Let's grab a bite before the film. 看电影前咱们随便吃点吧。

collocations.translation: 咬一口苹果；（喻）尝试的机会
collocations.example: One small bite of the apple was all it took to remind me that the simplest fruit from home tasted sweeter than any city delicacy. （读后续写·思乡）

collocations.translation: 对某人厉声说话；（狗）扑咬
collocations.example: Exhausted and anxious, she almost bit at the kind stranger, then caught herself and forced out an apologetic smile. （读后续写·情绪）

synonyms.example: The shy child would only nibble at her food, until Grandmother's funny stories finally coaxed a real appetite out of her. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:nibble 指一小口一小口地轻咬、慢吃，动作轻柔谨慎；bite 是一大口地咬，力度和分量都更大。

synonyms.example: He chewed slowly, savouring every mouthful, as if trying to hold onto the taste of home a little longer. （读后续写·珍惜）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:chew 强调把食物在口中反复咀嚼的过程；bite 强调用牙齿切入、咬下的那一个动作，两者是进食的不同阶段。

synonyms.example: The startled turtle snapped at the twig, then withdrew into its shell as quickly as it had emerged. （读后续写·自然观察）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:snap 指突然、快速地一咬（多为动物受惊时），带猛然合口之意；bite 更中性，可指人或动物平常的咬。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·bite 不规则动词与派生
advancedExpressions.expression: bite - bit - bitten（不规则）;biting(adj.刺骨的/尖刻的) → bitingly(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: He had bitten his nails again by exam day. 到考试那天他又咬起了指甲。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·bite 一词多义与习语
advancedExpressions.expression: take a bite of 咬一口 / a bite to eat 便饭 / bite into 咬入 / bite the bullet 硬着头皮 / bite one's tongue 忍住不说
advancedExpressions.example: She bit the bullet, took one bite of the medicine cake, and bit her tongue about the taste. 她硬着头皮咬了一口药糕，又忍着没吐槽味道。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示“咬/吃”（辨析,可替换 bite）
advancedExpressions.expression: bite 咬下一大口(中性) / nibble 小口轻咬慢吃 / chew 咀嚼(反复) / snap (动物)猛咬
advancedExpressions.example: He didn't nibble; he took one huge bite and chewed happily. 他没有小口啃，而是一大口咬下，开心地嚼着。

advancedExpressions.expression: one bite of ... and ... came flooding back

original_sentence: happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him
readingExamples: happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him
definitionEn:
(1) v. to choose someone or something from a group, especially after careful thought
(2) adj. carefully chosen from a larger number as being the best or most valuable
(3) adj. (of a place or group) used or belonging only to a small group of rich or privileged people

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （经认真比较后）挑选，选择
uncommonMeanings.example: His grandfather has selected the best chicken for him. 爷爷为他挑了最好的鸡肉。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 精选的；上等的；（团体/场所）高档的、专属的
uncommonMeanings.example: Only a select few were invited to the retreat. 只有少数精英获邀参加那次静修。

posExamples.sentence: Grandfather carefully selected the most tender piece of chicken and placed it in Bofeng's bowl, his weathered hands trembling slightly with a love that words had long since failed to express. （读后续写·亲情）
I am writing to inform you that our committee will select ten outstanding volunteers for the exchange programme, and I sincerely hope you will consider submitting your application. （应用文·通知/告知信）
When we select our friends, we are in fact selecting the very influences that will shape who we become, for we inevitably grow to resemble those we keep closest. （议论文·交友/成长）
Reaching the national finals, she found herself among a select group of young musicians whose talent had been polished by years of unseen, unglamorous practice. （读后续写·励志）

wordForms.noun: selection (选择；精选品) / selector (选择者)
wordForms.adjective: selective (adj. 挑剔的；有选择性的) / selected (adj. 精选的)
wordForms.other: select 本身也可作 adj. 精选的、上等的;辨析 selective(挑剔的) ≠ selected(被选中的)

collocations.example: We all selected Tom as our team leader. 我们都选汤姆当我们的队长。
The judges selected the winner from three finalists. 裁判从三位决赛选手中选出了获胜者。

collocations.phrase: select sb to do sth（【课件】）
collocations.example: Our school selected him to attend the meeting. 我们学校选了他去参加会议。
After many tests, he was selected for the national team. 经过多次选拔，他入选了国家队。

collocations.phrase: a selection of sth（【课件】selection n.）
collocations.translation: 【课件】一批精选的……；可供挑选的某类东西
collocations.example: It offers the widest selection of antiques in a one-day market. 它在一日集市上提供可供挑选、应有尽有的古董。
After careful selection, five candidates went to the next round. 经过仔细挑选，五位候选人进入了下一轮。

collocations.phrase: be selective about sth（【课件】selective adj. 精心挑选的，挑剔的）
collocations.example: Parents are selective about what their children eat and drink. 父母对孩子的饮食很讲究。

collocations.phrase: the chicken his grandfather has selected（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 爷爷为他挑选的鸡肉（课文原句）
collocations.example: happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him. 高兴地咬了一口爷爷为他挑选的鸡肉。
She was selected for the debate team. 她被选进了辩论队。
The judges had to select three designs from over two hundred entries. 评委得从两百多件作品中选出三件。
The teacher carefully selected the reading materials. 老师精心挑选了阅读材料。
The coach selected me to lead the relay's final leg. 教练选我跑接力最后一棒。
Success is not reserved for a select few. 成功并非只留给少数精英。

collocations.phrase: select from a range / list of
collocations.translation: 从一系列/一份清单中选择
collocations.example: Applicants may select from a wide range of courses. 申请者可从多种课程中选择。
The farmer hand-selected each ripe strawberry at dawn, unwilling to let a single bruised berry reach his customers' baskets. （读后续写·匠心）

synonyms.translation: 【课件·辨析】选择（侧重根据个人意愿和判断从众多对象中选择）
synonyms.example: She chose the red skirt rather than the blue one. 她选了红裙子而不是蓝裙子。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】choose：侧重根据个人意愿和判断从众多对象中进行选择；表“二选一”时只能用 choose，且可作 vi.。（select 更书面正式、强调精选辨别）

synonyms.translation: 【课件·辨析】选举（用投票等方式认真慎重地选择）
synonyms.example: Word came that Mr Wang had been elected as chairman of the committee. 传来消息，王先生被选为委员会主席。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】elect：按照一定的规章或法律，用投票等方式进行的认真慎重的选择（如选举主席、议员）。

synonyms.translation: 【课件·辨析】挑（多用于非正式语境，含随意挑选之意）
synonyms.example: Can you help me pick some apples? I want some sweet ones. 你能帮我挑几个苹果吗？我想要甜的。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】pick：常用于非正式语境，多指从个人角度从一群人/物中仔细挑选，也含“任意挑选”之意。

synonyms.example: Faced with two roads, she chose the harder one. 面对两条路，她选了更难的那条。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:choose 是最普通的“选择”，日常口语常用，可接不定式(choose to do);select 更正式，隐含“从多个中经过认真比较、精挑细选”，一般不接不定式。

synonyms.example: He picked the smallest puppy in the litter. 他挑了一窝里最小的那只小狗。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:pick 偏口语、随意，动作快而直接；select 强调审慎、有标准地挑选，书面语色彩更浓。

synonyms.example: More young people are opting for meaningful careers. 越来越多年轻人选择有意义的职业。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:opt for 强调“在权衡后决定采取某方案/选项”，多用于抽象选择（方案、道路）；select 多指从具体人或物中挑出。

advancedExpressions.expression: choose（凭个人意愿从众多中选，可作vi.，唯一能表"二选一"）/ select（书面正式，强调精选、仔细辨别）/ elect（按规章以投票等认真慎重地选举）/ pick（非正式，从一群人物中仔细挑，也含随意挑之意）
advancedExpressions.example: The members elected a chairman, the judges selected the finalists, I picked a few apples, and finally chose the sweetest one. 成员们选举了主席，评委精选出决赛者，我挑了几个苹果，最后选了最甜的一个。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·select 词族全家桶
advancedExpressions.expression: select(v./adj.) → selection(n.选择/精选品) → selector(n.) → selective(adj.挑剔的) → selectively(adv.);selected(adj.精选的)
advancedExpressions.example: She is selective about friends but generous once she selects them. 她择友挑剔，但一旦选定便待人慷慨。

advancedExpressions.expression: select sb for sth 为…挑选 / select sb to do 选某人做… / a select few 少数精英 / carefully select 精心挑选
advancedExpressions.example: The committee will carefully select ten volunteers for the programme. 委员会将精心挑选十名志愿者参加该项目。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示“挑选”（可替换 select，注意语域）

advancedExpressions.expression: candidates will be selected on the basis of ...

advancedExpressions.expression: what we select ... ultimately selects us

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. selected the ... and placed it before sb., saying nothing
