original_sentence: solve riddles written on them
readingExamples: solve riddles written on them
definitionEn:
(1) n. a question or statement phrased so as to be puzzling, usually asked as a game and requiring cleverness to answer
(2) n. a person, thing or situation that is mysterious or difficult to understand
(3) v. (usually passive: be riddled with) to fill something with holes, or with a large number of something undesirable

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①谜语（供人猜答、有明确谜底；solve/guess a riddle）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandfather whispered a riddle in my ear, and I spent the whole evening turning the puzzle over in my mind. （读后续写·祖孙互动）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②难解之谜;费解的人或事(a riddle no one could solve)
uncommonMeanings.example: Even after twenty years, his sudden disappearance remained a riddle that no one in the village could ever solve. （读后续写·悬念·未解之谜）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③(常用被动 be riddled with)布满(孔洞);充斥(大量不良之物,如错误/疑虑)
uncommonMeanings.example: The old report, it turned out, was riddled with errors, and the more carefully she read, the deeper her doubts grew. （读后续写·真相浮现）

posExamples.sentence: Grandfather leaned close and whispered a riddle in my ear, his eyes twinkling with mischief, and I spent the whole evening turning the puzzle over in my mind. （读后续写·祖孙互动）
During the Lantern Festival, visitors are invited to guess the riddles pasted on the glowing lanterns, and those who answer correctly will receive a small handmade gift. （应用文·活动通知）
The workings of the human brain remain one of the greatest riddles of modern science, a mystery that continues to humble even our most brilliant minds. （议论文·科学探索）
She scribbled the riddle on a slip of paper and tucked it under his pillow, certain that the puzzle would keep her little brother happily occupied all afternoon. （读后续写·姐弟情）

idioms.translation: 说话云山雾罩,让人摸不着头脑
idioms.example: Stop speaking in riddles and tell me plainly what happened that night! （读后续写·对话·急切追问）

idioms.idiom: a riddle wrapped in a mystery
idioms.translation: 谜中之谜,极度费解之事
idioms.example: To the young detective, the abandoned mansion was a riddle wrapped in a mystery, and every clue only deepened his confusion. （读后续写·悬疑）

collocations.translation: 解开(写在灯笼上的)谜语（课文原句搭配）
collocations.example: 课文原句：Carry or hang up paper lanterns, and solve riddles written on them. （提着或挂起纸灯笼,并解开写在上面的谜语）
The child clapped with delight the moment she solved the riddle, proud to have outwitted her older cousins. （读后续写·孩童机智）
During the festival, crowds gathered beneath the lanterns to guess the riddles written on colourful paper strips. （读后续写·元宵猜谜）
The wise old man posed a riddle to every traveller who sought to cross his bridge. （读后续写·寓言）
After hours of head-scratching, the answer to the riddle turned out to be embarrassingly simple. （读后续写·恍然大悟）

collocations.phrase: a riddle written on a lantern
collocations.example: Each riddle written on a lantern hinted at a lucky word, and the crowd buzzed with guesses. （应用文·民俗介绍）

collocations.translation: 布满(孔洞);充满(错误 / 疑虑)
collocations.example: The ancient wooden beam was riddled with tiny holes bored by generations of insects. （读后续写·古宅描写）

synonyms.example: The missing key was a puzzle that kept the whole household searching until well past midnight. （读后续写·寻找谜团）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：puzzle 范围更广,泛指任何需要思考解决的难题(拼图、谜团、困惑),可作动词'使困惑';riddle 特指以文字巧设、供人猜答的谜语。搭配:solve a puzzle/riddle 均可

synonyms.example: How the letter had reached her remained a mystery she never managed to unravel. （读后续写·未解之谜）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：mystery 强调神秘、无法解释,常无既定答案;riddle 作'谜语'时有明确谜底,作'谜团'时可与 mystery 互换。句法:a mystery to sb 对某人是个谜

synonyms.translation: 费解的人或事,谜一般的存在
synonyms.example: Even to his closest friends, the reclusive artist remained an enigma to the very end. （读后续写·人物刻画）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：enigma 较文雅、书面,多形容令人捉摸不透的人或深奥之事;日常猜谜游戏仍用 riddle。三词由具体到抽象:riddle < puzzle < mystery/enigma

advancedExpressions.expression: solve / guess / pose a riddle；remain a riddle；be riddled with
advancedExpressions.example: 一词多用:solve/guess a riddle 解/猜谜 → pose a riddle 出谜 → remain a riddle 仍是未解之谜 → (v.) be riddled with errors 满是错误。The document was riddled with errors, and its author's motive remained a riddle. （名词、动词双义串记）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... remained a riddle that no one could solve
advancedExpressions.example: The message carved into the old oak remained a riddle that no one in the village could solve, and its meaning haunted them for generations. （名词 riddle 作悬念载体 + haunt 延续张力，埋下伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: guests are welcome to guess the riddles and win small prizes
advancedExpressions.example: Guests are welcome to guess the riddles hanging from the lanterns, and clever solvers will be rewarded with small handmade gifts. （guests are welcome to 邀请套路 + reward 承诺，活动文说明）

advancedExpressions.expression: some of nature's riddles are yet to be unravelled
advancedExpressions.example: Some of nature's deepest riddles are yet to be unravelled, and it is precisely this endless mystery that drives human curiosity ever forward. （yet to be done 未竟表达 + it is...that 强调，赞探索精神）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The children guessed the riddles on the lanterns.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Clustered eagerly beneath the swaying lanterns, the children craned their necks to read the riddles by candlelight, calling out guesses and bursting into laughter whenever someone got it wrong. （读后续写·元宵猜谜）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语开头(Clustered...) + by candlelight 环境细节 + 现在分词伴随(calling...bursting)串起动作与欢乐

sentenceUpgrade.original: The cause of the illness is still unknown.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Despite decades of painstaking research, the true cause of the disease remains a riddle that continues to baffle the finest medical minds of our age. （议论文·科学未解）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Despite 让步短语开篇 + remain a riddle 名词化表达 + continue to baffle 现在时强调持续性,凸显问题之难

original_sentence: On top of the willows the moon crept
readingExamples: On top of the willows the moon crept
definitionEn:
(1) n. a tree that grows near water and has long thin branches that hang down
(2) n. the wood of this tree, valued for its flexibility and used to make cricket bats and baskets
(3) n. (often 'weeping willow') a variety with especially drooping branches, long associated in poetry with sorrow and parting

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文学象征）离别、哀愁的意象
uncommonMeanings.example: In classical Chinese verse, the willow by the roadside was never merely a tree; snapping off a slender branch was a wordless plea for the traveller to stay, a green promise of return. （读后续写·文化意象·离别）

posExamples.sentence: A gentle breeze stirred, and the willow by the pond bowed its trailing branches to the water, brushing the surface until a hundred silver ripples spread out like whispered secrets. （读后续写·环境描写·静谧夜晚）
We warmly invite every family to join our tree-planting day, where you can adopt a young willow along the riverbank and watch it flourish over the years to come. （应用文·倡议书·环保活动）
The willow endures precisely because it bends; those who learn to yield before the storm, rather than stand rigid against it, are the ones most likely to survive life's fiercest gales. （议论文·柔韧胜于刚强）
Beneath the old willow where they had first met, Grandpa laid a single white flower, his weathered hand trembling as decades of memory washed over him in silence. （读后续写·情感·怀念）

collocations.translation: 在柳树梢头（课文原句搭配）
collocations.example: 课文原句：On top of the willows the moon crept. （月亮悄悄爬上柳梢头）
A solitary weeping willow stood at the water's edge, its long green tresses swaying mournfully in the twilight. （读后续写·环境烘托·忧伤）
Children wove the supple willow branches into crowns and chased one another across the sunlit meadow. （读后续写·童年·欢乐）
Every summer afternoon, the old scholar would sit reading under the willows, utterly lost in the world of his books. （读后续写·人物·恬淡）
They planted a willow tree in the schoolyard to mark the day their class first came together. （应用文·纪念活动）
As dusk settled, the willows swayed gently, and the whole riverside seemed to breathe with a slow, peaceful rhythm. （读后续写·环境·宁静）
A row of willows lined the towpath, their reflections shivering in the canal below. （读后续写·环境·画面感）
A willowy figure emerged from the mist, moving with the effortless grace of a dancer. （读后续写·人物出场）

advancedExpressions.expression: willow(n.) → willowy(adj. 苗条纤长的)
advancedExpressions.example: willow 加 -y 变形容词 willowy，形容人身材'像柳枝般纤细柔美'。A willowy figure 苗条的身影。同类:silk→silky, star→starry。

advancedExpressions.expression: the willow ... as if ... , mirroring sb.'s mood
advancedExpressions.example: The willow trailed its branches in the still water as if it, too, were reluctant to let the day go, mirroring the quiet ache in her heart. （拟人+情景交融,以景写情）

advancedExpressions.expression: may each willow we plant today become ...
advancedExpressions.example: May each willow we plant today grow into a living pledge, reminding us that small hands, working together, can green an entire riverbank. （倡议信升华结尾,象征收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: like the willow that bends yet never breaks, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like the willow that bends in the wind yet never breaks, a resilient mind adapts to hardship without ever surrendering its roots. （借物喻理,类比开篇）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was a willow by the river.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By the winding river stood an ancient willow, its slender branches drooping to caress the water, as though bending low to listen to the secrets the current carried away. （读后续写·环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语倒装(By the river stood...) + 拟人(caress/listen) + as though引导比喻状语从句

sentenceUpgrade.original: The willow can survive strong wind because it is soft.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely the willow's yielding softness, not brittle strength, that allows it to weather the fiercest gales unbroken — a truth that speaks volumes about the wisdom of flexibility. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that强调句 + 对比(yielding softness / brittle strength) + 破折号引出哲理升华

original_sentence: On top of the willows the moon crept
readingExamples: On top of the willows the moon crept
definitionEn:
(1) v. to move slowly, quietly and carefully, especially to avoid being noticed
(2) v. (of a thing, feeling or quality) to appear or develop gradually and almost unnoticed
(3) v. (of a plant) to grow along the ground or up walls
(4) n. (informal) an unpleasant person, especially one who tries to win favour by flattery

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①轻手轻脚地走,悄悄移动(以免被察觉;creep along/into/out of)
uncommonMeanings.example: Holding her breath, she crept along the darkened corridor, terrified that a single creak would wake the whole house. （读后续写·潜行·紧张）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②(事物、感觉)不知不觉地出现、渐渐蔓延(crept over/into/in)
uncommonMeanings.example: As I watched the volunteers work through the night, a warm sense of pride crept over me. （应用文·活动感悟·心理）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③(植物)匍匐生长,沿墙攀爬;(数字、价格)缓慢上升(creep up)
uncommonMeanings.example: As costs crept up month after month, the small charity struggled to keep its shelter open. （议论文·社会·经济压力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④(口语,贬义)令人讨厌、谄媚的人;卑鄙小人
uncommonMeanings.example: Everyone in the office knew he was a creep who smiled to the manager's face and spread rumours behind everyone's back. （读后续写·人物·反面角色）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤(the creeps)(因恐惧、厌恶而起的)毛骨悚然的感觉
uncommonMeanings.example: The abandoned house, with its shattered windows and groaning floorboards, gave the children the creeps the moment they crossed the threshold. （读后续写·悬疑·恐惧氛围）

posExamples.sentence: Holding her breath, she crept along the darkened corridor, each floorboard threatening to betray her with a treacherous creak that would wake the whole house. （读后续写·紧张·潜行）
As I watched the volunteers work through the night, a warm sense of pride crept over me, and I knew I had made the right choice in joining this community. （应用文·活动感悟·心理）
Complacency tends to creep in the moment we believe we have nothing left to learn; it is precisely then that the diligent overtake the gifted. （议论文·警惕自满）
Dawn crept over the hills, and pale light spilled across the sleeping village, gilding the rooftops one by one until the whole valley glowed. （读后续写·环境·破晓）

wordForms.noun: creep / creeper (n. 攀缘植物;爬行者)
wordForms.other: 不规则变化:creep - crept - crept（切记非 creeped）；派生 creepy(adj.)；固定短语 give sb the creeps 使某人发毛

idioms.translation: 让某人心里发毛、感到厌恶（熟词僻义·高频）
idioms.example: There was something about the silent, watchful house at the end of the lane that gave me the creeps. （读后续写·气氛·不安）
The stranger's cold, unblinking stare made her flesh creep, and every instinct screamed at her to run. （读后续写·悬疑·恐惧）

collocations.translation: 【课件】蹑手蹑脚地上楼（缓慢、无声地移动）
collocations.example: I crept up the stairs, trying not to wake my parents. （课件·蹑手蹑脚地行进）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（感觉）渐渐在某人心头产生、袭上
collocations.example: A slight feeling of suspicion crept over me. （课件·渐渐产生）
Tiredness can easily creep up on you while you're taking classes. （课件·不知不觉逼近）
House prices are creeping up again. （课件·渐渐上涨）

collocations.phrase: (the moon) creep on top of the willows
collocations.translation: (月亮)悄悄爬上柳梢（课文原句搭配）
collocations.example: 课文原句：On top of the willows the moon crept. （月亮悄悄爬上柳梢头——creep 写月亮不知不觉、悄然升起）
A note of doubt crept into her voice, and the whole room fell silent, sensing that something had gone terribly wrong. （读后续写·对话·转折）
The traffic crept forward inch by inch, and I began to fear I would miss the interview altogether. （读后续写·焦急）
Long before sunrise, she crept out of the tent and climbed the ridge to watch the first light break. （读后续写·冒险·清晨）
A creeping sense of unease settled over the passengers as the plane lurched through the storm. （读后续写·氛围·不安）

collocations.translation: 让某人浑身起鸡皮疙瘩
collocations.example: The eerie whisper echoing down the tunnel made my skin creep. （读后续写·恐怖）

synonyms.example: He sneaked a glance at the answer sheet, his heart pounding with guilt. （读后续写·心理·犯错）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:sneak强调'偷偷摸摸、带有不正当或做贼心虚的目的';creep更侧重'动作本身缓慢、轻、无声',不一定含贬义。句法:sneak/creep + into/out of

synonyms.example: The wounded soldier crawled toward the trench, dragging his injured leg through the mud. （读后续写·战争·坚韧）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:crawl指'手脚并用地爬'(婴儿、伤兵)或形容极慢移动(交通);creep更强调'轻手轻脚、以免被察觉'的悄悄移动

synonyms.example: She tiptoed past the nursery, terrified that the slightest sound might wake the baby. （读后续写·细节·小心翼翼）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:tiptoe特指'踮脚尖'这一具体动作;creep是更宽泛的'悄悄移动',不限定脚的姿势

advancedExpressions.expression: creep - crept - crept（过去式/过去分词均为 crept）
advancedExpressions.example: On top of the willows the moon crept.（课文原句用过去式 crept）注意:不是 creeped！同类不规则:sleep-slept, keep-kept, sweep-swept。

advancedExpressions.expression: creep up on / creep in / creep over sb.
advancedExpressions.example: creep up on sb 悄悄逼近某人 / creep in 悄然渗入 / creep over sb (感觉)慢慢袭上心头。A chill crept over her as footsteps crept up on her from behind. （方向介词决定含义,成组记）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... crept over sb., and only then did sb. realize ...
advancedExpressions.example: A chill crept over her, and only then did she realize that the footsteps behind had never stopped. （倒装+悬念,续写恐惧升级）

advancedExpressions.expression: as ... , a sense of ... crept over me
advancedExpressions.example: As the last note of the anthem faded, a profound sense of belonging crept over me — I was, at last, part of something greater than myself. （应用文·活动体验·情感收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... often creeps in unnoticed, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: Prejudice often creeps in unnoticed, disguised as harmless opinion, until it hardens into a wall no argument can breach. （渐进式论证,揭示隐患）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She walked quietly into the room.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Barely daring to breathe, she crept into the room, placing each foot with the exaggerated care of someone who knew that a single creak could ruin everything. （读后续写·潜行·紧张）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语前置(Barely daring to breathe) + creep替代walk quietly增强画面 + 状语从句(who knew...)补足心理动机

sentenceUpgrade.original: Slowly, people started to feel afraid.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Little by little, an unspoken fear crept through the crowd, tightening every throat and stilling every restless hand, until the square lay under a silence heavy enough to touch. （读后续写·群体情绪）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: creep through the crowd拟物化恐惧 + 现在分词并列(tightening/stilling) + 夸张收尾(silence...heavy enough to touch)

classPractice.question: On top of the willows the moon ____ (creep), casting a pale glow over the sleeping town.
classPractice.note: 课文原句意境；creep 的过去式为 crept（不规则,非 creeped）

classPractice.question: The silent, watchful house at the end of the lane gave me the ____ (让我发毛).
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义 give sb the creeps 使某人心里发毛，用复数 creeps

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（crept / sneaked）：Exhaustion ____ up on him unnoticed, and by the final mile he could barely walk.
classPractice.note: creep up on sb（疲惫等）不知不觉逼近；sneak 侧重'做贼心虚地溜'，不搭 up on 表此义

original_sentence: Tears fall, and make my sleeves wet.
readingExamples: Tears fall, and make my sleeves wet.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a drop of the salty liquid that flows from the eye when someone cries or when the eye is irritated
(2) v. /teə(r)/ to pull or be pulled apart, or to pull pieces off, often violently or by accident
(3) v. /teə(r)/ to move very quickly and often carelessly
(4) n. /teə(r)/ a hole or split made when something is torn

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①眼泪,泪珠（读 /tɪə/；tears roll/course down 眼泪流下, tearful 含泪的）
uncommonMeanings.example: Tears rolled down / coursed down his face. She became very tearful and asked him tearfully what was wrong. （课件·眼泪/含泪）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②撕，撕裂，撕碎（读 /teə/，tear-tore-torn；与'眼泪'同形异音）
uncommonMeanings.example: I tore a hole in my jeans; he tore the letter in two. Careful — the fabric tears very easily. （课件·撕）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③tear apart 使……四分五裂；使难过
uncommonMeanings.example: War and revolution have torn families apart; being away from you has torn me apart. （课件·撕裂/使难过）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④飞奔，狂奔（读 /teə/;tear across/down/along）
uncommonMeanings.example: The moment the bell rang, the children tore across the playground, whooping with uncontainable joy. （读后续写·童年·活力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤(be torn between)在两者之间进退两难、左右为难
uncommonMeanings.example: She was torn between her longing to chase her dream in the city and her duty to care for her ageing parents. （读后续写·内心冲突·抉择）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑥(撕开的)口子,裂缝(a tear in the fabric)
uncommonMeanings.example: A jagged tear ran down the sleeve of his old coat, a silent record of the years of hard labour. （读后续写·细节·人物）

posExamples.sentence: A single tear traced its way down her weathered cheek as she watched the train pull away, carrying her only son toward a future she could no longer share. （读后续写·离别·亲情）
On behalf of the whole class, I want to say that your unwavering support moved many of us to tears, and we will carry your kindness with us for years to come. （应用文·感谢信·致老师）
Tears are not a sign of weakness but of a heart brave enough to feel deeply; a society that shames people for crying only teaches them to suffer in silence. （议论文·情感与坚强）
In a fit of despair he tore the rejection letter to shreds, only to kneel moments later and gather the pieces, unwilling to give up on the dream just yet. （读后续写·转折·不放弃）

wordForms.adjective: tearful / teary / torn (含泪的/撕破的)
wordForms.other: 发音同形异义:n.眼泪读 /tɪə/;v.撕、n.裂口读 /teə/。动词不规则:tear - tore - torn。派生:tearful(adj.)→tearfully(adv.)

idioms.example: When she saw her name at the top of the honour roll, she burst into tears, months of doubt dissolving in an instant. （读后续写·惊喜·情感爆发）
The old veteran's simple words about his fallen comrades moved the entire audience to tears. （读后续写·感人·致敬）
I found her sitting alone in the corner, in tears, clutching a faded photograph to her chest. （读后续写·发现·悲伤）

idioms.translation: 磨损，损耗（日常使用造成的）
idioms.example: After years of daily use, the old bridge showed serious wear and tear and had to be closed for repairs. （议论文·基础设施·维护）
Fighting back tears, he stepped up to the microphone and thanked the coach who had believed in him. （读后续写·感恩·克制）

collocations.phrase: tears roll down / course down one's face
collocations.translation: 【课件】眼泪顺着某人的脸颊流下来（tear 读 /tɪə/）
collocations.example: Tears rolled down / coursed down his face. （课件·眼泪流下）

collocations.translation: 【课件】挥泪送别（tearful adj. 含泪的；~event 催人泪下的）
collocations.example: They said their goodbyes at a tearful farewell on the crowded platform. （课件·含泪的）

collocations.translation: 【课件】变得眼含泪水 / 含泪地（对某人说）
collocations.example: She suddenly became very tearful, and asked him tearfully what had gone wrong. （课件·tearful/tearfully）

collocations.phrase: tear a hole in sth / tear sth in two
collocations.translation: 【课件】撕出一个洞 / 把某物撕成两半（tear 读 /teə/，tore, torn）
collocations.example: I tore a hole in my jeans. He tore the letter in two. （课件·撕）
War and revolution have torn families apart. Don't think it hasn't torn me apart to be away from you. （课件·撕裂/使难过）

collocations.phrase: tear sth up into little pieces
collocations.example: In a fit of anger, he tore the photo up into little pieces. （课件·撕碎）

collocations.translation: 【课件】深受罢工困扰的行业（-torn 构成复合形容词）
collocations.example: Investors were reluctant to put money into a strike-torn industry. （课件·-torn 复合形容词）

collocations.phrase: tears fall (and make one's sleeves wet)
collocations.translation: 泪水落下（打湿衣袖）（课文原句搭配）
collocations.example: 课文原句：Tears fall, and make my sleeves wet. （泪水落下,打湿了我的衣袖——此处 tears 读 /tɪə/,作'眼泪'）

collocations.translation: 泪水滚落 / 涌流而下
collocations.example: Tears streamed down his face as the national anthem played and the flag rose above the podium. （读后续写·荣耀·激动）

collocations.translation: 泪水在眼眶里打转、涌上来
collocations.example: Tears welled up in her eyes, but she blinked them back, determined not to let anyone see how much the words had hurt. （读后续写·隐忍·心理）
Choking back tears, she managed a trembling smile and told her mother that everything would be all right. （读后续写·坚强·安慰）
He gently wiped away her tears with his sleeve and promised that he would never leave her side again. （读后续写·安慰·温情）
When the rescue team finally emerged from the collapsed mine, the waiting families wept tears of joy and relief. （读后续写·获救·团圆）

collocations.phrase: tear sth. up / apart / to pieces
collocations.translation: 把某物撕碎、撕开（tear 读 /teə/）
collocations.example: Furious at the unfair verdict, he tore the contract to pieces and stormed out of the office. （读后续写·愤怒·冲突）
With trembling fingers she tore open the envelope, hardly daring to hope for the news she had waited months to receive. （读后续写·悬念·期待）

collocations.translation: 磨损,损耗（日常使用造成的；tear 读 /teə/，此处为名词）
collocations.example: After years of daily use, the old bridge showed serious wear and tear and had to be closed for repairs. （议论文·基础设施·维护）

collocations.phrase: be torn between A and B
collocations.translation: 在 A 与 B 之间难以取舍
collocations.example: The young doctor was torn between the promise of a city practice and his vow to serve the remote village that had raised him. （议论文·理想与现实·抉择）
The relentless criticism finally reduced the young intern to tears, though she refused to let it break her resolve. （读后续写·委屈·坚持）

synonyms.example: She wept silently by the window, mourning a friendship that time and distance had slowly worn away. （读后续写·悲伤·文雅）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:weep是动词,较cry更文学、更含蓄,强调'默默流泪';tear是名词,指'泪珠'本身,常见于shed tears/in tears等搭配

synonyms.example: He ripped the wrapping paper off the gift, unable to contain his childlike excitement. （读后续写·惊喜·急切）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:rip与tear(撕)近义,但rip更强调'又快又猛地撕开、扯下';tear可快可慢,是更中性、通用的说法

synonyms.example: He dashed out of the classroom the instant the exam ended, desperate to share the good news with his family. （读后续写·急切·奔跑）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:dash与tear(飞奔)近义,均指快速跑动;tear更强调'不顾一切、横冲直撞'的鲁莽感,dash则较中性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·同形异音+不规则变化
advancedExpressions.expression: tear /tɪə/(眼泪) vs tear /teə/(撕);tear - tore - torn
advancedExpressions.example: 同一拼写两读音两义:Tears /tɪə/ fell（泪落, 名词）；He tore /teə/ up the letter（他撕碎信, 动词, 过去式 tore, 过去分词 torn）。做题先判词义再定读音与形态。

advancedExpressions.expression: tear up / tear open / wear and tear / be torn between
advancedExpressions.example: tear up 撕碎 / tear open 撕开 / wear and tear 磨损(名词) / be torn between A and B 在两者间难以取舍。He was torn between keeping the torn photo and tearing it up. （集中记 /teə/ 一组）

advancedExpressions.expression: tears sb. had fought so hard to hold back finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: The tears she had fought so hard to hold back finally broke free, streaming down her face — not tears of sorrow this time, but of pure, overwhelming relief. （定语从句+转折,泪水意象升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: words can hardly express ... , even now brings tears to my eyes
advancedExpressions.example: Words can hardly express our gratitude; even now, recalling how you stayed by our side that night brings tears to my eyes. （感谢信,以泪写恩）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being a weakness, tears are ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being a weakness, tears are the honest overflow of a heart that dares to care — and a world that mocks them breeds only coldness. （否定前置强调,情感与人性论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very sad and started to cry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Something inside her finally gave way; the tears she had held back for so long spilled over, silent at first, then shaking her whole body as grief long buried rose to the surface. （读后续写·情感爆发）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 隐喻(something gave way)写情绪决堤 + tears held back...spilled over画面化 + 节奏递进(silent at first, then shaking)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Crying does not mean you are weak.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To shed tears is not to admit defeat; rather, it is to acknowledge, with unflinching honesty, that we are human — and it is often the bravest, not the weakest, who allow themselves to weep. （议论文·观点升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 不定式作主语(To shed tears is...) + not...rather对比结构 + it is...who强调句突出'勇敢者'

classPractice.question: 泪水落下,打湿了我的衣袖。____ fall, and make my sleeves wet.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处 tears 读 /tɪə/，作'眼泪'

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（tears /tɪə/ 或 tore /teə/）：In a fit of rage, he ____ the rejection letter into a hundred pieces.
classPractice.note: 此处义为'撕碎'，读 /teə/，动词，过去式 tore；与'眼泪'tears 同形异音

classPractice.question: After years of daily use, the old bridge showed serious ____ and tear and had to be closed.
classPractice.note: wear and tear 磨损、损耗（固定短语，此处 tear 为名词，读 /teə/）

classPractice.question: She was ____ (tear) between chasing her dream in the city and caring for her ageing parents.
classPractice.note: be torn between A and B 在两者间难以取舍；tear 的过去分词 torn

original_sentence: Tears fall, and make my sleeves wet.
readingExamples: Tears fall, and make my sleeves wet.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the part of a piece of clothing that covers all or part of your arm
(2) n. a stiff paper or cardboard cover that protects a record or CD
(3) n. a tube-shaped cover that fits over another part, especially to protect it
(4) v. (usually 'up one's sleeve') to keep something secret and ready for use at the right moment

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （唱片、CD 的）纸套，护封
uncommonMeanings.example: He slid the vinyl record from its faded sleeve with the reverence of a man handling a long-lost photograph. （读后续写·怀旧·细节）

posExamples.sentence: She rolled up her sleeves, took a deep breath, and plunged her hands into the icy stream to free the trapped fawn before the current could sweep it away. （读后续写·救助·行动力）
Please remember to wear a shirt with long sleeves and sturdy trousers during the field trip, as the mountain trails can be thorny and the weather unpredictable. （应用文·通知·活动须知）
A person who is always ready to roll up their sleeves and get to work, rather than merely offering advice from the sidelines, is the true engine of any team. （议论文·实干精神）
With no handkerchief to hand, the little boy wiped his tear-streaked face on his sleeve and bravely announced that he was not crying at all. （读后续写·童真·倔强）

wordForms.other: 构词:sleeve + -less（无……的）→ sleeveless 无袖的；sleeve + -d → long-sleeved 长袖的。习语富集词:roll up one's sleeves / up one's sleeve / wear one's heart on one's sleeve

idioms.translation: 卷起袖子；准备大干一场
idioms.example: Instead of complaining about the flooded classroom, the students simply rolled up their sleeves and began mopping the water away. （读后续写·集体·担当）

idioms.idiom: have / keep sth. up one's sleeve
idioms.translation: 暗中留有妙计、锦囊；私藏一手
idioms.example: The old coach smiled calmly at the scoreboard, for he still had one final tactic up his sleeve. （读后续写·比赛·反转伏笔）

idioms.idiom: wear one's heart on one's sleeve
idioms.translation: 把感情表露无遗；毫不掩饰内心
idioms.example: Unlike his guarded brother, Tom wore his heart on his sleeve, and everyone always knew exactly how he felt. （读后续写·人物性格·率真）
While the others panicked over the sudden test, she laughed up her sleeve, for she had quietly revised the whole chapter the night before. （读后续写·心理·暗喜）

collocations.translation: 打湿衣袖（课文原句搭配）
collocations.example: 课文原句：Tears fall, and make my sleeves wet. （泪水落下,打湿了我的衣袖）

collocations.translation: 卷起袖子（准备行动、大干一场）
collocations.example: The moment disaster struck, volunteers from every corner of the town rolled up their sleeves and worked side by side through the night. （读后续写·灾难·团结）
As autumn crept in, she packed away her short-sleeved shirts and reached for something with long sleeves. （读后续写·季节·日常）

collocations.translation: 拉扯某人的袖子（引起注意）
collocations.example: A small child tugged at my sleeve and, pointing to a lost puppy shivering in the rain, asked if I could help. （读后续写·触发·善意）
He wiped the sweat from his brow on his sleeve and pressed on toward the summit. （读后续写·坚持·登顶）
For the summer charity gala, many guests chose light sleeveless dresses to cope with the sweltering heat. （应用文·活动·着装）
She pushed up her sleeves and began kneading the dough with a determination that surprised even herself. （读后续写·动作·投入）
The cover artwork on the record sleeve was as iconic as the music it protected. （议论文·艺术·文化记忆）
The old coach smiled calmly at the scoreboard, for he still had one final tactic up his sleeve. （读后续写·比赛·反转伏笔）
The magician tucked the silk scarf up his sleeve so smoothly that not a single child in the front row noticed. （读后续写·表演·手法）

advancedExpressions.expression: roll up one's sleeves / have sth up one's sleeve / wear one's heart on one's sleeve
advancedExpressions.example: sleeve 三大高频习语:roll up one's sleeves 卷袖子准备大干 / have sth up one's sleeve 暗藏一手 / wear one's heart on one's sleeve 情感外露。He rolled up his sleeves, though he still had a trick up his sleeve. （成组记忆,区分动作义与比喻义）

advancedExpressions.expression: sleeve + -less → sleeveless；+ -d → long-sleeved
advancedExpressions.example: -less 表'无……的':sleeveless 无袖的、careless 粗心的、hopeless 绝望的;复合形容词 long-sleeved 长袖的、short-sleeved 短袖的。a sleeveless dress / a long-sleeved shirt。

advancedExpressions.expression: little did they know sb. still had ... up their sleeve
advancedExpressions.example: Little did his rivals know that the quiet boy still had one dazzling move up his sleeve, saved for the very last round. （倒装+悬念,续写反转铺垫）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us roll up our sleeves and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than waiting for others to act, let us roll up our sleeves and turn this barren corner of our campus into a garden we can all be proud of. （倡议信·号召行动）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who roll up their sleeves ... , not those who ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is those who roll up their sleeves and shoulder the hard work, not those who theorise endlessly from the comfort of their armchairs, who truly move society forward. （强调句+对比,褒实干贬空谈）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He got ready to work hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a word of complaint, he rolled up his sleeves, squared his shoulders, and threw himself into the task as though the fate of the entire team rested on him alone. （读后续写·担当·投入）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 状语前置(Without a word of complaint) + 三动词连贯动作(rolled up, squared, threw) + as though夸张比喻烘托决心

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should act instead of just talking.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The time has come to stop talking and start doing; let us roll up our sleeves, for a single deed accomplished together is worth a thousand promises made in isolation. （应用文·倡议·号召）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The time has come to...正式呼吁 + let us祈使号召 + 对比格言收尾(a single deed...worth a thousand promises)

classPractice.note: 课文原句；sleeve 袖子，此处用复数 sleeves（双袖）

classPractice.note: roll up one's sleeves 卷起袖子/准备大干一场（此处叙述过去，用 rolled up）

classPractice.note: have sth up one's sleeve 暗藏一手、私留妙计
